Result: 在MNIST/Fashion-MNIST INR分类中达95.6%/80.7%准确率，优于NFN、DWSNet等基线；在sinusoid回归任务上test MSE为1.06±0.24，优于GMN(1.13)；在CIFAR-10泛化预测中Kendall's τ=0.846，低于NFN(0.934)，但换取了内在可解释的紧凑嵌入。消融证实排序损失、时序平滑及带符号回归头对几何-功能耦合至关重要。

Conclusion: 将训练轨迹视为参数图在负曲率空间中的演化，可获得兼具置换对称性、紧凑性与几何意义的内在表示；该框架可推广到CNN、Transformer等结构，并在内在可解释性、层级与功能模块形成的可视化中展现潜力，但相较原始张量方法在精细性能预测上仍有差距，需更强正则或集成的稳态优化。

Abstract: Intrinsic explainability remains a challenging problem, particularly in contexts where multilayer perceptrons (MLPs) require dynamic re-training within an optimization environment. This paper investigates how MLPs and their training dynamics can be represented and studied in non-Euclidean spaces; our representation features the Poincaré model of hyperbolic geometry. We aim to capture the geometric evolution of their weighted topology and self-organization over time. Instead of restricting the analysis to single checkpoints---as per established measure-based explainability methods---we construct temporal \textit{parameter graphs}, i.e., snapshots over time $T$ steps of the optimization/training process for MLPs. This reflects the view that neural networks encode information not only in their weights but also in the trajectory traced during training. Drawing on the idea that many complex networks admit embeddings in hidden metric spaces where distances correspond to connection likelihood, we present a geometric and temporal graph-based metalearning framework for obtaining dynamic hyperbolic representations of the underlying neural parameter graphs. Our model embeds temporal parameter graphs in the Poincaré model ball, and learns from them while maintaining equivariance to within-snapshot neuron permutations and invariance to permutations of past snapshots. In doing so, the approach preserves functional equivalence over time and recovers the latent evolving geometry of the network. Experiments on regression and classification tasks with trained MLPs show strong meta-network performance, accompanied by hyperbolic temporal representations. This reveals how the network structure emerges over time under specific training environments, thus providing insights into the network's self-organization.

</details>


### [152] [AvoKV-E: Payload-Aware KV Cache Eviction for Long Reasoning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.03007)
*Han Yu,Wenhui Zhu,Xiwen Chen,Zhipeng Wang,Hejian Sang,Han Shi,Menglin Zhou,Xuanzhao Dong,Minzhou Huang,Rui Cai,Hao Wang,Alborz Geramifard*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: AvoKV-E 是一种无需训练的 KV 缓存淘汰策略，专为长输出推理任务设计。它通过延迟新生成条目的淘汰评估时机，并结合读压力、键冗余度和价值载荷潜力三个候选归一化信号进行打分，解决了现有"路由式"淘汰方法忽略高载荷低注意力条目以及过早评估新生成状态两个关键问题。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在长输出推理（如 DeepSeek-R1、Qwen3）中，已生成的推理 token 本身成为 KV 缓存的主要占用对象。现有淘汰方法（H2O、StreamingLLM、R-KV、LazyEviction 等）主要从键（key）的角度判断条目重要性，存在两个局限：一是低注意力条目可能携带高价值载荷（value payload），其移除会显著改变后续预测；二是新生成的状态可能因后续查询尚未有机会读取而显得"陈旧"，过早评估会混淆"尚未被读取"与"无用"。诊断显示，低注意力/高载荷区域的"高损伤"条目富集约 2.4 倍。

Method: AvoKV-E 采用两阶段、无训练的淘汰策略：(1) **延迟因果观察**：将缓存分为受保护的延迟缓冲 P_t（最近 W_delay 个条目不可淘汰）和候选集 C_t（更早条目可参与排名），确保每个候选在被评估前已被观察窗口 O_t 中的查询因果地读取过；(2) **载荷感知淘汰风险打分**：对候选条目计算三个信号——读压力 p_i（O_t 内注意力均值）、键冗余度 r_i（与候选邻域内最近邻的余弦相似度）、载荷潜力 b_i（值向量 L2 范数与层/头中位数的比值），三者经候选内百分位秩归一化到 [0,1]，组合为 S_i = λ_p·N(p_i) - λ_r·N(r_i) + λ_b·N(b_i)。载荷项独立于查找与键聚合，不与查找相乘，以避免抑制低读/高载荷条目。压缩每 128 token 触发一次，配置 (λ_p, λ_r, λ_b) = (0.1, 0.9, 0.05)，W_obs=8，预算 ≥500 时 W_delay=8，预算 ≤512 时 W_delay=32，并始终保护前 4 个缓存条目。

Result: 在 DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Llama-8B 和 Qwen3-14B 上的 MATH-500 与 AIME-25 基准测试中，AvoKV-E 在匹配的活跃 KV 预算下匹配或优于 R-KV（冗余感知）、LazyEviction（基于复发）和自实现的薄 KV（思想自适应）基线，且在最小预算下优势最大（如 R1-8B/MATH-500 预算 512 时准确率 81.4% vs R-KV 76.6%，32K 截断命中数 55 vs 78）。在 5,440 个候选条目的单 token 淘汰 KL 预言排名上，AvoKV-E 在 AUROC（0.901）、AP（0.848）、Top-k 召回（0.658）、误安全率（0.020）和 Spearman 相关（0.331）五项指标上均优于纯注意力、R-KV 风格、查找纯代理及查找×年龄基线。组件消融表明：移除键冗余度损失最大（预算 512 时从 81.4% 降至 73.4%），移除载荷项、延迟资格或秩归一化均导致持续退化。诊断证实：低注意力/高载荷区域高损伤条目富集 2.4 倍（Fisher 精确检验 p=0.009），低注意力候选者的读累积分布在 32 步内有 15% 始终未被强读（KS 检验 p=0.010）。

Conclusion: 长推理场景下的 KV 缓存淘汰应同时保留"可能被读取的键"与"维持推理轨迹的价值载荷"。AvoKV-E 通过解耦"何时可评估"（延迟观察）与"如何打分"（读压+键冗余+载荷潜力+候选归一化），在无需训练、附加里程碑/思想分类器或服务内核修改的前提下，以纯淘汰策略实现了对路由式淘汰两个失败模式的有效修正，并在紧缓存场景下取得最显著增益。未来工作可与 KV 量化和混合淘汰–量化分配策略结合评估。

Abstract: Long-output reasoning shifts the KV-cache bottleneck from the fixed prompt to the generated trace. Existing reasoning-cache eviction methods largely treat cached entries as routing objects, estimating whether an old key will still be read, will recur, or can be replaced. This routing-only view overlooks two effects: low-attention entries can carry large value payloads whose removal changes future predictions, and newly generated states can appear stale before later queries have had a chance to read them. We introduce AvoKV-E, a training-free eviction policy that first delays eligibility for recent states and then ranks eligible entries using candidate-normalized read pressure, key redundancy, and value-payload potential. According to empirical evaluation across different models and datasets, AvoKV-E matches or exceeds redundancy-aware, recurrence-based, and thought-adaptive eviction baselines at matched active-KV budgets, with its largest gains in the tightest-cache regime. Component and counterfactual analyses further connect these gains to delayed observation, payload-aware scoring, redundancy, and scale-robust normalization. Together, the results show that long-reasoning KV eviction should preserve not only keys that are likely to be read, but also the value payloads that sustain the reasoning trajectory.

</details>


### [153] [Tailoring the Quantization Space for 1-Bit KV Cache Compression](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.03027)
*Minsoo Cheong,Donghyun Son,Sungjoo Yoo*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: TaSQ是一种针对1-bit KV缓存压缩的向量量化方法，通过查询引导的通道加权、跨头归一化和协方差感知的通道分组来定制量化目标空间，在保持推理稳定性的同时显著提升压缩效果。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 随着长上下文LLM推理的普及，KV缓存成为内存容量和带宽的主要瓶颈。现有向量量化(VQ)方法在1-bit极致压缩率下性能严重下降，因为每个码本需要用有限的中心表示更多通道，容量利用困难。观察发现：1)不同键通道对量化误差的敏感度不同；2)通道间存在不均匀相关性；3)RoPE后会扩大键的分布范围。

Method: TaSQ通过三个核心组件定制VQ目标空间：1)查询引导的通道加权 - 基于查询激活统计推导通道权重W_h，转换键使VQ重建目标直接包含查询敏感性；2)跨头共享尺度归一化 - 用单个RMS尺度替代逐头归一化，节省元数据开销；3)协方差感知的通道分组 - 基于速率失真理论使用协方差行列式作为量化误差代理，通过层次匹配算法在保持RoPE对约束下分组。这些变换可被合并到投影权重和码本中，对RoPE兼容，不引入运行时密集操作。值则使用标准VQ。

Result: 在Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct、Qwen3-4B、Qwen3-4B-Thinking-2507、DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Llama-8B和Phi-4-reasoning-plus等模型上，TaSQ在通用任务、长CoT推理和长上下文检索基准测试中均优于CQ、NovaKV和NSNQuant等基线方法。在RTX 6000 Ada GPU的SGLang实现上，批处理大小提升14倍，峰值吞吐量相比BF16提升1.87倍(220.8→412.6 tokens/s)。消融研究表明协方差感知分组贡献最大。

Conclusion: TaSQ通过定制量化目标空间（而非依赖密集变换），实现了准确且高效的1-bit KV缓存压缩，同时保留了传统VQ查找结构，几乎无运行时开销。该方法展示了针对KV缓存统计结构和误差敏感性设计VQ空间是实现超低比特压缩的有效途径。

Abstract: The key-value (KV) cache becomes a major memory bottleneck in long-context LLM inference, placing substantial pressure on memory capacity and bandwidth. To mitigate this bottleneck, vector quantization (VQ) has emerged as a promising approach for aggressive KV cache compression. However, existing VQ methods degrade substantially in the 1-bit regime. At such extreme compression, each codebook must represent a larger group of channels with a limited set of centroids, making effective use of its capacity increasingly challenging. To address this, we introduce $\textbf{TaSQ}$, which tailors the VQ target space by combining query-guided channel weighting, cross-head normalization, and covariance-aware channel grouping to better reflect the error sensitivity and statistical structure of cached activations. Since these transforms are RoPE-compatible and can be easily merged into projection weights and codebooks, TaSQ preserves the conventional VQ lookup structure and adds negligible serving overhead. Across general, long-chain-of-thought reasoning, and long-context retrieval benchmarks, TaSQ consistently outperforms existing low-bit KV cache VQ baselines while preserving reasoning stability. On a single RTX 6000 Ada GPU, its SGLang implementation supports up to $14\times$ larger batch sizes and achieves $1.87\times$ higher peak throughput compared to the BF16 baseline.

</details>


### [154] [WebFovea: When the Model Is Right but the Click Is Wrong -- Reliable Round Trips for Vision-Based Web Agents on Live Websites](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.03036)
*Jiangang Han*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: WebFovea 是一款基于视觉的网页智能体，在 WebRetriever Challenge 2026 中获得第二名（57.0/100）。其核心贡献是提出一个"四阶段往返"分析框架（解析、执行、反馈、观察），并通过加固每个阶段及外围护栏，使同一模型的官方分数从 31.0 提升到 57.0，证明许多看似推理错误的失败实际上发生在模型与浏览器之间的"工具链"层。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 视觉型网页智能体在真实网站上的许多失败并非源于模型推理，而是发生在模型与浏览器之间的 harness（执行框架）层面：动作解析错误、执行未生效、反馈报告错误或观察信息缺失。当模型判断正确但点击落空时，错误被误归咎于推理能力。论文旨在系统化识别并修复这些阶段层面的故障。

Method: 1. 四阶段往返模型：将每一步建模为"解析（parsing）→ 执行（execution）→ 反馈（feedback）→ 观察（observation）"的闭环，并围绕闭环设置护栏（guardrails）。  
2. 具体加固措施：  
- 解析：保留首个 Thought/Action 对，剥离模型自生的 chat-template token（如 `<|eot_id|>`）及尾部残留标记；  
- 执行：坐标空间对齐（API 实际将 1920×1080 下采样至约 1440×810，需按 1.324/1.350 修正）；新增 `select` 处理原生下拉框、`fill` 处理文本输入（含 iframe）、Enter 键提交、iframe DOM 回退；  
- 反馈：DOM 指纹 + 子框架指纹、tooltip 文本哈希、`fill` 回读值；  
- 观察：截图尺寸上限、`hover`、`find_text`、`read_text`（含自定义字体反混淆）、基于规则的触发条件；  
- 护栏：封闭动作集（移除 `goto` 等捷径）、执行器强制预算（每任务 80 步/1800 秒）、14 条硬约束、滚动断路器、共享队列调度、模型调用重试。  
3. 使用同一模型 `claude-opus-4-6` 进行四次提交，逐步替换各组件以隔离 harness 改进的影响。

Result: 在 WebRetriever Challenge 2026 隐藏测试集上的官方得分从 31.0（首次提交）逐步提升至 41.0 → 46.0 → 57.0（最终提交），排名第二，且人工复核未扣分。关键组件证据：坐标对齐在 24 任务上将成功率从 8/24 提升至 20/24；token 剥离修复了全部 551 个受污染步骤且未影响干净步骤；iframe 回退使 Tableau 任务首次通过；4.9% 的回合受 chat-template token 污染，受污染回合成功率仅 7.7%（清洁回合 41.7%）。负面结果包括：单纯增加反馈提示未能改变模型行为、`read_text` 被使用但未修复任务、早期启发式空闲中断反而破坏正常任务。

Conclusion: 对于在真实网站上运行的视觉型网页智能体，许多失败源自模型与浏览器之间的工具链（harness）而非模型推理本身。"四阶段往返"框架提供了一种模型无关的诊断清单与设计视角，可迁移到更强的模型、模型组合及新环境。主要建议：在归咎于模型之前，先检查模型的决策是否真正到达页面，以及页面的响应是否真正到达模型。局限包括：仅使用单一模型、样本量小、真实网站会随时间漂移（13/100 公开任务参考答案已过时）、缺乏参考实现在隐藏集上的同模型基线。

Abstract: We present WebFovea, a vision-based web agent that placed 2nd in the WebRetriever Challenge 2026 with a final score of 57.0 out of 100. The challenge evaluates agents end to end on Protocol III of the WebRetriever benchmark ( arXiv:2607.06118 ): starting from an entry URL on a live website, the agent must operate the site's own interface and return a verifiable answer. A capable multimodal large language model (LLM) is necessary for this, but not sufficient. The model's decisions reach the browser through the harness, the code between the model and the page. At every step, four things must go right: the model's reply must be parsed into the intended action, the action must take effect on the page, the result must be reported back accurately, and the model must be shown the information it needs. On real websites, many of the failures we observed occurred at one of these four stages rather than in the model's reasoning. A coordinate-space mismatch placed every click at 3/4 of its intended coordinates; actions on native dropdowns, inside iframes, and in text boxes failed silently; and self-generated chat-template tokens contaminated 4.9% of task episodes. WebFovea hardens each stage and surrounds the loop with guardrails that keep the agent within the rules and its budget. The four-stage view does not depend on the model, although some individual fixes do. Because we used the same model in all four submissions, the rise of our official hidden-set score from 31.0 to 57.0 reflects changes to the harness, up to run-to-run variance on live sites. We describe the design, the evidence for each component (including negative results), a failure analysis, the limitations, and a roadmap that includes routing different steps to different models.

</details>


### [155] [Zephon: Elastic Determinism for Online, Stateful Foundation Model Data Loading Pipelines](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.03087)
*Maximilian Böther,Josh Wills,Ties Robroek,Sonnet Xu,Paul Burstein,Daniel Zayas,Cody Blakeney,Siddharth Joshi,Haoli Yin,Rishabh Adiga,Haakon Mongstad,Luke Merrick,Pratyush Maini,Ari Morcos,Matthew Leavitt,Ana Klimovic,Bogdan Gaza*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: Zephon 是首个为在线、有状态的 n-to-m 基础模型数据加载流水线同时提供弹性确定性（elastic determinism）和高效检查点恢复的数据加载器。它通过"lane"抽象将全局数据流划分为拓扑独立的逻辑子流，使用累加器（accumulator）将有状态的排序决策序列化在单线程中，同时允许无状态变换在可互换的执行后端（runner）上并行，并通过每偏移贡献者跟踪（per-offset contributor tracking）实现有界成本的检查点恢复。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 基础模型开发中，研究者依赖昂贵的消融实验来隔离参数变更的影响。然而现代数据流水线包含分词、打包、混样等有状态的 n-to-m 操作，破坏了样本索引性。同时，GPU 资源稀缺导致训练常在动态变化的拓扑上运行。现有的 tf.data、Cedar、Grain、Mosaic Streaming 等数据加载器要么仅支持可索引的 1-to-1 流水线，要么不能同时保证跨拓扑变化的确定性输出。离线物化数据集的方案在存储和计算上代价高昂，对视频等模态甚至不可行。因此亟需一个支持在线、有状态流水线并同时提供弹性确定性和高效恢复的数据加载系统。

Method: Zephon 的核心设计包含三个关键机制：(1) Lane 抽象：将全局训练流划分为固定数量的拓扑独立 lane，每个 lane 维护独立的算子状态和数据流，推广了 Mosaic Streaming 的 canonical node 概念到非可索引、有状态流水线；(2) Accumulator + Pump 模式：将每个算子分为有状态的累加器（单线程执行排序决策）和无状态的工作线程（通过 runner 在进程或线程后端上并行执行），通过序列号和重排序缓冲区保证确定性输出；(3) Per-offset contributor tracking + Flush sentinel：为非单调流水线（如打包）记录每条记录的源贡献者引用，使用墓碑标记完成的偏移，并通过每 K 个 chunk 注入 flush 哨兵重置累加器状态，使段（segment）独立，从而实现有界成本的检查点恢复（不随训练进度增长）。此外还设计了在进程 runner 中通过共享内存合并（SHM coalescing）减少 IPC 开销。

Result: 在吞吐量方面：文本数据上 Zephon 与最优基线 Grain 可比；VLM 数据上过程 runner 达到 16 k 样本/秒（比最佳基线高 2.7 倍），线程 runner 在 Python 3.14t（GIL 移除）下达到 59 k 样本/秒。在 VLM 完整流水线中，Zephon 与 Grain 实现了相当的近线性缩放（DOP 32 时 29.9k vs 29.8k utps）。在检查点方面：检查点大小几乎恒定（100/1k/10k 步分别为 2.61/2.92/2.97 MiB），恢复时间也几乎恒定（100/1k/10k 步分别为 48.5/70.2/73.8 秒），反压限制了预读量。在弹性确定性方面：训练 1B 模型 20B token，使用 Zephon 时不同 GPU 数量（8/16/32/64）下的 DCLM Core v1 分数差异仅 0.061pp、FineWeb 仅 0.007pp（低于 0.2pp 的有意义差异阈值）；不使用时分别为 0.922pp 和 0.555pp。VLM 训练中，Zephon 的平均绝对两两差异比非确定性方案低 5.84 倍。各项保证相对一个既未去不能保证确定性和检查点的负载器额外开销仅 16%（文本）和 22%（VLM）。

Conclusion: Zephon 是首个为在线、有状态 n-to-m 基础模型数据流水线同时提供弹性确定性和高效恢复的加载器。它通过序列化排序决策、并行化无状态工作以及仅检查点化有界在飞状态，将数据加载从消融实验的混淆变量转变为可靠的基础设施，使训练结果真正反映所改变的参数而非 GPU 拓扑的偶然性，从而支持更可靠的消融研究并降低大规模基础模型开发的算力开销。Zephon 已开源，约 2 万行代码，提供构建器模式的组合接口。

Abstract: Deterministic data loading is important for foundation model development: model researchers need confidence that differences they observe across costly ablations are caused by the parameter they changed rather than non-determinism in the training data sequence. The data loader must provide elastic determinism, i.e., a deterministic sequence of global training data batches despite changes to the GPU topology across runs (e.g., due to GPU scarcity), frequent checkpoint-resume cycles, and different data processing execution backends. Achieving this is difficult because modern foundation model data pipelines tokenize, pack, and mix samples online, introducing stateful n-to-m transformations that break sample indexing. Existing data loaders largely assume indexable 1-to-1 pipelines, and the common workaround of offline materialization is expensive and, for some modalities such as video, infeasible. We present Zephon, a data loader for foundation models that supports online, stateful pipelines while providing elastic determinism and efficient resumption from checkpoints. It partitions the global stream into topology-independent lanes, serializes ordering decisions while parallelizing stateless work on interchangeable backends, and checkpoints only bounded in-flight state so recovery cost does not grow with training progress. We evaluate Zephon on text and vision-language workloads and show that it achieves competitive throughput while providing a combination of guarantees that no existing loader offers for online, stateful pipelines.

</details>


### [156] [ULTRADISCOVERY: Abductive Exploration in an Interconnected, Epistemically Open Universe](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.03092)
*Weihan Li,Tianshi Zheng,Yangqiu Song,Ginny Y. Wong,Simon See*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文介绍ULTRADISCOVERY基准测试，该测试通过2×2实验设计（表征开放/公开、证据分散/对齐）分离科学发现中的“构建表征”和“组合证据”两大难题，发现现有AI模型在跨域干预预测中无法构建新表征，导致开放表征情境下表现严重不足。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 科学发现常常始于零散线索，需要构建新的表征来解释未知现象，并跨上下文组合相互关联的证据。现有基准测试无法独立区分和控制这两种能力，因此难以诊断AI系统在科学发现中的真实瓶颈所在。

Method: 构建ULTRADISCOVERY交互式环境，包含5个领域，通过2×2因子设计独立控制表征开放性（开放/公开）和证据分布（分散/对齐），固定潜在动力学；测试11个模型以及两个扩展多领域的vendor-harness系统，评估其在未见跨域干预下的预测能力。

Result: 在表征开放条件下，11个模型常常撤回被教授的公理，但没有任何模型引入未观察实体或重写变量；公开表征使干预请求增加3倍并多产生约18个发现中的1个，对齐证据的作用较小；扩展系统在更多领域进行发现，其中一个能在开放情境下重写变量；在200次付费动作预算内无系统做出精确预测，更大预算下仅在两种辅助条件下各出现1次精确预测，所有开放情境下的预测均不精确。

Conclusion: 科学发现的瓶颈在于从积累证据到将其组合为可迁移表征的这一步骤；现有模型在需要构建新表征的开放情境下能力严重不足，仅靠积累证据无法完成跨域科学推理。

Abstract: Scientific discovery often begins when scattered clues call for a new way of describing the world. Such abductive exploration can require constructing the representation in which an explanation is stated, when the world is epistemically open, and composing evidence scattered across contexts, when it is structurally interconnected. Existing benchmarks rarely separate these two demands or control them independently. We introduce ULTRADISCOVERY, an interactive world of five domains in which an agent revises an initially successful theory and predicts the outcome of an unseen cross-domain intervention. A $2 \times 2$ design leaves the representation open or discloses it, and leaves the evidence distributed or aligns it, with the latent dynamics fixed. With the representation open, agents across eleven models often retract the axiom they were taught, and none introduces the unobserved entity or rewrites the variables that a replacement requires. Disclosure triples intervention requests and adds about one of the eighteen findings the world affords, and alignment adds less. Two vendor-harness systems carry discovery into more domains, and one of them rewrites the variables in Open episodes. No system makes the exact prediction within 200 paid actions. At larger budgets one exact prediction appears with both aids, while every Open episode remains inexact. The results locate the difficulty in the step from accumulating evidence to composing it into a representation that transfers.

</details>


### [157] [How to Find and Reuse Policies for Continuous Adaptation in Lifelong Reinforcement Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.03119)
*Saptarshi Nath,Inish M. D'Souza,Antonio Carta,Soheil Kolouri,Andrea Soltoggio*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: AMSC提出了一种基于非参数Wasserstein任务嵌入的自适应掩码选择与组合方法,通过在线经验估计任务相似度,选择并加权相关历史策略以促进终身强化学习中的知识迁移,在CT-graph和MiniGrid上表现优异,但在更复杂的Continual World上需要进一步调整。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在终身强化学习中,仅保留先前学习的策略不足以有效迁移到新任务,因为有用的知识可能分布在多个先前策略中,且其相关性会随学习者获得经验而变化。核心假设是任务相似性可作为持续学习设置中选择和组合先前学习策略的有效标准。

Method: AMSC(Adaptive Mask Selection and Composition)通过在线经验进行任务相似度估计:1)使用非参数Wasserstein任务嵌入从状态-动作-奖励函数样本中提取任务表示;3)使用相似度得分的z-score归一化sparsemax来推导可变大小的支持集;4)周期性地选择和加权策略,以形成学习新任务时的先验知识。

Result: 在CT-graph和MiniGrid基准测试中,AMSC实现了比模块化组合基线更高的平均性能和前向迁移,且无遗忘现象;在Continual World上的结果表明识别相关先验知识并确定其特定层组合可能需要额外的特定层调整。消融实验表明选择相关源和决定重用强度是收益的关键。成对迁移的独立测量与任务嵌入相似度正相关。

Conclusion: 研究结果表明任务相似性可以作为终身强化学习中选择和加权特定知识以供重用的有效标准,验证了基于任务嵌入相似度进行策略选择和组合的可行性。

Abstract: In lifelong reinforcement learning, retaining previously learned policies is not sufficient for effective transfer to a new task. Useful knowledge may be distributed across several prior policies, and its relevance may change as the learner acquires experience. One hypothesis is that task similarity can be effectively used in a continual learning setting to find and combine previously learned policies. To test it, Adaptive Mask Selection and Composition (AMSC) is designed to estimate similarity from online experience via non-parametric Wasserstein task embeddings from state-action-reward samples. The z-score-normalized sparsemax of the similarity scores are used to derive a variable-size support to periodically choose and weight policies to form a prior when learning a new task. On CT-graph and MiniGrid, AMSC achieves higher mean performance and forward transfer than the evaluated modular composition baselines while exhibiting no forgetting. Results on Continual World suggest that identifying relevant prior knowledge and determining its layer-specific composition may require additional layer-specific tuning. Ablations show that selecting relevant sources and determining how strongly to reuse them are central to these gains. Independently measured pairwise transfer is also positively associated with task-embedding similarity. These results indicate that task similarity can be an effective criterion to select and weight specific knowledge for reuse in lifelong reinforcement learning.

</details>


### [158] [D2K-Bench: Can LLM Agents Turn Expert Designs into Efficient GPU Kernels?](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.03226)
*Daifeng Li,Huiqiang Jiang,Chengruidong Zhang,Wei Wu,Xudong Guo,Jianhong Tu,Jianwei Zhang,Binhang Yuan,Dayiheng Liu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: D2K-Bench 是一个面向 LLM 智能体的诊断性基准测试，包含 26 个 GPU 内核任务和 85 个工作负载，通过三级分层（L1 算法洞察、L2 数据流设计、L3 低层优化技巧）的专家设计指导，评估智能体能否将专家设计有效转化为高效 GPU 内核实现，并在 NVIDIA B200 GPU 上对五个模型进行成对（有/无指导）对比实验。结果显示专家设计指导显著提升正确性（93.1%→98.5%）和性能（S_perf 从 1.46 提升至 1.95），但仍存在未实现的设计属性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有 LLM 智能体生成的 GPU 内核与专家实现之间存在性能差距，但仅靠运行时间无法揭示差距源于设计发现的不足还是实现能力的不足。该论文旨在提供一个诊断性基准，将性能比较与设计发现和实现的结构化评估相结合，以明确专家设计指导的效益与局限。

Method: 构建 D2K-Bench 基准（26 任务/85 工作负载），组织专家设计指导为三级层次结构（L1 算法洞察、L2 数据流设计、L3 低层优化技巧），并记录跨层级依赖。采用成对评估协议：有/无专家指导的智能体在同一任务描述、工作负载、工具、硬件和 350 轮预算下运行。使用 Qwen3.8-Max 作为 LLM 法官，独立评估智能体的设计提案（JS_design）和实现代码（JS_impl），对 L1/L2/L3 各层打分（0-100）。通过 Performance Score（S_perf，几何均值加速比）和阈值加速率（fast_p）进行客观度量。在 NVIDIA B200 GPU 上对五个模型（GPT-6-Astra、Claude-Opus-4.8、GPT-5.6-Sol、GLM-5.3、Kimi-K3）进行成对对比，并消融研究三级指导的累积效应。

Result: 专家设计指导在 130 个模型-任务对上使正确性从 93.1% 提升至 98.5%，所有 26 个任务的 Performance Score 从 1.46 提升至 1.95（+33.9%）。三个全正确模型（GPT-6-Astra、Claude-Opus-4.8、GPT-5.6-Sol）的几何均值加速比从 1.69× 提升至 2.49×。五个模型的平均实现得分从 57 提升至 70（满分 100）。LLM 法官评分与性能排序一致，且指导提升法官得分。累积指导分析显示三级均有增益，L1 通常产生最大增量。Muon 正交化案例研究详细展示法官评分与代码/设计引用的一致性。专家实现 Performance Score 为 2.33，表明指导后智能体仍落后于专家。

Conclusion: D2K-Bench 通过将三级专家设计指导、成对性能比较和独立设计/实现的结构化评估相结合，有效诊断了 LLM 智能体在 GPU 内核生成中的设计转化能力。研究证实专家设计指导对正确性和性能均有显著价值，但智能体在指导后仍存在未实现的设计属性，表明设计发现与实现之间存在持续差距。该基准为改进自动化内核开发提供了明确的诊断工具。

Abstract: GPU kernels generated by large language model (LLM) agents can remain less efficient than expert implementations, but runtime alone does not reveal how the gap relates to design discovery and implementation. We introduce D2K-Bench, a diagnostic benchmark of 26 tasks and 85 workloads that measures how effectively agents translate expert design guidance into efficient GPU kernels. The guidance covers L1: high-level algorithmic insights, L2: dataflow design, and L3: low-level optimization tricks, including dependencies among these levels. Pairwise runs with and without guidance share task descriptions, workloads, tools, hardware, and a 350-turn budget. Complementary assessments examine independently proposed designs and the design properties implemented in generated code. Across five models on NVIDIA B200 GPUs, guidance raises correctness over 130 model-task pairs from 93.1% to 98.5% and increases the Performance Score over all 26 tasks from 1.46 to 1.95. For the three frontier models with correct submissions on all 26 tasks in both runs (GPT-6-Astra, Claude-Opus-4.8, and GPT-5.6-Sol), geometric mean speedup increases from $1.69\times$ to $2.49\times$. Across all five models, the mean combined implementation score increases from 57 to 70 out of 100. These results show the value of expert design guidance while identifying design properties that remain unimplemented.

</details>


### [159] [Mapping and Advancing the Scalability-Accuracy Frontier of Nonlinear Causal Discovery](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.03258)
*Hendrik Suhr,Sascha Xu,Jilles Vreeken*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该论文系统性地比较了四类可扩展非线性因果发现方法（可微分结构学习、摊销结构学习、得分匹配、组合搜索）在精度-运行时间权衡上的表现，识别出组合搜索中重复的局部非线性评分是主要瓶颈，并提出基于样条的预编译充分统计量方法SPADE，将组合搜索的可扩展性提升数个数量级。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 非线性因果发现方法众多（可微分、摊销、得分匹配、组合搜索），但它们在精度与运行时间之间的权衡关系缺乏系统性理解，限制了该领域对方法瓶颈的诊断和进一步发展。

Method: 1) 在受控的非线性加性噪声模型基准上，对四类方法的代表算法（SDCD、CauScale、DAS、Topic等）进行特征维度d和样本量n两个维度的扩展性-精度对比实验；2) 提出SPADE方法，使用固定基样条模型和BIC型评分，通过一次性预编译全局样条设计的Gram矩阵G=B^T B和特征-响应交叉矩阵H=B^T Y，在组合搜索过程中复用缓存充分统计量，代替重复的非线性拟合；3) 提供Gaussian（Spade-Gauss）和Histogram（Spade-Hist）两种残差似然变体，并集成到TOPIC的拓扑序搜索框架中。

Result: 实验揭示了互补的瓶颈：可微分和摊销方法扩展性好但精度不足；得分匹配在低维精确但随特征数快速退化；组合搜索精度高但受重复局部评分拖慢。SPADE将Topic在d=800时的运行时间从12.5小时降至99.3秒（456倍加速），样本缩放中达2708倍加速；可求解100变量/160K样本（秒级）和1600变量/2.5K样本（分钟级）的问题。在96种综合设置下，Spade-Hist平均F1=0.748（Topic为0.616），平均运行时间1.24秒（Topic为75.35秒）。在Causal Chamber真实基准上F1=0.50，运行时间0.97秒（SDCD为520秒达到0.49 F1）。复杂度从O(nd^3)降至O(nd^2+d^3)（有界入度假设下，Gaussian变体）。

Conclusion: SPADE通过样条充分统计量的预编译与复用，在保持组合搜索高结构精度的同时，将可扩展性推进数个数量级，重新定义了组合搜索在实际问题中的可行规模；该工作强调应沿完整的精度-运行时间前沿评估可扩展因果发现方法。

Abstract: Scalable nonlinear causal discovery requires methods that combine flexible mechanism estimators with efficient search over large graph spaces. Several algorithmic families have been proposed to address this challenge, yet their accuracy-runtime trade-offs remain poorly understood. We empirically compare the four major approaches: differentiable structure learning, amortized structure learning, score-matching, and combinatorial search. Our results reveal complementary bottlenecks: differentiable and amortized methods scale well but exhibit an accuracy gap, score-matching methods can be accurate in low dimensions but degrade quickly for increasing feature sizes, and combinatorial methods remain accurate but are slowed by repeated and redundant local scoring. Motivated by this bottleneck, we develop SPADE, a spline-based score-evaluation scheme that compiles sufficient statistics once and reuses them throughout combinatorial search. Under bounded indegree, its Gaussian variant reduces algorithmic complexity from O(nd^3) to O(nd^2+d^3). Empirically, SPADE shifts the observed scalability-accuracy frontier by orders of magnitude: it solves 100-variable problems with 160K samples in seconds and 1600-variable problems with 2.5K samples in minutes, while retaining high structural accuracy across synthetic and real-world benchmarks. These results reveal a substantial shift in the practical scale of combinatorial search and highlight the importance of evaluating scalable causal-discovery methods along the full accuracy-runtime frontier.

</details>


### [160] [SPEAR: A Spectral-Disentangled MoE Neural Operator with Knowledge-Guided Expert Aggregation for Large-Scale PDE Pretraining](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.03265)
*Dengdi Sun,Xiaoya Zhou,Xiao Wang,Wanli Lyu,Jin Tang,Bin Luo*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出SPEAR，一种基于频谱解耦的MoE神经算子，通过知识引导的专家聚合策略解决大规模PDE预训练中异构动态的知识干扰和专家冗余问题，在12个PDE数据集上实现高效预训练与迁移。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有PDE基础模型存在两大挑战：(1)频谱耦合问题——椭圆、双曲、抛物等不同类型PDE的高低频动力学差异显著，而Fourier类神经算子（如AFNO）将所有频率耦合在共享参数中，导致梯度干扰；(2)MoE架构的专家冗余——现有专家合并方法基于路由统计而非任务语义，无法准确识别学习相似物理模式的专家。两者的联系在于：低频动力学跨PDE可共享，高频模式则PDE特异。

Method: 方法包含两大核心创新：
1) **频谱解耦架构**：低频分支采用AFNO作为共享专家建模全局动力学；高频分支通过硬高通滤波器提取局部精细结构，输入到低秩适配器型MoE模块（1个基础专家+12个非共享专家，Top-2路由）。非共享专家共享深度可分离卷积（DSC）骨干，通过LoRA风格的下投影-上投影适配器（𝐁ᵢ和𝐀ᵢ）实现专家特化，𝐀ᵢ初始化为零以稳定训练。共享与特化输出经可学习系数λ融合。
2) **知识引导的专家聚合策略**：通过双线性投影Sᴱ_raw = RᵀSᴅR将数据集物理知识矩阵（基于微调前后参数差Δv的余弦相似度）与数据集-专家偏好矩阵R融合得到专家相似度矩阵Sᴱ；采用阈值约束的平均链接层次聚类合并专家，按全局路由频率加权聚合适配器参数（θ̄ₖ = Σωᵢθᵢ）。
损失函数：L2RE重建损失 + 负载均衡损失（λ₁=0.001）+ 正交损失（λ₂从0.1衰减至0）。

Result: 在12个PDE数据集的实验结果：
- **预训练阶段**（11M参数）：在PDEBench的6个任务中5个最优，6个PDEBench子任务平均L2RE为0.0246，优于DPOT(0.0285)、NESTOR(0.0270)等；
- **微调阶段**（FT500）：在6个任务中最佳，FNO-ν(1e-5)达到0.0543；
- **专家合并**：12个专家压缩至6个（50%减少），PDEArena NS-cond的L2RE从0.291降至0.281，多数任务保持或提升精度；对比方法OPCM性能下降数十至数百倍，SMoE性能略低；
- **新数据集划分**：在6个任务中4个最优；
- **未见PDE迁移**：Wave-Layer L2RE=0.0085，Wave-Gauss=0.0066，相对最佳基线分别提升10.5%和12.0%；
- **消融实验**：高频分支贡献最大（+0.0152），MoE模块+0.0008，负载均衡和正交损失各+0.0004；
- **专家数量消融**：12个非共享专家最优。

Conclusion: SPEAR通过"频谱解耦实现专业化，聚合实现精炼"的两阶段策略，有效解决了PDE基础模型中的知识干扰和专家冗余问题，实现了参数效率与泛化性能的平衡，为大规模PDE预训练提供了可扩展解决方案。其核心贡献在于：基于频率特性区分共享知识与PDE特异模式，以及基于物理语义而非路由行为进行专家合并。

Abstract: Large-scale pre-training has improved the generalization of neural operators across diverse PDEs. However, existing PDE foundation models still struggle with heterogeneous dynamics, where shared representations may cause knowledge interference, while mixture-of-experts (MoE) architectures suffer from increasing expert redundancy. We propose SPEAR, a spectral-disentangled MoE neural operator with knowledge-guided expert aggregation for large-scale PDE pre-training. SPEAR decouples latent features into low- and high-frequency components, enabling shared modeling of transferable dynamics and specialized learning of PDE-specific patterns. To address expert redundancy, we design a knowledge-guided expert aggregation strategy that measures expert similarity from dataset-specific learned knowledge and routing preferences, enabling the identification and consolidation of similar experts. Experiments on twelve PDE datasets and multiple downstream benchmarks demonstrate superior performance in pre-training, fine-tuning, and transfer learning. Furthermore, our aggregation strategy reduces the number of experts by 50\% while maintaining or improving prediction accuracy, achieving a balance between model efficiency and generalization for PDE foundation models.

</details>


### [161] [Training-Loss Guarantees for Muon with Finite-Step Newton--Schulz Orthogonalization](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.03306)
*Amartya Roy,Souvik Chakraborty*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文为带有限步牛顿正负化（Step-Morthogonalized）的动量优化器（Muon）建立了有限时间训练损失保证。针对充分宽的两层 ReLU 网络（全批量训练，固定随机输出权重，正定极限 NTK），证明 Muon 以高概率在 O((1−μ)⁻¹ε⁻¹/²) 步内将经验平方损失降至任意目标 ε>0，其中 μ 为动量参数。所需学习率正比于 (1−μ)√ε，所需宽度与目标精度和动量均无关。关键机制在于：调优的有限步 Newton–Schulz 映射保持与动量缓冲的对齐性并约束谱范数，而初始化附近的梯度变化控制使该对齐性传递给当前梯度。数值实验在远低于理论充分宽度的规模下验证了这些机制。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有 Muon 收敛分析要么假设精确正交化，要么分析经典 Newton–Schulz 多项式，且仅给出平稳性保证。因此 Muon 实际使用的五步调优 Newton–Schulz 迭代保留了哪些性质、是否足以达到预设训练损失，这些问题仍未解决。本文旨在弥合 Muon 实际构造与神经网络训练损失保证之间的差距。

Method: 分析对象为充分宽两层 ReLU 网络的全批量 Muon 训练（仅训练第一层权重）。核心方法是：(1) 识别 Newton–Schulz 映射的两个充分性质——与输入缓冲的对齐性 κx≤Φ(x) 和输出谱范数上界 Φ(x)≤M，并证明 Muon 调优系数满足 κ=2/3、M=5/4；(2) 通过轨迹包含性论证（利用更新范数和迭代预算）建立初始化邻域内的均匀 NTK 和线性化余项控制；(3) 证明梯度-更新对齐引理（Lemma 3.2），将缓冲对齐性通过动量累积的控制转移到当前梯度；(4) 推导单步残差下降引理（Lemma 3.3），并通过求和获得有限时间击中时间保证。证明基于初始化事件 ℰ（控制初始残差、NTK 集中性、门翻转计数），概率至少 1−δ。

Result: 主要定理（Theorem 3.1）：对于 μ∈[0,1)，若宽度 m=Ω(n⁵/(λ₀⁴δ³))，学习率 η=(1−μ)κ√(λ₀ε)/(8M²nα)，迭代预算 T=⌈128M²nR₀/((1−μ)κ²λ₀√ε)⌉，则以高概率 min_{0≤t≤T} L(W_t)≤ε。所需宽度独立于目标精度 ε 和动量 μ。实验在宽度 64–2000（远低于充分条件 m≳2×10²⁷）下进行：30 次运行全部达到目标 10⁻²；梯度-更新对齐始终超过参考值 1/3（最低 0.695）；核特征值比 K_t 始终高于 1/2（最低 0.826）；归一化位移最大仅 1.67×10⁻³ R_B。此外，调优五步映射在所有 59 个共享缓冲上满足 a≥2/3、s≤5/4 的分析参考。

Conclusion: 本文证明了带五步调优 Newton–Schulz 正交化的 Muon 优化器的有限时间训练损失保证，是首个同时处理动量累积和调优有限步正交化的神经网络训练保证。证明仅依赖 Newton–Schulz 映射的两个性质（对齐性和谱范数界），无需近似精确极因子。ε⁻¹/² 依赖性源于固定学习率下更新不会随梯度缩小（与梯度下降的线性速率不同），且证明未表明动量能加速 Muon。实验支持理论机制在远低于理论充分宽度的规模下成立。未来工作方向包括：(i) 更紧的宽度和动量需求、是否能在 Muon 中实现加速；(ii) 超越近初始化区域的分析；(iii) 小批量梯度和有限精度算术；(iv) 更深网络和两层联合训练。

Abstract: Existing convergence analyses of Muon either assume exact orthogonalization or analyze classical Newton--Schulz polynomials, and guarantee only stationarity, so it is unresolved what Muon's five tuned Newton--Schulz steps preserve and whether that suffices to reach a prescribed neural-network training loss. We establish a finite-time training guarantee that accounts for both momentum accumulation before orthogonalization and the tuned finite-step update. For full-batch training of a sufficiently wide two-layer ReLU network with fixed random output weights and a positive-definite limiting neural tangent kernel, we prove that Muon reaches any target empirical squared loss $\varepsilon>0$ with high probability over initialization. For every momentum parameter $\mu\in[0,1)$, a target-dependent constant learning rate proportional to $(1-\mu)\sqrt{\varepsilon}$ yields a hitting-time bound of $O((1-\mu)^{-1}\varepsilon^{-1/2})$, with other problem parameters fixed. The sufficient width is independent of both target accuracy and momentum. The analysis shows that the tuned Newton--Schulz map preserves alignment with the momentum buffer while bounding the update's spectral norm. Control of gradient variation near initialization transfers this alignment to the current gradient, ensuring descent until the target is reached without requiring exact orthogonalization. Numerical experiments support these mechanisms at widths below the sufficient theoretical threshold: gradient-update alignment remains above the analytical reference, and all 30 runs across six widths and five student initializations on a fixed teacher-student dataset reach the target loss while maintaining kernel positivity.

</details>


### [162] [Cordial Learning: Distributed Training with Correlated Data](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.03330)
*Sarah Shitrit,Ilai Bistritz*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出"友善学习"（Cordial Learning, CL），一种面向数据相关智能体的分布式训练范式。各智能体仅共享低维嵌入输出而非原始数据，通过协调层提取有用信息。在线性模型下证明了两时间尺度SGD能以概率1收敛到全局最优解，即使全局目标函数是非凸的。实验在多位数MNIST上验证了深度网络设置下方法的有效性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 当多个ML智能体共享同一环境时，它们的数据（输入和标签）天然相关。现有联邦学习方法假设各设备数据独立同分布，忽略了这种相关性结构，导致性能不佳；而集中式方法因隐私和通信开销不可行。需要一种新范式让分布式智能体既保持隐私又能利用数据相关性。

Method: 提出Cordial Learning算法：每个智能体i拥有嵌入模型M_i和协调层{Λ_j^i}，仅向其他智能体发送低维嵌入输出M_i·X_i而非原始数据。使用两时间尺度SGD更新参数，其中协调层学习速率慢于嵌入层。为消除偏差，引入残差化局部变量Z_j^i = X_j - Cov(X_j,X_i)X_i，并通过两个独立批次估计协方差以保证梯度无偏。将问题建模为合作博弈，证明在非凸全局目标下仍能收敛到全局最优。

Result: 线性模型仿真（N=8,16,32，高斯和拉普拉斯输入）：20,000次迭代后，友善学习损失仅为孤立智能体损失的0.36%-1.4%，所有600次运行均优于孤立训练。多位数字MNIST实验（Pairwise-10数据集，N=2,4,6）：测试损失降低数个数量级，准确率从0.88-0.91提升至0.94-1.000，接近集中式网络性能。共因数据集（p=0.8,0.6）：在P≥100时几乎所有设置均优于孤立训练。理论证明两时间尺度SGD以概率1收敛到全局最优解。

Conclusion: Cordial Learning是首个针对数据相关分布式学习的通用框架，在非凸目标下仍具有全局最优收敛保证。该方法在保持低通信开销的同时显著优于孤立训练，在多位数字MNIST等结构化任务上接近集中式性能。开放问题包括收敛速率分析、在线遗憾界以及基于接收方损失的自适应信息压缩。

Abstract: We consider a distributed learning task with agents that have correlated data. Specifically, the label of an agent depends on the input of other agents for the same sample, and these inputs are also correlated. Correlated data is the reality when agents share the same environment. Existing decentralized methods, such as federated learning, ignore the structure of the problem and perform poorly on correlated data. On the other hand, centralized approaches are infeasible due to privacy and communication constraints. We introduce cordial (correlated and distributed) learning to address this gap by sharing only low-dimensional outputs between the agents while training local models to extract informative signals from peers. This distributed learning induces a game in which the loss function of each agent depends on the models of others. Assuming a linear model, we prove that cordial learning converges with probability one to a globally optimal solution, despite the nonconvex global objective. Experiments on structured multi-digit MNIST tasks demonstrate that cordial learning remains highly effective even in highly nonlinear settings.

</details>


### [163] [Follow the Winners: Conservative Policy Improvement with the Cross-Entropy Method for Critic-Free RFT](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.03361)
*Joery Ariën de Vries,Neil David Lawrence,Zhenwen Dai*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出Follow the Winners (FTW)，一种基于交叉熵方法的critic-free策略学习算法，用于智能体大语言模型的强化学习微调。它通过replay buffer上的ordinal filter替代group rollouts，在Sokoban和Search-R1基准上与GRPO和PPO表现相当，但无需value model或环境复制。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有的GRPO式critic-free RFT方法依赖重复rollout计算组基线，在状态化环境（如live services、安全沙箱）中既不切实际，又因长horizon稀疏验证轨迹的噪声而引发aggressive update entrenchment问题。需要一种不依赖critic model或group rollouts的保守更新策略学习算法。

Method: 1) 扩展Control-as-Inference框架，将inference从单条轨迹扩展到轨迹批次，使用ordinal likelihood（Plackett-Luce或多分类）进行条件化；2) 通过batch-level ELBO推导出交叉熵方法式的采样-投影方案；4) 用top-K over C的replay buffer ordinal filter替代全局排序，通过超几何分布的组合倾斜分布实现poly集中度提升；3) 推导各算法风险特征——GRPO为风险中性，DPO和FTW有界risk-seeking，attractor由K/C控制。

Result: 在3个诊断bandit问题（σ-trap、Pareto-α、state-aliasing）上验证理论预测：在σ-trap中GRPO仅在降低lr时稳定，FTW/DPO在Pareto重尾下稳定；在state-aliasing中FTW的L1距离低于GRPO和DPO。在Brax HalfCheetah上FTW-K4-C64最终达到与SAC相当的return且seed方差更紧。在LLM post-training中，Sokoban上FTW-K1/K2与GRPO/PPO聚类，性能相当但无需PPO的value model或GRPO的重复rollout；FTW-K3因Sokoban二元回报下的有限样本效应崩溃。Search-R1上FTW-K1-C4达到35.46%±0.15%的exact-match accuracy，匹配已发布的PPO(32.5%)和GRPO(33.6%)基线。线性contextual bandit案例研究表明FTW在epistemic不确定性下保持更紧的信念宽度和预测熵。

Conclusion: FTW提供了一种可行的trade-off，用CPU memory替代value model或group rollouts需求，在agentic LLM post-training中与现有RFT方法性能相当但资源需求更少。将GRPO、DPO和FTW统一在Control-as-Inference框架下，识别GRPO为risk-neutral、FTW/DPO为有界risk-seeking，为critic-free RFT算法设计提供了理论轴线。限制：风险偏移在aleatoric噪声下会偏离均值最优策略；IIA假设需要总序性，不适用于非传递性设置；replay buffer带来内存开销。

Abstract: Critic-free reinforcement fine-tuning (RFT) for agentic large language models is often done through GRPO-style methods, which compute a group baseline over repeated rollouts to reduce target variance. However, this setup is ill-suited to agents acting in stateful environments such as live services or security sandboxes, where repeated rollouts are impractical to obtain and aggressive updates entrench the noise of long, sparsely verified trajectories. We propose \textit{Follow the Winners} (FTW), a critic-free policy-learning algorithm that adapts the cross-entropy method to RFT, replacing group rollouts with an ordinal filter on replay-buffer samples that yields polynomial concentration in the order statistic of returns. We derive FTW through a control-as-inference lens, which also recovers GRPO and DPO as specific modelling choices, identifying GRPO as risk-neutral while DPO and FTW share a bounded risk-seeking offset that FTW controls. We identify this offset as an inherent trade-off of variance reduction through ordinal filters on samples, whereas a critic model induces a different trade-off between bias and variance. Scaled to agentic LLM post-training, FTW matches GRPO and PPO on Sokoban and Search-R1 baselines, showing a viable trade-off from a value model or group rollouts to CPU memory.

</details>


### [164] [Rethinking Epistemic Uncertainty in Node Classification through Information Growth](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.03418)
*Emma Meneghini,Francesco Ferrini,Bruno Lepri,Andrea Passerini,Veronica Lachi*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该论文针对图证据深度学习（EDL）在节点分类中认识不确定性评估的不足，建立了基于信息增长的统计框架，证明了现有EDL方法不是一致的认识不确定性预测器，并提出图自助集成（GB-Ens）作为替代方案。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有图EDL方法在固定图上定义认识不确定性原则（如特征支持、结构支持、邻域冲突），并通过OOD检测等下游任务评估，但不能直接测试认识不确定性随DGP信息增加而可约简的核心特性。此外，节点依赖性使得"更大图提供更多关于同一DGP信息"的假设并不天然成立，亟需一个用于节点分类的认识不确定性可约简性评估框架。

Method: 1) 建立信息增长实验协议：采用射影图DGP（projective graph DGP）确保嵌套图为同一过程的相干观测，定义包含单调性（monotonicity）与一致性（consistency）两个条件的认识预测器一致性准则；2) 统一图EDL目标并刻画其总体最优，证明其认识不确定性由超参数控制而非显式估计数据不确定性；3) 提出图自助集成（GB-Ens），结合B×S自助样本与随机种子的交叉设计，分离数据不确定性（EU_boot）和过程不确定性（EU_seed），并采用基于局部概率估计的图边自助法。

Result: 在指数衰减graphon和SBM graphon两类射影图DGP上的控制实验表明：1) 图EDL方法（GPN、GPN-LOP、CUQ-GNN等）的认识不确定性在信息增长下不收敛，AU对正则化参数λ高度敏感，证实其非一致性；2) GB-Ens（25×4设计）在N=500到10000范围内EU分别降低94%（GCN）、91%（APPNP）、61%（GAT），AU趋于稳定且接近预测器无关的估计，而标准深度图集成（G-Ens）无一致的EU收缩。GB-Ens与真实DGP重采样的二阶分布之间Wasserstein距离较小，APPNP约0.29、GCN约0.21，表明良好近似。

Conclusion: 认识不确定性应通过信息增长下的行为而非固定图原则或下游任务效用进行评估；图EDL模型因依赖超参数调控EU而非显式估计数据不确定性，一般不满足一致性准则；图自助集成通过同时建模两种认识不确定性来源（数据采样与训练过程），是经验支持的候选一致认识预测器家族，但理论一致性仍有待证明。

Abstract: Epistemic uncertainty should decrease as additional information about the data-generating process (DGP) becomes available to the predictor. Yet, existing graph evidential deep learning (EDL) methods for node classification typically construct epistemic uncertainty from graph-specific properties and evaluate it on downstream tasks such as out-of-distribution detection, which do not test its reducibility as information about the DGP increases. To make reducibility directly testable, we introduce a statistical framework for studying epistemic uncertainty under information growth. Our framework specifies an information-growth experimental protocol and a consistency criterion for epistemic predictors, while using projective graph DGPs to ensure that growing graphs, which in general need not provide increasing information about the same DGP, constitute coherent observations of the same underlying process. We show that EDL methods do not explicitly estimate data uncertainty arising from a single finite graph observation and instead regulate epistemic uncertainty through model hyperparameters, precluding consistency, as corroborated by controlled information-growth experiments. As an alternative, we propose graph bootstrap ensembles, capturing both data and procedural uncertainty through graph resampling and randomized training. Under the same experimental protocol, these ensembles exhibit epistemic uncertainty reduction beyond standard deep ensembles. These findings support bootstrap ensembles as candidate consistent epistemic predictors under information growth.

</details>


### [165] [OptiSelect: How does the Optimizer Shape Data Curriculum?](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.03432)
*Simin Fan,Alireza Abdollahpoorrostam,Martin Jaggi*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文形式化了 OptiSelect 范式，系统研究优化器如何影响在线数据选择。理论证明选择增益由效用分数的可辨识度（discriminability）决定，并揭示 Lion（符号崩溃）和 Muon（径向崩溃）的预处理器会限制选择增益，而 AdamW/Sophia 的对角自适应几何则具备严格更优的上界。同时推导了候选过采样最优比 λ*=2。在 124M/720M 模型上的预训练实验验证了理论：AdamW 的对角自适应评分几何是最优的，且选择增益在数据改写技术下依然保持。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有 LLM 预训练中，数据选择策略与优化器设计是独立进行的：数据流水线通常忽略优化器，而优化器基准测试则使用均匀采样。本文认为优化器的预处理器会重塑原始梯度，从而也定义了数据效用评分，几何形状应该被共同设计。核心问题是：优化器如何与在线数据选择相互作用，哪些优化几何能真正从中受益？

Method: 1) 形式化 OptiSelect 训练范式：每步从 λB 候选中采样 B 个，按优化器感知的边际效用 U(z,t) 选择；2) 在五种优化器（AdamW、AdEMAMix、Sophia、Lion、Muon）下推导冻结状态评分算子 O_t；3) 理论：高斯候选模型下推导选择增益原理 G_t = c_q · σ_U(t)（定理1），证明 Lion 的精确符号评分呈指数崩溃（定理2），AdamW/Sophia 对角自适应具备放大增益（定理3），Muon 极坐标导数有径向不变性（定理4）；4) 引理1证明最优候选倍数 λ*=2；5) 在 124M/720M Llama 模型上 FineWeb-HQ 预训练评估，使用 ARC/HSwag/PIQA/SciQ 五个下游任务混合作为选择代理。

Result: 1) 定理1-4给出不同优化几何的可辨识度排序：AdamW/Sophia > SGD = Lion(线性化) ≥ Lion(精确)；2) 引理1解析推导最优 λ*=2，与候选倍数扫描实验吻合；3) 实验显示 AdamW、AdEMAMix、Sophia 在 OptiSelect 下下游损失稳定改善（124M：Δ=-0.119/-0.135/-0.028；720M：Δ=-0.104/-0.096/-0.023），Lion/D-Muon 增益不显著或为负；4) 评分几何消融显示 AdamW 对角算子是 D-Muon 优化器下最优评分几何，与匹配几何相悖；5) OptiSelect 在 0%/50%/100% 数据改写混合下均保持增益；6) OptiSelect 在等应用 token 下胜出，在等读取 token（2x开销）下落后。

Conclusion: 优化器不仅是优化算法，也是课程设计者：AdamW 的方差归一化构建偏向稀有坐标大梯度候选的课程，Muon 的矩阵符号几何构建极坐标切向课程，忽略仅改变奇异值的候选。本文为优化器与数据选择的协同设计提供了理论基础和实验依据，建议未来工作按"应用 token"与"读取 token"两种匹配方式均报告选择方法性能。

Abstract: Online data selection has demonstrated substantial efficiency gains for LLM pretraining by training on the most valuable candidates within each batch. Since a candidate's value is realized through its effective model update, principled selection should account for the optimizer step, which reshapes the raw gradient before it updates model parameters. We formalize this optimizer-aware selection paradigm as OptiSelect and present the first systematic study of how the optimizer shapes data selection. Our theory establishes a selection gain principle in which the advantage of online selection is governed by the discriminability of the optimizer-induced utility scores. We prove that sign-based and polar-tangential preconditioners of Lion and Muon would suffer from a discriminability collapse which caps attainable gains from OptiSelect, whereas diagonal-adaptive optimizers such as AdamW and Sophia admit strictly better upper bounds. The proposed principle also yields a quantitative derivation of the optimal candidate oversampling ratio. Pretraining experiments on 124M and 720M models are consistent with our theoretical analysis and show that AdamW's diagonal-adaptive scoring geometry remains the strongest scoring geometry even with Muon as optimizer. We further demonstrate that OptiSelect retains its benefits under data rephrasing, a technique used in modern data processing pipelines. Our findings provide theoretical foundations and practical guidance for co-designing optimizers and data selection in LLM pretraining.

</details>


### [166] [Measure Less, Know More: Self-Supervised Test-Time Feature Acquisition](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.03454)
*Eeshaan Jain,Linus Bleistein,Bart Deplancke,Charlotte Bunne*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: ECHO-$k$ 提出了一种任务无关、无标签的自监督视图获取框架，使用预训练基础模型的内部表征作为代理目标，通过强化学习学习长视野序列视图选择策略，以在测试时预算受限的多模态场景中有效获取信息。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 多模态基础模型在测试时获取所有特征/模态成本高昂且常冗余，而现有序列获取方法依赖任务标签或特定下游目标，无法应对下游任务未知且需即时决策的实际部署场景。

Method: 将序列视图获取建模为马尔可夫决策过程，以预训练模型的全视图表征作为自监督参考目标，使用近端策略优化（PPO）学习长视野强化学习策略，奖励为表征恢复的归一化改进量；理论部分在线性设定下引入Gumbel潜在关联模型与近似等距假设，推导oracle策略与测试时最优策略之间的遗憾界。

Result: 在单细胞转录组（hPancreas）、空间蛋白质组（NSCLC）、多模态地理空间（MMEarth-Bench）以及图像/表格数据集上，ECHO-$k$ 在受限预算下一致优于方差、GIR、Laplacian Score、SPEC-φ3、MCFS等无监督基线及GSMRL-AIR、ALG、CIG等自适应无标签基线，并在表征恢复指标上验证了与下游性能的一致性；同时对部分观测参考数据具有鲁棒性，支持异构获取成本。

Conclusion: 基础模型可从被动的预测器转变为主动塑造推理证据的资源感知系统；ECHO-$k$ 提供了一条原理化的、任务无关、成本感知的测试时部署路径，适用于任何测量代价高昂且下游任务先验未知的多模态系统。

Abstract: Recent progress in multimodal, high-dimensional learning has enabled foundation models to process heterogeneous, large-scale data. However, at test time, acquiring all features or modalities can be prohibitively costly and often redundant. Sequentially selecting informative modalities is therefore critical, yet challenging when the downstream task or prediction target is unknown. To this end, we introduce ECHO-$k$, a task-agnostic and self-supervised learning principle for modality acquisition: we use a deep model's internal pretrained representations (e.g., from a foundation model) as proxy targets that summarize cross-modal information. We provide theoretical guarantees in a stylized linear setting that motivate a reinforcement learning (RL) policy for sequential modality selection. Across task-agnostic and label-free acquisition baselines, ECHO-$k$ consistently improves budgeted downstream performance across diverse foundation-model backends. Our method provides a principled route to cost-aware test-time deployment, with implications for any multimodal system where measurements are expensive or time-constrained, and downstream tasks unknown a priori.

</details>


### [167] [Single or Multiple Policies for Phase-Structured Reinforcement Learning?](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.03475)
*Guilhem Loussouarn,Nancy Nayak,Kin K. Leung*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文研究阶段结构化强化学习中共享策略与多策略的选用问题。证明共享策略类与多策略类在表示能力上等价，提出基于瞬态-准稳态分解的诊断方法，通过四个关键因素判断何时共享、何时专业化。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 近期研究发现多策略方法在阶段结构化RL中常优于共享的增广状态策略，但缺乏理论解释。本文旨在系统分析该现象背后的机制，确定两种架构的适用条件。

Method: 1) 形式化阶段结构化MDP，证明共享-多策略等价性（命题2）；2) 提出瞬态-准稳态分解，将性能差距分解为稳态专业化增益G_m和瞬态切换成本K_m；3) 推导四个诊断量：持续时间、异质性、样本预算、切换依赖性；4) 在HAPS、PhasePendulum、PhaseGridWorld三个环境进行PPO实验验证四个假设。

Result: 验证四个核心假设：H1-更长阶段持续时间有利于多策略；H2-阶段异质性增加共享策略负担（梯度稀释而非破坏性干扰）；H3-多策略需要充足的每阶段样本预算；H4-严重的边界切换依赖可逆转架构排序。多头架构作为中间解在不确定区间表现稳健。

Conclusion: 提出了一种基于瞬态-准稳态分解的架构选择框架，明确了共享与专用的适用条件：共享在行为重叠、预算受限或边界协调重要时占优；专用在阶段异质、数据充足且准稳态增益超过切换成本时占优。未来工作应设计自适应架构并在未知阶段结构下扩展该框架。

Abstract: Many reinforcement-learning (RL) problems are non-stationary yet structured and can be decomposed into phases, each with its own transition probabilities and reward functions. When the phase sequence is known, the common solution augments the state with information to satisfy the Markovian property and applies standard RL techniques. However, prior work finds that the multi-policy approach for different phases can outperform a single state-augmented policy shared among the phases, for reasons that remain unclear. In this work, we first show that the shared policy can theoretically achieve performance of any multi-policy solution. However, whether a multi-policy solution can perform better than the corresponding single shared policy in practice depends on function approximation, learning and optimization processes, as well as, for multi-policy solutions, the sample efficiency and loss of continuity from one policy to another. We propose a regime-based phase decomposition method to identify which policy can provide better performance. The method is based on consideration of the duration of transient system dynamics relative to the duration of the quasi-stationary period. Numerical experiments are conducted with different non-stationary RL problems to validate our four major hypotheses: (a) longer phase durations favor multi-policies, (b) the heterogeneity between phases increases the burden on single policy, (c) multi-policies need sufficient data for each phase, and (d) environment-specific transition dynamics between phases can affect which policy is preferable.

</details>


### [168] [Certified Mechanistic Edits: Behavioral Guarantees for Skill Removal and Preservation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.03502)
*Md Sazid Uddin,Md. Khairul Alam Mazumder,M. F. Mridha*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出"认证机制编辑"框架，通过形式化证明而非抽样测试，验证对神经网络（如消融、权重编辑、激活引导等机制编辑）是否在连续输入区域内确实移除了某一有害技能并保留了有用技能。作者给出了四个命题（P1–P4）：编辑区域单调性与并集封闭、认证半径可判定且廉价、有限确定性黑盒测试无法认证移除（干预幻觉不可能性）、以及外科式编辑与引导式编辑在副作用上的精确分离。技术上结合了精确 SMT 求解器（处理 ReLU/阈值门路）和基于 CROWN 的有界传播（处理 softmax + LayerNorm 真实 Transformer），后者维度约为前者的 9 倍，并被攻击从上方括号化验证。实验涵盖从两层 ReLU 网络到标准 Transformer 的多种结构，揭示了训练自然产生、测试全部通过但技能仍在"幸存口袋"（体积占比 <1.5×10⁻⁶）的"干预幻觉"现象。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有机制编辑仅通过有限测试集验证效果，无法覆盖连续输入区域；测试通过的安全编辑仍可能被对抗输入逆转（jailbreak / unlearning reversal）。需要一种形式化的"最坏情况行为保证"来替代抽样测试，确保编辑在整个输入区域内的真实行为。

Method: 1) 框架：定义 claim (h, R, ⊳) 与认证半径 ε*，P1–P4 四个命题构成理论骨架；2) 精确方法：将网络编码为 Z3 SMT，使用 QF-LRA（有理数上精确算术）+ ReLU 的 ite 分裂，通过 unsat 证明对所有输入成立；3) 序列+连续噪声通过"hull 松弛"在一次查询中处理（避免布尔分支爆炸）；4) 有界传播扩展（CROWN/auto_LiRPA）：处理 softmax + LayerNorm，给出 sound 但 incomplete 的下界，并由投影梯度攻击从上方括号化给出 certified ≤ true ≤ attack 的区间；5) 双副本 siamese 编码用于特征非干扰性（独立于禁用输入）；6) float 间隙通过前向误差分析（≈10⁻¹³）与显式 slack（10⁻⁹/10⁻⁶）控制。

Result: 1) 在标准 softmax + LayerNorm Transformer 上，CROWN 认证 448 维嵌入噪声球的移除与保留半径，被攻击括号化验证（0.0091 ≤ 0.03，0.0079 ≤ 0.05，0.0098 ≤ 0.1），无伪造；2) 阈值门 Transformer 精确求解认证所有 token 序列×连续嵌入球，跨注意力头+MLP 的分布式回路（仅头或仅 MLP 均不能移除技能 A）；3) P3 构造"帐篷"小装置通过 40,401 点网格+保留证明，但被求解器找到幸存点；自然训练在 160 个模型中产生 3 个 d≥4 的干预幻觉，幸存口袋 <1.5×10⁻⁶；4) 认证影响（特征非干扰）在 Transformer 上精确为 0；5) 外科编辑（消融/权重编辑）保零副作用，引导（diff-of-means）副作用随剂量线性侵蚀（R²≥0.999），与 P4(d) 线性律一致；6) 精确验证在 8 宽 1 头 L=6 配置内可解，更大则超时或松弛失效。

Conclusion: 机制编辑的形式化行为认证可行：用证书替代测试集作为"编辑是否达到目的"的证据。核心负结果（P3）证明测试本质上无法提供此保证。精确 SMT 受限于分支爆炸（指数级），有界传播以 sound 方式扩展但有松弛。外科式编辑有可证明的零副作用，引导式编辑在剂量-保留间存在不可避免的权衡。该方法预设目标技能具有可判定规范，这一假设限制了其在真实危害能力上的直接应用，是未来工作（预训练小模型 + 真实 SAE 钳位 + 离散编辑距离证书）的核心前提。

Abstract: Mechanistic edits (ablations, weight edits, activation steering) are the standard tools for unlearning a harmful capability from a neural network while preserving useful ones. Current approaches validate their effects only by testing, which can never cover an entire continuous region of inputs. Prior work at the interpretability-verification boundary certifies descriptions of a model: what a circuit computes, or whether it faithfully explains the whole. We instead certify the behavioral effect of an edit: that disabling a circuit removes one skill and provably preserves another, for every input in a region; a feature non-interference guarantee in the information-flow-security sense. We demonstrate such certified edits from toy ReLU networks up to a standard softmax + LayerNorm transformer, proving removal and preservation over continuous embedding-space regions and reaching roughly 9x the input-perturbation dimension an exact solver can handle by switching to sound bound propagation. Furthermore, we prove that no finite deterministic black-box test can certify removal, exhibiting an edit that passes exhaustive testing yet provably fails on a survivor pocket that can be made arbitrarily small. Guarantees hold on small, standard-architecture networks and, like any removal claim, presuppose that the target skill admits a decidable specification, a property which real-world harms may not have.

</details>


### [169] [Beyond Trained Models: Compiling GNNs for a Sound Explainer Benchmark](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.03526)
*Steve Azzolin,Francesco Paolo Nerini,Stefano Teso,Francesco Bonchi,Bruno Lepri,André Panisson,Andrea Passerini*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文针对GNN解释器评估中常用的"合理性"（plausibility）度量存在的根本缺陷，提出了一种新的基准测试方法。作者发现被解释的GNN可能并未学习到预期的判别模式，因此提出用逻辑编译替代训练，并通过编译GNN构建精确的真值解释。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 合理性评估隐含假设训练后的GNN会依赖预定义的判别模式（如植入的motif），但该假设在多个流行基准上被违反——例如仅凭节点度分布就能解决任务，从而导致对解释器的评估产生误导，正确识别替代模式的优秀解释器反被惩罚。

Method: 作者提出三个核心方法：1) Gracr——首个将分级模态逻辑公式编译为GNN权重的编译器，生成行为已知的GNN；2) 基于形式化XAI的素数蕴含（prime implicant）概念定义精确的真值解释，取所有素数蕴含的并集作为UPI；3) 基于ROBDD的高效UPI提取算法UnionPI，并基于此构建GracrBench基准。

Result: 在六个任务上对十一种解释器进行实验的结果显示：仅FlowX、GraphSVX和IG在所有任务中均稳定可靠；大多数解释器对公式的不同实现形式（即相同语义的等价计算）不具备鲁棒性；多数解释器难以捕捉间接影响（如二跳邻居效应）；同时复现了GNNExplainer无法稀疏化冗余边、Deconv会对无关边分配虚假重要性等已有发现。

Conclusion: GracrBench作为一种新颖且严格的图后验可解释性评估环境，能够对GNN解释器进行细粒度的诊断评估，揭示了它们在鲁棒性方面的局限性。编译后的GNN虽与真实训练模型存在差距，但提供了一种此前不可实现的精确可控分析手段。

Abstract: Explainers for Graph Neural Networks (GNNs) are commonly evaluated by their plausibility, i.e., how well their explanations recover a predefined ground truth, such as a motif planted in the data. This protocol implicitly assumes that a GNN trained on such data relies on the intended motif. Although prior work has questioned this assumption, plausibility remains widespread. First, we show that the assumption is violated on several widely used benchmarks, where, e.g., degree statistics alone suffice to solve the task. Then, we remove this confounder by replacing training with compilation. We achieve this by introducing $\mathsf{Gracr}$, the first compiler translating graded modal logic formulas into GNN weights, yielding models that replicate the behaviour of the corresponding formulas. Since the behaviour of the model is now known by construction, we can define its ground truth explanation formally and compute it exactly. Building on this, we introduce $\mathsf{Gracr}\mathsf{Bench}$, a benchmark of compiled GNNs for the evaluation of explainers against this exact ground truth. Experiments on eleven explainers across six tasks show its effectiveness for fine-grained diagnostic evaluation: notably, we discover that most explainers are not robust to indirect influences or alternative implementations of the same formula. These results position $\mathsf{Gracr}\mathsf{Bench}$ as a novel, rigorous evaluation setting for graph post-hoc explainability.

</details>


### [170] [Cephalonauts One: A deep fMRI dataset for decoding naturalistic speech in the human brain](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.03558)
*Antoine Collas,Louis Jalouzot,Géraud Ilinca,Corentin Caris,Romain Valabrègue,Ahmed Hassayoune,David Goncalves,Madeleine Hueber,Thaddée Delebarre,Julien Savatovsky,Clara Fonteneau,Charles Maussion,Bertrand Thirion,Alexis Thual*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文发布了Cephalonauts One数据集，这是目前最深的用于自然语音刺激的fMRI数据集，每个被试包含30小时的全脑3T fMRI数据，并提出了音频片段检索的脑解码基准任务。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有的自然语音fMRI数据集每个被试的数据量有限（最多约16小时），制约了被试特定解码器的性能提升。需要更深的单被试fMRI数据集来推动自然语音的脑编码与解码研究。

Method: 1) 采集3名健康被试在聆听播客音频时进行多次扫描，每次包含5个15分钟run；2) 配对脑活动与播客音频、转录标注及刺激嵌入；3) 提出音频片段检索解码基准（从fMRI活动中识别对应的时序对齐音频片段）；4) 提供标准化数据划分、评估指标与基线解码器；5) 进行数据量缩放分析。

Result: 构建了每个被试30小时fMRI数据的最深自然语音fMRI数据集；解码性能随每个被试训练数据量的增加而持续提升（缩放分析得到验证）。

Conclusion: Cephalonauts One填补了深度单被试自然语音fMRI数据的空白，其配套的音频片段检索基准为评估和推动脑解码方法提供了标准化框架，证实了数据深度对解码性能的关键作用。

Abstract: Cephalonauts One is a whole-brain 3 Tesla (3T) functional magnetic resonance imaging (fMRI) dataset recorded while subjects listened to audio podcasts. Three healthy subjects underwent multiple scanning sessions, each consisting of five 15-minute runs, while listening to podcasts in their native language. With 30 hours of fMRI data per subject, the current release is the deepest available fMRI dataset using naturalistic speech stimuli. The dataset pairs brain activity with the corresponding podcast audio, transcript annotations, and derived stimulus embeddings. Furthermore, we introduce a brain decoding benchmark formulated as audio segment retrieval: given fMRI activity from a held-out session, the decoder must identify the corresponding time-aligned podcast audio segment among candidate segments. We provide standardized splits, evaluation metrics, and baseline decoders for this task. Finally, a scaling analysis shows that decoding performance improves continuously with the amount of training data per subject.

</details>


### [171] [What Should World Models Forget? Stratified Retention for Continual Adaptation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.03713)
*Nishit Anand,Ramani Duraiswami,Dinesh Manocha*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该论文指出持续学习世界模型面临的核心矛盾：传统持续学习假设预测目标固定，将"遗忘"视为缺陷；但世界模型预测的是动态变化的环境，部分知识（陈旧事实）必须被修正而非保留。作者提出按"不变性时间尺度τ"对世界模型知识分层（不变量/环境规律/实例配置/瞬时状态），并设计"差异性保留"评估协议，同时报告不变量回归测试与修正延迟，以区分真正的灾难性遗忘与正确的知识更新。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 持续学习领域默认预测目标是静态的，因此旧任务性能下降即为"灾难性遗忘"。但世界模型建模的是环境，环境本身会随时间改变（如道路重建、物体移位），此时正确做法是修正而非保留旧知识。与此同时，世界模型还需编码物理、几何、因果等永不变更的不变量（如重力、物体恒存性）。现有方法无法区分"正确修正陈旧知识"与"灾难性遗忘"，且现有持续学习基准假设任务内真值不变，使该问题被掩盖。

Method: 论文采用立场论文（position paper）形式，提出三点核心贡献：1）在概念层面区分三种"关于过去的错误"——灾难性遗忘（真实缺陷）、故意遗忘（合规移除）、过时性（环境改变导致知识失效，必须修正）；2）提出按不变性时间尺度τ对知识分层（详见表1），主张保护程度应与τ正相关，而非与"对过去任务的重要性"相关；3）提出"差异性保留"评估协议，包含两个不聚合的联合报告指标：(a) 不变量回归测试——在τ=∞层（如物理概念）抽取探针集，每轮适配后复测；(b) 修正延迟——度量模型需要多少观测才能反映已变化的事实，并单独统计从未修正的事实。

Result: 本文作为立场论文，未提供实验结果。其论证性结果包括：1）指出标准遗忘指标在变化环境下存在病态最优——完全不更新的冻结模型反而得分最高，而这恰恰是需要被持续适配所避免的失败模式；2）指出现有物理推理基准（如WorldBench、PhyGround）仅评估冻结检查点，将其改造为适配流上的回归套件即可实现不变量测试，无需新数据；3）批评EWC、replay、distillation等现有巩固方法按"对过去性能的重要性"决定保护对象，与τ无关，会同时过度保护已失效的下层知识和欠保护上层不变量；4）指出即使匹配刷新后的标签，也无法保证更新未损害不变量表示。

Conclusion: 世界模型是"过时性"与"硬不变量"并存的独特场景，需按不变性时间尺度τ对保留进行分层。保护程度应随τ递增，而非按对过去任务的重要性。当前评估无法区分正确修正与灾难性遗忘，差异性保留协议通过联合报告不变量回归测试与修正延迟（不聚合）解决该问题。该论文作为立场文章，留下三个开放问题：τ的边界是否域相关、能否从观测估计；几何一致性与因果结构是否缺乏等价探针；不变量在习得世界模型中是否局部存在、若纠缠是否需要架构支持。

Abstract: Continual learning treats degradation on previously seen data as evidence of failure, a convention inherited from settings with a stationary prediction target, where a correct label remains correct indefinitely. World models do not satisfy this condition. Their prediction target is the environment, which changes, so knowledge that was accurate when acquired may later become false, and discarding it is required behavior rather than a defect. Non-stationary ground truth is well studied in the concept drift literature and in the temporal factuality of language models, but has not been formulated for world models, which are distinctive in that they also encode knowledge that must never be revised. We argue that continual world models require retention stratified by invariance timescale, separating invariants such as physics and object permanence, which must never be revised, from instance-level facts that should be revised as soon as the environment changes. Standard forgetting metrics cannot distinguish a world model that has correctly revised outdated knowledge from one that has suffered catastrophic forgetting, and consequently rank a frozen model highest, while existing physical-reasoning benchmarks evaluate only frozen checkpoints. We propose differential retention, which reports invariant regression testing across the adaptation stream jointly with revision latency, without aggregation.

</details>


### [172] [A Path Integral Surrogate for Multi-Step Gradient Inversion in Federated Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.03597)
*Agnivo Ghosh,Saumik Bhattacharya*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出 PI-SME 方法，将 FedAvg 多步累积更新视为梯度场沿客户端轨迹的路径积分，采用 Gauss–Legendre 数值积分在可学习 Bézier 曲线的多个节点上求积，实现比现有最强代理基线（NL-SME）更优的多步梯度反演攻击。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 联邦学习中 FedAvg 客户端累积多步更新，服务器仅观测到权重轨迹的两端。现有代理模型攻击（SME、NL-SME）仅在单点读取替代梯度，误差随局部步数 T 增长而扩大；高维向量梯度场下均值定理无法保证存在单点使梯度方向与均值对齐。

Method: 将累积更新建模为梯度场沿 Bézier 曲线的路径积分 I(X̂, P₁)=∫₀¹∇ℓ(f_{w(t)}(X̂),Y)dt；通过 m 个节点的 Gauss–Legendre 数值求积公式在 [0,1] 上的映射点 {tᵢ, cᵢ} 加权组合各节点的代理梯度，得到 G(X̂, P₁)=Σcᵢ∇ℓ(f_{w(tᵢ)}(X̂),Y)。联合优化伪输入 X̂、可学习控制点 P₁ 和校准向量 d，最小化余弦匹配损失加 TV 先验与正则项。固定 m=7，使用 Adam 迭代 1000 次。

Result: 在 CIFAR-100 和 FEMNIST 上，对 T=100/250 及不同类别数 C=100→10 全面优于 NL-SME、SME 及单步方法 IG、GI-NAS、DGGI。CIFAR-100 上 PSNR 提升从 T=100 时 +0.8 dB 扩大到 T=250 时约 +3 dB；FEMNIST 在两档 T 下均提升约 +1.2 dB。类别受限场景中领先优势从 C=100 时 +0.8 dB 扩大到 C=10 时约 +4.2 dB。路径一致性测试表明即使仅知两端点，多节点求积仍显著优于沿全轨迹的最优单点（m=2 时损失约为单点的 1/3），且优势随 T 增大而扩大。增加 NL-SME 的迭代预算不能缩小差距，校准向量 d 吸收了额外迭代而非改善真实对齐。

Conclusion: PI-SME 将多步梯度反演重构为数值积分问题，利用 Gauss–Legendre 求积沿可学习 Bézier 路径估计累积更新。增益随反演难度（更长轨迹、类别更稀疏）而扩大；理论合理的节点数选取依据及类别稀疏下所有代理方法性能骤降的解释仍待未来工作。

Abstract: Federated learning lets many clients train a shared model together without ever sending their private data to a central server. Each client shares only a model update, and this update should reveal far less about the client than its raw training examples would. This premise is what protects the privacy of the clients. Gradient inversion attacks challenge it directly by trying to reconstruct a client's private input images from the single update it shared. Under FedAvg, a client's update accumulates several local training steps, so the server sees only the two endpoints of a hidden weight trajectory. Recent gradient inversion attacks fit a surrogate model along the path between these two endpoints but they still read its gradient at a single point. We propose the Path-Integral Surrogate Model Extension (PI-SME) which treats the accumulated update as a path integral of the gradient field and approximates it by Gauss--Legendre quadrature over several nodes along a learnable Bézier path. On CIFAR-100 and FEMNIST images across a range of trajectory lengths and class-restricted batches PI-SME reconstructs the private inputs more faithfully than the strongest surrogate baseline on several inversion metrics and the matching loss.

</details>


### [173] [Hybrid Machine Learning-Assisted Raman Spectroscopy with Generative Feature Augmentation for Pharmaceutical Identification](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.02224)
*Quach Thi Thai Binh,Ton Nu Quynh Trang,Thang B. Phan,Vu Thi Hanh Thu,Nguyen Tuan Hung*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种名为 HyMLRaman 的混合机器学习框架，结合深度特征提取、生成式特征增强与经典分类器，用于基于拉曼光谱快速识别六种药物残留物（阿莫西林、氯霉素、环丙沙星、四环素、布洛芬和对乙酰氨基酚）。其中 EfficientNet-B3 作为最优特征提取器，其 1536 维嵌入结合 SVM 分类器取得最佳基线性能（96.31% 准确率，96.36% macro-F1），并通过 DDPM 在 PCA 降维的潜在空间中进行特征增强，在低数据条件下对 KNN 等分类器带来选择性增益。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 药物残留物（尤其是抗生素）在食品、水和临床样本中的存在引发公共卫生担忧。拉曼光谱因其快速、无损、分子特异性的振动指纹特性，是现场筛查的理想工具，但实际测量中的光谱变异性给传统化学计量学方法带来挑战，亟需将现代机器学习技术与拉曼光谱深度融合。现有研究大多采用单一建模范式（经典 ML 或深度学习），未能充分利用两者的互补优势；同时在数据有限条件下缺乏有效的增强策略。

Method: 框架包含三个核心阶段：(1) 光谱图像预处理与深度特征提取——将一维拉曼光谱重塑为 128×128 三通道灰度光谱图像，比较 EfficientNet-B0/B3、RegNetY-400M、ViT-B16 等骨干网络，选取 EfficientNet-B3 提取 1536 维全局平均池化嵌入；(2) 经典分类器下游分类——在 1536 维嵌入上训练 SVM（RBF 核）、KNN、多项式 Logistic 回归（带 L2 正则化）、随机森林、XGBoost 和双层 MLP（256-128 神经元，Dropout=0.3），以及嵌入级一维 CNN 基线，采用分层十折交叉验证（SEED=1337）；(3) DDPM 特征级增强——在 64 维 PCA 降维的嵌入空间中训练类条件 DDPM，生成候选特征后通过逻辑回归置信度（τ=0.85）与近邻距离（λ=1.25 倍第 95 百分位）双重过滤，仅保留符合类内分布的合成样本。所有预处理与增强操作严格限于训练折内以防止信息泄露。

Result: 基线性能：EfficientNet-B3–SVM 取得 96.31% 准确率与 96.36% macro-F1，优于所有独立深度骨干网络（EfficientNet-B3 89.60%、RegNetY 88.12%）与嵌入级 CNN（92.62%）。ANN、LR、XGBoost、RF、KNN 分别达到 95.91%、95.61%、95.31%、94.91%、94.62%。DDPM 低数据消融：在 25%/50% 训练比例下，KNN 获得最大正向增益（50% 时 +0.795% 准确率，+0.848% macro-F1），SVM 在 25% 时也获得 +0.301% 准确率提升；但在 100% 全数据下多数分类器反而出现微小负增益（如 ANN −1.098%），表明 DDPM 增强效果与分类器和数据量强相关。类别级分析：SVM 六类 AUC 均在 0.995–0.999 之间（微平均 0.998），对布洛芬召回率最低（94.0%）；KNN 因受局部重叠影响，对布洛芬与对乙酰氨基酚的区分稍弱（AUC 0.981/0.989）。应用层面：基于 PyQt 的拉曼药物分析仪对独立实验测量的 PAR、CIP、IBU、TET 样本实现 >98% 置信度的正确识别，并显示光谱响应图辅助可解释性。

Conclusion: HyMLRaman 验证了"深度嵌入+经典分类器"混合范式在拉曼光谱药物识别中的有效性，其中 EfficientNet-B3 作为特征提取器配合 SVM 提供了最强且最稳定的基线。DDPM 在 PCA 潜在空间中的特征增强并非通用增益工具，而是稀疏数据条件下对邻域敏感分类器（尤其 KNN）的有效辅助模块。类别级混淆矩阵与 ROC-AUC 证实所提特征空间在六类化合物上均保持高判别性。最后通过交互式拉曼分析仪证明了模型在独立实验数据上的实际可部署性与可解释性，为快速拉曼药物筛查提供了一条实用路径，但仍需在更大规模外部样本上进一步验证。

Abstract: Rapid and reliable identification of pharmaceutical residues is important for safeguarding public health, ensuring food safety, and enabling practical Raman-based screening. In this study, we propose HyMLRaman, a hybrid Raman spectroscopy framework that combines deep spectral feature extraction, generative models, and classical machine-learning classifiers to identify six pharmaceutical compounds, including amoxicillin, chloramphenicol, ciprofloxacin, tetracycline, ibuprofen, and paracetamol. Raman spectra are converted into spectral images and encoded with several deep neural-network backbones, among which EfficientNet-B3 yields the most effective representation. The resulting 1536-dimensional embeddings are then used to train downstream classifiers, including SVM, KNN, logistic regression, random forest, XGBoost, and ANN, using stratified 10-fold cross-validation. The hybrid EfficientNet-B3--SVM configuration achieves the strongest baseline performance, reaching 96.31% accuracy and a macro-F1 score of 96.36%, outperforming the standalone CNN baseline. To address limited-data conditions, a generative model, a DDPM-based feature augmentation, is introduced in a PCA-reduced EfficientNet-B3 latent space. The low-data ablation results show that DDPM augmentation provides selective benefits, particularly for KNN with reduced training fractions, and that its effect remains classifier-dependent. Finally, an application-level Raman Pharmaceutical Analyzer demonstrates the feasibility of embedding the trained model into an interactive Raman analysis workflow. These results suggest that HyMLRaman provides a practical and interpretable route for rapid Raman-based pharmaceutical screening.

</details>


### [174] [The Price of Greenwashing: Algorithmic Verification and Market Discipline using Conformal Machine Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.02225)
*Sourav Bose,Taoufik Bouraoui*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文针对企业自我报告排放数据中的"漂绿"问题，通过融合SEC财务数据与EPA设施级温室气体登记数据，构建基于梯度提升和Mondrian一致性预测（Conformal Prediction）的算法基线，并提出"一致性加权连续散度"（CWCD）指标来量化自报数据与物理排放基线之间的偏差。实证发现，该算法散度与企业未来的Tobin's Q和ROA呈显著负相关，证明市场会将环境数据造假视为公司管理不善的领先指标。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 当前ESG评级和文本情感分析依赖主观判断，难以客观量化企业的物理排放现实；企业自报数据存在普遍漂绿现象，造成资本市场信息不对称，市场是否存在"盲目"假设亟待检验。

Method: 1. 数据融合：将SEC企业财务数据与EPA设施级温室气体登记数据匹配，建立数学保证的物理排放基线；2. 模型构建：使用梯度提升（Gradient Boosting）算法预测企业实际排放量；3. 不确定性量化：采用Mondrian Conformal Prediction生成预测区间；4. 指标创新：提出Conformal-Weighted Continuous Divergence（CWCD）衡量自报值与算法基线的偏离程度；5. 实证设计：横截面引导-滞后（lead-lag）计量经济学回归，以CWCD作为解释变量，未来Tobin's Q和ROA作为被解释变量。

Result: 算法排放散度（CWCD）与企业未来市场估值（Tobin's Q）和经营盈利能力（ROA）之间存在显著且稳健的负相关关系，统计显著性高，表明机构资本确实对环境数据造假进行了定价。

Conclusion: 市场并非对环境欺骗视而不见，而是将漂绿行为视为公司基本面管理恶化的领先信号；CWCD指标为资产管理者和监管者大规模部署算法审计基础设施提供了量化依据，有助于缓解资本市场中的绿色信息不对称。

Abstract: While corporate sustainability mandates are expanding, the systemic reliance on self-reported emissions data exposes financial markets to pervasive greenwashing. Current literature relies heavily on subjective ESG ratings or textual sentiment analysis, leaving a critical econometric gap in objectively quantifying physical climate realities. To resolve this information asymmetry, we fuse U.S. SEC financial fundamentals with facility-level EPA greenhouse gas registries to establish a mathematically guaranteed baseline of physical corporate emissions. Leveraging a gradient boosting architecture and Mondrian Conformal Prediction, we quantify the shortfall between self-reported data and this algorithmic baseline into a novel Conformal-Weighted Continuous Divergence (CWCD) metric. Evaluating this divergence via a cross-sectional lead-lag econometric design, we uncover a robust mechanism of market discipline: algorithmic emissions divergence exhibits a severe, statistically significant negative relationship with subsequent market valuation (Tobin's Q) and operational profitability (ROA). Providing definitive evidence against the market blindness hypothesis, this study proves that institutional capital actively prices environmental deception not merely as an ethical lapse, but as a leading indicator of fundamental corporate mismanagement. Ultimately, these findings provide the quantitative justification necessary for asset managers and regulators to deploy algorithmic auditing infrastructure at scale.

</details>


### [175] [State-Space Unlearning for Non-Stationary Bias in Land Surface Forecasting](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.02248)
*Anidipta Pal*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出SSU-LSF,首个面向地球科学Mamba结构状态空间模型(SSM)的机器遗忘框架,用于消除非平稳偏差事件(如未记录的灌溉、传感器重校准)对地表预报(NDVI、LST、物候)的持续性偏差影响。通过EKFac影响函数定位时间混淆窗口,结合KL散度信赖域和空间全变分(TV)正则化实现遗忘,在三个基准上CRR达0.773-0.859,GPU成本较全重训降低8.4倍。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 运营级地表预报系统(基于Mamba/S4 SSM)将非平稳混淆事件吸收进状态转移矩阵Ā,导致NDVI、LST、物候预测在物理原因消失后仍长期偏差;全重训成本高达47+ GPU小时,梯度反转、EWC等方法牺牲清洁域精度且未利用SSM递归结构。

Method: 三阶段框架:(1) EKFac影响函数推导——针对Mamba状态矩阵Ā=exp(ΔA),给出闭式矩阵指数梯度(Eq.4),索引k=0,...,T-t-1;(2) 谱半径加权肘部阈值定位时间混淆足迹Φ;(3) Hessian-free投影梯度上升,KL信赖域约束(δ_KL≤0.05),参数空间空间TV正则化(融合套索式,fused lasso)。算法1为端到端外推过程。命题1给出理论保证:残留混淆上界O((1-ρ(Ā)^T_c)/((1-ρ(Ā))μ_ref))+O(L_enc·δ_KL/(1-ρ(Ā))),但经验上界松约200倍(因Pinsker和Lipschitz最坏情形松)。

Result: 三个异构基准(NDVI-LST Fusion 24个月、ERA5 Patchified 24个月、CropHarvest 6个月)、11个基线下:CRR分别0.821/0.859/0.773,最差清洁域RMSE退化4.2%(ERA5),LiRA-MIA降至0.53(接近随机),3-5 epoch收敛,8.4× GPU成本降低。消融显示TV正则化是空间一致性(SCS)的决定因素,EKFac足迹定位是CRR的决定因素;EUMETSAT SEVIRI真实事件CRR=0.793;S4骨架上CRR=0.791,证实跨架构迁移性。T_c∈{6,12,24,36}月R²=0.995验证命题1定性单调趋势。

Conclusion: SSU-LSF是首个面向地球科学Mamba族SSM的机器遗忘框架;命题1定性正确(单调性R²=0.995)但定量松200×;空间TV是空间一致性的关键,EKFac足迹定位是CRR的关键。局限:主要实验使用注入混淆加神谕窗口知识;CRR需已知影响位置;定量界限在ρ_max=0.91时失效;S4泛化仅在一个基准验证。未来工作:自动变化点检测、真实多事件档案、选择性SSM更紧谱界。

Abstract: Operational land surface forecasting systems built on Mamba-family Structured State Space Models absorb non-stationary confounding events (unrecorded irrigation booms, dam-operation shifts, sensor recalibrations) into their state-transition matrices, silently biasing NDVI, LST, and crop phenology predictions long after the physical cause ends. This paper introduces SSU-LSF (State-Space Unlearning for Land Surface Forecasting), the first machine-unlearning framework purpose-built for geoscientific Mamba-based SSMs. We develop EKFac influence functions specialized to the Mamba state matrices via a closed-form matrix-exponential gradient, use spectral-radius-weighted elbow thresholding to localize a temporal confounding footprint $\Phi$, and apply Hessian-free projected gradient ascent within a KL-divergence trust region augmented by spatial total-variation (TV) regularization. Proposition 1 establishes that residual confounding is bounded by $\mathcal{O}\big((1-\rho(\bar{A})^{T_c})/((1-\rho(\bar{A}))\mu)\big)$, which grows with the window length $T_c$. Across three heterogeneous benchmarks and eleven baselines, SSU-LSF achieves confounding reduction rates of $0.773$ (CropHarvest), $0.821$ (NDVI-LST), and $0.859$ (ERA5), with worst-case clean-domain RMSE degradation of $4.2\%$ on ERA5, converging in 3--5 epochs at $8.4\times$ lower GPU-cost per unlearning request than full retraining. Code: this https URL

</details>


### [176] [Nearest-neighbour baselines for fingerprint prediction from MS/MS spectra under different assumptions](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.02249)
*Ling Min Serena Khoo*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文系统性地比较了多种最近邻检索方法在分子指纹预测任务上的表现，揭示了不同假设（无化学式、化学式已知、化学式标注峰）对性能的影响，强调应使用更强的基线以更严格地衡量深度学习模型的真实进展。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 近期研究表明最近邻检索在从MS/MS谱预测分子指纹任务中可匹敌甚至超越当前深度学习模型，但"最近邻"实际涵盖多种信息假设不同的方法，缺乏严格基线。作者旨在厘清这些假设如何影响性能，建立更严谨的基准。

Method: 在三种信息假设下（无化学式/已知化学式/公式标注峰），使用五种谱相似度（余弦、修正余弦、中性损失余弦、DreaMS嵌入余弦、分箱余弦），在NPLIB1和MassSpecGym两个数据集的scaffold和random划分上系统评估最近邻基线。公式标注峰假设下还提出亚式（sub-formula）规则：对每个峰通过质量分解标注子化学式，生成片段与中性损失标记，结合元素加权的Bray-Curtis公式相似度作为软先验，通过softmax加权top-k训练指纹生成预测。

Result: 主要结论：(1) 无化学式时DreaMS嵌入余弦最强（Jaccard 0.263-0.895），谱相似度选择影响最大；(2) 已知化学式在random划分提升显著（覆盖率80.7%/97.1%），但在scaffold划分因覆盖率仅约40%而效果有限；(3) 公式标注峰假设下取得最佳结果（Jaccard最高0.337/0.758/0.381/0.947；余弦相似度最高0.528/0.842/0.556/0.960），亚式规则在scaffold划分上提升最显著（+0.078和+0.073），且此时谱相似度选择影响很小（差异<0.013）。

Conclusion: 不同信息假设下结果差异巨大，公式标注峰假设配合亚式规则提供最强基线；现有SOTA深度学习模型（如MIST）所使用的信息层级与假设3一致，说明此前比较未充分控制可用信息量。作者建议未来基准测试应明确报告各方法在推理时可用信息，并采用这些更严格的最近邻基线进行对比，以更真实地衡量进展。代码已开源。

Abstract: It has recently been shown that nearest-neighbour retrieval provides a strong baseline for molecular fingerprint prediction from MS/MS spectra, with several variants matching or outperforming current deep learning models (Khoo and Barzilay, 2026; Liu et al., 2026; Gupta et al., 2026). Importantly, "nearest neighbour" encompasses a family of retrieval methods that differ in the information assumed to be available at inference. In this report, we systematically compare several nearest-neighbour variants and show how these differing assumptions affect performance. Our goal is to establish stricter baselines that enable more rigorous benchmarking and better measure progress in this area.

</details>


### [177] [Rank-Aware Speculative Sampling for Diffusion Draft Trees](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.02251)
*Marcello Bullo,Yanxiao Liu,Öykü Sıla Güner,Arpan Mukherjee,Deniz Gündüz*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种名为RASS（Rank-Aware Speculative Sampling）的基于树状结构的投机采样方法，通过利用候选样本间的排序信息，在无需额外目标模型评估的前提下，改进了D-GRS的验证规则，从而更高效地加速扩散模型的生成。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有基于树的投机采样方法（如D-GRS）虽然比单链草稿能更有效地分配并行计算预算，但其按生成顺序依次验证候选样本的策略忽略了候选样本间天然存在的排序信息。因此，作者希望利用这种排序信息，在保持目标分布不变的前提下，进一步提升采样效率。

Method: RASS的核心方法是基于秩感知列表耦合（rank-aware list coupling）的验证规则。具体步骤包括：1) 根据候选样本在建议分布与目标分布均值之间的位移进行排序；2) 根据最小化所选建议与目标分布之间总变差的优化权重来抽取一个秩；3) 将选中的候选样本与目标分布进行最大耦合，并通过对残差进行修正来保证对任意秩权重都能进行精确采样。

Result: RASS在高斯混合目标分布、FFHQ的无条件像素空间生成、CIFAR-10的条件生成以及使用COCO2014提示词的Stable Diffusion 3.5潜在扩散模型等多个场景下进行了评估。以标准采样与投机采样的目标模型评估次数之比作为衡量指标，RASS在所有评估设置中均优于D-GRS，在CIFAR-10的计算预算匹配条件下，效率提升幅度约为20%。

Conclusion: RASS通过挖掘并利用投机采样候选样本间的排序信息，提供了一种更高效的验证规则。它不仅保持了目标分布的精确性，还显著降低了目标模型的评估次数，是一种实用且有效的扩散模型加速方法。

Abstract: Speculative sampling accelerates diffusion generation by verifying inexpensive draft states in parallel while preserving the target law. Recent tree-based methods allocate the parallel compute budget more effectively than single-chain drafts, as demonstrated by Diffusion Greedy Rejection Sampling (D-GRS). D-GRS generates $K$ conditionally independent candidates per node, and sequentially tests them in their generation order. Yet the sampled candidates admit an informative ranking without additional target-model evaluations. To exploit this, we introduce Rank-Aware Speculative Sampling (RASS), a verification rule for speculative draft trees based on rank-aware list coupling. RASS orders draft candidates along the proposal-target mean displacement and samples a rank with weights optimized to minimize total variation between the selected-proposal and target laws. Finally, the selected candidate is maximally coupled with the target, with residual correction ensuring exact sampling for any choice of rank weights. We evaluate RASS on a Gaussian-mixture target, unconditional pixel-space generation on FFHQ, conditional generation on CIFAR-10, and latent diffusion with Stable Diffusion 3.5 using COCO2014 prompts. Measured by the ratio of standard to speculative sampling's target-model evaluation counts, RASS improves on D-GRS across the evaluated settings, with gains reaching approximately 20% on CIFAR-10 at matched compute budgets.

</details>


### [178] [Approximation Property of Dropout Neural Networks: Sobolev Rates and Confidence Bounds](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.02253)
*Jia-He Yao*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文研究了带独立边 dropout 的 ReLU 网络对 Sobolev 空间 W^{n,∞} 单位球的逼近问题，构造了常数深度、规模为 Õ(p^{-9}ε^{-max{d/n,2}} log(1/δ)) 的网络，并证明了在精度指数上匹配的上下界（在固定保留率 p 和高置信度条件下）。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有的 dropout 神经网络通用逼近性质仅说明存在性，不描述网络规模需求。确定性逼近仅是问题的一部分，网络还必须有足够的冗余以控制随机删除带来的变化。研究这两种需求之间的交互是本文的主要目的。

Method: 方法包括上界构造和下界证明。上界构造结合了：(1) 有界局部子网络（利用 Manita 等人的去偏恒等式，仅对固定大小的有界电路使用）；(2) 在成功逼近事件上的局部化（通过平移输出偏置恢复支撑性质）；(3) 多尺度 Taylor 分解（在尺度内先求和以避免乘以 ε^{-2}）。下界证明分为两部分：(a) 输出层障碍——即使对仿射函数 f_0(x)=(1+x_1)/2 也需要 ((1-p)/p)ε^{-2}log(1/δ) 条边，利用 Bernoulli 和的小区间方差界及测度变化论证；(b) Sobolev 容量障碍——利用局部化 bump 函数族和 VC 维理论证明必须有足够多的边被保留。

Result: 主要结果：固定常数深度 L_{n,d}，上界规模为 C_{n,d} p^{-9} ε^{-2}(J+1)^2 (Σ 2^{j(d-2n)}) log(C_{n,d}/(εδ))；下界为 c_{n,d} max{p^{-1} max{ε^{-d/n}/(Lℓ_ε), ε^{-d/(2n)}}, ((1-p)/p)ε^{-2} log(1/δ)}。当 d≤2n 时，精度和置信度同时匹配；当 d>2n 时，仅精度指数匹配。保留率依赖 p^{-9} 和对数因子的最优性仍开放。

Conclusion: 本文证明了 dropout ReLU 网络对 Sobolev 函数的随机逼近存在两个独立必要成本：空间分辨率成本 ε^{-d/n}（确定性表达力）和输出波动成本 ε^{-2}（随机实现可靠性），其最大值决定了精度指数。多尺度 Taylor 构造在固定或对数深度预算下实现了这一指数，但最优的保留率依赖 p^{-9} 和对数因子仍未确定。当 d>2n 时，置信度联合下界尚未建立；当 d≤2n 时，可同时获得精度与置信度的匹配。W^{n,r}（r<∞）目标的下界可推广，但相应上界需额外分析。

Abstract: The universal approximation property of dropout neural networks does not by itself describe the network size required for an accurate random realization. In this work, we study approximation of the unit ball of $W^{n,\infty}([0,1]^d)$ by ReLU networks whose edges are retained independently with probability $p$. The approximation error is measured uniformly over the input domain, and the guarantee holds with probability at least $1-\delta$ for a single sampled network. We construct networks of constant depth and size $\widetilde O_{n,d}(p^{-9}\varepsilon^{-\max\{d/n,2\}} \log(1/\delta))$. The construction combines bounded local subnetworks, localization on a successful approximation event, and a multiscale Taylor decomposition. Conversely, Sobolev capacity imposes a lower bound on the number of surviving edges, while approximation of a fixed affine function requires an output-layer cost of order $((1-p)/p)\varepsilon^{-2}\log(1/\delta)$ at sufficiently high confidence. For fixed $p\in(0,1)$ and $\delta<\min\{1/2,1-p\}$, the upper and lower bounds match in the accuracy exponent under a fixed or logarithmic depth budget. When $d\leq2n$, they also match in confidence up to logarithms of accuracy. We extend the lower bounds to $W^{n,r}$ targets with $L^s$ error, and distinguish this extension from the upper bound for $W^{n,\infty}$. The optimal retention dependence and logarithmic factors remain open.

</details>


### [179] [MACTS-EM: Multi-Agent Collaborative Time Series Forecasting with Emergent Memory](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.02255)
*Ahmad Shahi,Mamehgol Yousefi*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: MACTS-EM 提出了一种多智能体协作时间序列预测框架，通过专业智能体（模式识别、异常检测、因果推理、不确定性量化）、元认知层、涌现记忆机制、多模态集成和对抗鲁棒性五大组件，在金融、气候、疫情和能源四个领域实现了 8-12% 的预测精度提升、22-27% 的零样本迁移能力、16-21% 的分布偏移韧性以及 15-18% 的恢复速度提升。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有时间序列预测方法（无论是 LSTM/Transformer 等单体架构，还是 TimeGPT、Chronos、Time-LLM 等基础模型）均难以有效处理制度转换、跨领域知识迁移和多模态数据集成等复杂现象。多智能体系统在协作解决复杂问题方面已有成功应用，但其在时间序列预测这一专门领域的应用仍十分有限。论文旨在借鉴 LLM 多智能体系统的角色专业化、通信、记忆与协调原则，同时保持智能体的可解释性，以弥补这一研究空白。

Method: MACTS-EM 框架由五部分组成：(1) 四个专业智能体——基于 N-BEATS 的模式识别智能体、基于 TCN 的异常检测智能体（输出异常分数）、基于 BlockRNN+LSTM 的因果推理智能体（维护动态因果图）、基于 LightGBM 分位数回归的不确定性量化智能体（产生预测区间），通过特征级消息传递、置信度共享和抽象表示交换进行通信；(2) 元认知层通过 softmax 加权机制（权重基于时间序列特征和历史表现进行学习）动态分配智能体；(3) 涌现记忆机制采用模式库结构（域标识符+模式向量），通过高斯核相似度计算跨域相似性，并利用对比学习的三元组损失训练以促进跨域迁移；(4) 多模态集成通过 BERT（文本）、CNN（视觉）、嵌入层（类别）等专用编码器结合跨模态注意力融合异构数据；(5) 对抗鲁棒性组件通过生成水平偏移、趋势变化、波动加剧等挑战性场景增强模型韧性。采用两阶段训练（独立预训练 + 协作训练）和包含预测、多样性、鲁棒性、迁移损失的集成损失函数。

Result: 在金融（S&P 500）、气候（Berkeley Earth）、疫情（Johns Hopkins COVID-19）、能源（ETT、GEFCom2014）四个领域的实验显示：MACTS-EM 在大多数场景下以 p<0.01 统计显著优于基线（N-BEATS、DeepAR、TFT、Informer、TiDE、TimeMixer、Time-LLM、Chronos、Stacking Ensemble），整体精度提升 8.2-12.0%（长期气候预测提升达 12.0%）；零样本跨域迁移在五个迁移场景中提升 22.0-26.8%（最强为金融→气候对疫情的 26.8%）；分布偏移韧性提升 16.2-20.6%（疫情变种期间最强）；分布偏移后恢复速度提升 15.3-18.2%；在市场崩盘等极端场景下提升达 38.8%。消融研究表明元认知层贡献最大（移除后 MAPE 增加 13.4%），涌现记忆次之（11.1%）。但存在四个领域/场景下的小幅欠表现：短期气候最佳 1.8%、中期能源 0.9%、Pandemic→Energy 迁移 1.1%、能源分布偏移韧性 2.9%。

Conclusion: MACTS-EM 通过从单体模型向协作智能体系统的范式转变，在大多数评估中表现出色，最显著的价值体现在市场崩盘、疫情浪潮、极端天气等高难度场景（恰恰是最需要精准预测的时刻），且具有 2-4 天的早期预警优势。消融研究表明性能源于各组件的协同贡献。该框架仍存在训练开销增加 36%、超参数空间扩大、超长预测（>90 天）性能下降以及对高随机性数据处理能力不足等不足。未来将引入 LLM 智能体、强化学习优化通信、元学习加速新域适应、层次化结构与动态智能体创建等方向。

Abstract: Time series forecasting remains a critical challenge across numerous domains. Despite significant advancements, existing approaches struggle with complex phenomena such as regime shifts, cross-domain knowledge transfer, and multimodal data integration. This paper introduces Multi-Agent Collaborative Time Series Forecasting with Emergent Memory (MACTS-EM), a novel framework where specialised agents collaborate to achieve superior forecasting performance.
