Abstract: To deploy deep neural networks on edge hardware, highly efficient inference schemes are necessary that retain high accuracy. This work presents W16A16, a high precision (16-bit), fast speed, low energy quantization method. On a widely applied microcontroller architecture Armv7E-M, our proposed approach achieves faster speed and lower energy consumption on layer- and model-level compared to alternative quantization schemes. We analyze the architecture of Armv7E-M, explain the underlying principles behind the performance advantages of 16-bit approaches, and evaluate the empiric quantization errors for regression and classification tasks, as well as empiric time- and energy consumption in MCU deployment. We observe ca.\ 10 times lower quantization errors compared to 8-bit quantization schemes while achieving similar or better inference times and energy consumption.

</details>


### [293] [AIBL: Augmented Instance-Based Learning with Structured Memory and Neural Embeddings](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.03413)
*Radha Poovendran,Andrea Stocco,Linda Bushnell*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: AIBL（Augmented Instance-Based Learning）是一种将经典实例学习理论（IBLT）扩展到神经网络向量空间的实例学习模型，通过主动/遗忘/惊奇（surprise）三级记忆组织和观察驱动的晋升算法，在概念漂移和冷启动等动态环境下显著提升高维序列数据的决策性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统基于实例的学习理论（IBLT）依赖手工定义的符号匹配规则，难以处理文本、图像、交易向量、用户-物品历史等高维输入；同时，面对随时间变化的分布（即概念漂移），需要一种既能保留实例存储与基于激活的检索机制，又能自动学习相似度并有效管理新颖性（novelty）、冷启动与漂移适应的方法。

Method: 1. 将 IBLT 的符号情境匹配推广为基于神经嵌入的向量相似度匹配；2. 保留实例存储、激活加权检索与效用混合机制；3. 将记忆划分为 active、forgotten、surprise 三类存储库，surprise 用于隔离弱匹配/可能分布外/边角案例；4. 设计观察驱动（observation-driven）的晋升算法，将反复出现的惊奇实例晋升至 active 记忆，以容纳概念漂移下重复出现的新模式。

Result: 在五个机器学习任务与三个受控仿真任务上，使用同一 AIBL 实现，相比经典 IBLT 变体及任务相关基线，准确率提升 6 到 17 个百分点；向量空间检索在符号匹配失效的场景中带来明显增益，新增的记忆机制有效支持了新颖性检测、冷启动处理、漂移适应与奖励学习。

Conclusion: 研究证明了将 IBLT 从符号匹配扩展到神经嵌入向量空间的可行性，验证了 active/forgotten/surprise 三级记忆与晋升算法在动态序列决策中的关键作用；AIBL 在保持实例学习可解释性的同时，为高维、非平稳环境下的顺序学习提供了一种通用且有效的框架。

Abstract: Sequential learning systems often make decisions from accumulated experience while receiving high-dimensional inputs whose distribution may change over time. Instance-Based Learning Theory (IBLT) provides a principled case-based framework for such settings through stored situation-decision-utility instances, partial matching, activation, and blending. IBLT relies on symbolic knowledge representation in dictionary-like formats, but text, images, transaction vectors, and user-item histories often require learned similarity rather than hand-specified matching rules. In this paper, we introduce AIBL (Augmented Instance-Based Learning), an instance-learning model formulated in a learned vector space for high- dimensional sequential data. AIBL generalizes symbolic situation matching to neural embedding similarity while retaining instance storage, activation- weighted retrieval, and utility blending. The AIBL model organizes memory into active, forgotten, and surprise stores. Surprise memory separates weakly matched, possible out-of-distribution, or corner-case observations from active memory, reducing forced fitting to the nearest available cases. An observation-driven graduation algorithm promotes recurring surprise instances to active memory, allowing the memory to incorporate repeated novel patterns that may arise under concept drift. We evaluate the same implementation on five machine learning tasks and three controlled simulation tasks, comparing AIBL with classical IBLT variants and task-specific baselines where appropriate. AIBL improves accuracy by 6 to 17 percentage points. The results show where vector-space retrieval improves over symbolic matching and how the added memory mechanisms govern novelty detection, cold-start handling, drift adaptation, and reward learning under the tested protocols.

</details>


### [294] [Deep Bayesian REFoCUS](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.03419)
*Simon Penninga,Ruud van Sloun*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出 Deep Bayesian REFoCUS（DB-REFoCUS），将超声多静态（multistatic）数据恢复建模为贝叶斯推断问题，并训练深度生成先验以解决秩亏缺条件下经典线性 REFoCUS 解码器的局限。该方法在仿真和体内实验中均优于线性基线，并在反演精确时退化为线性解码。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统超声成像面临帧率、SNR 与聚焦质量之间的权衡。线性 REFoCUS 解码器在秩亏缺（发射事件数少于阵元数）时无法唯一恢复多静态数据集，其点估计无法表达零空间中的不确定性。亟需一种能够利用数据先验结构、在零空间中填充合理解并量化认知不确定性的方法。

Method: 1) 将多静态恢复建模为贝叶斯逆问题：先验 p(x) 采用连续时间流匹配（flow-matching）生成模型（3D U-Net，~146.7M 参数）；2) 通过扩散后验采样（DPS）框架，结合发射编码算子 A 及其伴随 A* 进行似然引导；3) 似然项的梯度包含与经典 REFoCUS 相同的伴随算子，对测量残差进行反投影以保证测量一致性；4) 在 ζ=0.35（仿真）/0.8（体内）的引导强度下，通过 Γ=1000 步、K=8 个后验样本进行采样；5) 后验方差表征秩亏缺区域的认知不确定性。

Result: 1) 仿真中，DB-REFoCUS 在所有秩亏缺程度和噪声水平下均优于伴随、斜坡滤波伴随和 Tikhonov 正则化等线性解码器（N_beams≥4 时复相关系数即接近 1）；2) 在 N_beams=80、反演精确时退化为线性解码；3) 后验方差与多静态损失在秩亏缺下呈强单调相关（Spearman ρ 高），可定位测量零空间；4) 在体内 PLAX 心脏数据上，未经微调即展现对谐波成像和分布偏移的强泛化能力，Hadamard 编码下线性解码失败时仍能恢复大部分缺失采集。

Conclusion: DB-REFoCUS 验证了深度生成先验在超声通道域中的可行性，能为任意发射序列恢复多静态数据并提供后验分布。该方法与认知超声框架结合，可为信息寻求智能体提供自适应发射-接收序列设计的贝叶斯重建基础。未来工作包括：基于 DiT 的更大规模架构、采用 ambient diffusion 利用真实体内数据训练、模型蒸馏以减少采样步数。

Abstract: In this work we formulate ultrasound multistatic recovery from arbitrary transmit sequences as a Bayesian inference problem. To that end, we train a deep generative prior on multistatic data sets to tackle the rank-deficient regime in which classical linear REFoCUS decoders fail. This appproach, which we term Deep Bayesian REFoCUS, outperforms the linear baselines for all regimes of rank-deficiency and noise levels, and regresses to linear decoding when inversion is exact. The model also expresses uncertainty in the null space of the acquisitions, whereas the linear REFoCUS decoders only provide point estimates. Finally, we analyze the impact of distribution shift between simulation and in-vivo acquisitions, showing remarkable generalization ability without any fine-tuning or adaptation.

</details>


### [295] [Causal Representation Learning with Instantaneous and Lagged Relations via Nonstationarity](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.03452)
*Tatsuya Yamada,Hiroshi Morioka,Yoshinobu Kawahara*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出 iCReN 框架,利用时间序列数据中的非平稳性(通过辅助变量关联的转移噪声分布变化),联合识别潜在状态及其瞬时因果关系和滞后因果关系,扩展了独立创新分析(IIA)以同时处理同一时间步内和跨时间步的因果结构。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 时间序列因果表示学习中,需要同时建模同一时间步内的瞬时因果关系和跨时间步的滞后因果关系,并处理数据的非平稳性。然而,现有方法无法联合处理这两类因果关系与非平稳性,成为关键瓶颈。

Method: 1) 建立理论可识别性条件:利用与辅助变量相关的转移噪声分布变化,在一定正则性、充分变异性、跨时间变异性与分离条件、边集大小约束下,证明潜在状态(在分量排列和逐分量可逆变换下)及其瞬时/滞后因果结构可被识别。2) 提出 iCReN 框架,包含 iCReN-T(离散辅助变量,时间对比学习)和 iCReN-G(一般辅助变量,广义对比学习)两种变体,无需变分推断或解码器,通过对比损失学习共享编码器、转移逆函数和历史特征,并加入稀疏性和 DAG 正则。3) 因果图通过学习转移逆函数 r̂ 的雅可比支撑来估计。

Result: 合成数据:iCReN-T 和 iCReN-G 在潜在状态恢复(MCC)和因果图恢复(瞬时/滞后 F1)上优于 IDOL、G-CaRL、CtrlNS、LEAP、iVAE、β-VAE 等基线。真实数据:在跑步机运动预测(所有预测时域误差最低)和 ERA5 气象预报(8 个区域中 5 个区域的标准化 MSE 最低)中均取得最佳表现。

Conclusion: iCReN 通过利用转移噪声非平稳性,成功实现了含瞬时和滞后因果关系的时间序列因果表示学习,无需干预目标标签。理论分析和实验验证了该框架在合成和真实数据上的有效性。局限性包括:充分变异性条件不覆盖含瞬时边且转移噪声可分解为当前与过去状态函数之和的模型(如线性转移模型);需额外证据验证真实数据上学习到的因果关系。

Abstract: Causal representation learning for time-series data aims to identify latent states and their causal relations from observations. In this setting, an important challenge is to model both lagged causal relations across observation intervals and faster causal effects that appear as instantaneous relations within an interval, while accounting for nonstationarity in time-series data. However, methods that jointly handle these causal relations and nonstationarity remain limited. To address this gap, we establish sufficient conditions for identifying latent states up to component permutation and component-wise invertible transformations, and their instantaneous and lagged causal structures up to the same permutation, using an observed auxiliary variable, such as time or a condition label, associated with changes in transition-noise distributions. Based on these results, we propose iCReN, a framework that uses contrastive learning with discrete or continuous auxiliary variables to learn latent representations and estimate their instantaneous and lagged causal structures. Experiments demonstrate accurate recovery of latent states and both instantaneous and lagged causal structures on synthetic data and the utility of the learned representations for downstream forecasting on real-world data.

</details>


### [296] [Beyond Random Splits: Evaluating Drug-Target Affinity Models Under Chemically and Biologically Motivated Distribution Shifts Copy](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.03456)
*Minjae Chung,Clara Li,Malar Paavai Muthukumaran,Shaunna Wang,Aniket Ramkrishnan Iyer,Shaun Qien Yeau Tan,Harinishree Sathu,Micky C. Nnamdi,J. Ben Tamo,Benoit Louis Marteau,May Dongmei Wang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文系统评估了药物-靶点亲和力（DTA）预测模型在四种不同分布偏移（scaffold OOD、fingerprint OOD、protein OOD、dual OOD）下的架构选择稳定性。研究表明，评估协议显著影响最佳架构的选择：化学偏移下排名一致，但在蛋白质或双重偏移下排名发生反转甚至逆转。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有DTA模型通常在单一数据划分下比较，但实际部署需要面对新化学系列、新蛋白质靶点或两者的外推场景。不同形式的分布偏移可能使不同架构各具优势，但此前缺乏系统研究架构排名是否随评估协议变化而保持稳定。

Method: 构建了包含718,800个唯一药物-蛋白质对的数据集（来自ChEMBL和BindingDB），涵盖273,528个化合物和3,704个蛋白质。设计4种评估协议：Bemis-Murcko骨架划分、ECFP4 Tanimoto聚类划分、蛋白质3-mer Jaccard聚类划分以及双重划分。比较Morgan指纹+蛋白CNN基线与12种受控架构（4种药物表征×3种ESM-2交互模式）。使用Kendall's τ和Spearman's ρ进行排名稳定性分析，并通过重复种子、组感知bootstrap和规模匹配控制进行验证。

Result: 1) 平均验证RMSE从化学偏移下的0.950/0.945升至蛋白质/双重偏移下的1.299/1.321；2) 两种化学偏移间排名高度一致（τ=0.79），但骨架OOD与蛋白质OOD仅τ=0.39，与双重OOD呈负相关τ=-0.55；3) ECFP+AttnPool在三种偏移下最优但在双重OOD下最差，而GCN+CrossAttn在双重OOD下最优；4) 训练规模消融和bootstrap分析证实排名变化源于架构对同时外推的特异性响应而非训练集缩小。

Conclusion: 架构选择高度依赖于外推形式而非仅平均误差或训练集大小。DTA基准测试应与部署场景的化学和靶点偏移相匹配，并报告排名稳定性而不仅是绝对误差。建议采用相似性感知（ECFP4 Tanimoto和3-mer Jaccard）作为架构路由信号。

Abstract: Drug-target affinity (DTA) prediction is widely used to prioritize candidate compounds before costly experimental screening. DTA models are often compared under a single data split, even though deployment may require extrapolation to new chemical series, new protein targets, or both. We ask whether the distribution shift used for evaluation changes which architecture appears best. We curate 718,800 unique drug-protein pairs from the ChEMBL and BindingDB datasets. We compare a Morgan-fingerprint + protein-CNN baseline with 12 controlled architectures that combine four drug representations with three ESM-2 interaction modes. Mean validation RMSE increases from 0.950 and 0.945 under scaffold and fingerprint-cluster OOD to 1.299 and 1.321 under protein-cluster and dual OOD. Model rankings are similar across the two chemical shifts (tau = 0.79), but agreement with scaffold OOD falls under protein OOD (tau = 0.39) and reverses under dual OOD (tau = -0.55). Held-out evaluation, repeated seeds, group-aware bootstrap analysis, and a size-matched control support the same conclusion: architecture selection depends on the form of extrapolation, not only on average error or training-set size. DTA benchmarks should therefore match the chemical and target shifts expected at deployment.

</details>


### [297] [Metropolis-Hastings Dominates Importance Resampling for Policy Composition](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.03480)
*Alexey Kurennoy,Ramil Yarullin,Fergal Reid*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文证明在解码时策略组合（将多个针对特定奖励微调的LLM策略以几何加权方式合并）中，独立Metropolis-Hastings（MH）修正方法在每个候选预算下都比普通采样-重要性重采样（SIR）更接近目标分布，且这种优势在每个凸f-散度下均成立。作者还推导出MH相对于未修正解码器在共识目标上的改进下界，并刻画了两种渐近误差行为：策略接近一致时MH误差衰减阶数更高，以及长响应场景下两者均达到总变差误差下界。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LLM对齐需要在多个目标（如帮助性、安全性、准确性）之间权衡，但为每个权衡重新训练代价高昂。解码时策略组合提供了一种无需重训即可调整权衡的方法，但标准的局部乘积解码会引入采样偏差。需要在理论与实践上确定哪种采样修正方法（MH vs SIR）能更好地逼近目标分布。

Method: 理论分析：(1) 通过优先级采样表示耦合MH与SIR输出，证明MH所选重要性权重随机占优于SIR，从而得到f-散度排序（定理1）；(2) 利用记录权重的算术-几何平均对数比G_M导出MH改进下界（命题1）；(3) 在近一致策略族中证明MH的KL误差衰减阶为δ^{4M}，而SIR仅为δ^4/M²（定理2）；(4) 分析长响应下目标-提议对数比的波动，给出关键预算下TV误差的精确下界（定理3）。实验在可枚举问题、GSM8K与HH-RLHF上验证。

Result: 主要结果：(1) 定理1：在每个候选预算M和每个凸f-散度下，MH输出分布与目标的距离不超过SIR；M≥2且策略非恒同时对KL（双向）、χ²和总变差严格成立。(2) 命题1：MH的共识改进下界为λ·E[G_M]，可仅从记录权重估计。(3) 定理2：近一致策略下MH的KL误差以δ^{4M}阶衰减，严格优于SIR的δ^4阶。(4) 定理3：长响应下MH和SIR均达到渐近最小TV误差。实验上：在可枚举问题中MH的KL始终低于SIR；在GSM8K上MH比SIR多去除70-95%的初始KL；带2个候选时MH在midpoint上下文中去除96.8%的初始KL（SIR仅76.0%）。

Conclusion: 独立MH校正在解码时策略组合中严格且一致地优于普通SIR，在每个凸f-散度和每个候选预算下均更接近序列目标。MH的改进可通过记录权重的证书进行下界估计，无需评估输出分布。理论结果也揭示了限制：随着响应变长和提议-目标比波动增大，两种方法的误差均趋于非零下界，因为候选池中缺失的目标响应无法被恢复。

Abstract: Post-training a large language model (LLM) often requires exploring trade-offs between multiple rewards, but retraining for each trade-off is expensive. Decoding-time policy composition allows these trade-offs to be adjusted by combining reward-specific policies at inference time. This composition targets a weighted product of the policies' probabilities over complete responses, but standard implementations combine their next-token probabilities, generally introducing sampling bias. We analyze a known iterative correction based on independence Metropolis-Hastings (MH). Our main result shows that, for every rollout budget, MH produces an output distribution at least as close to the target as sampling-importance-resampling (SIR) with the same budget, as measured by every convex f-divergence. We also derive a lower bound on MH's improvement over the uncorrected decoder in a consensus objective measuring agreement with the supplied policies. We further characterize the correction's sampling error in two asymptotic regimes: when the reward-specific policies approach agreement, and when the log ratio between target and uncorrected-decoder probabilities fluctuates increasingly widely, as can happen for long responses. We complement our analysis with experiments in enumerable and LLM-scale settings.

</details>


### [298] [Dual-Context Analog Retrieval for Time Series Forecasting](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.03491)
*Jung Min Choi,Ngoc Son Le,Ibram Abdelmalak,Vijaya Krishna Yalavarthi,Lars Schmidt-Thieme*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: DuoTS 是一种用于长期时间序列预测的"预测—检索—修正"框架，通过双上下文（当前上下文与检索到的类比细节上下文）逐 patch 修正基础预测，在八个基准上取得 SOTA，且修正机制可作为模型无关模块使用。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有长期时间序列预测模型多采用一次性映射（look-back 到 horizon），既不显式识别与未来各段最相关的历史片段，也无法考察匹配状态之后发生的情形；传统类比预测虽能利用此类证据，但单一最近邻不可靠且重叠 patch 易产生冗余候选。

Method: 方法由两部分组成：(1) 双路径 patch 主干，包含结构化路径（patch 内 MLP、显式一阶与二阶差分、跨 patch 轴混合、稀疏跨通道图混合）和直接路径（线性映射），融合后经线性头输出基础预测；(2) 双上下文修正器，对每个未来 patch f 构造查询 ξ_f=U_N+e_fhor，融合 current context（对最近 K_cur 个 token 的 cosine 注意力）与 detail context（在当前窗口内进行两层检索：先粗粒度选 top-K_blk 个 journey block，再在块内以排除半径 ρ 多样性选择 K_det 个历史 patch，将每个 patch 与其后 K_suc 个后继变化拼接编码；置信度由 top-2 间隔经 sigmoid 仿射校准），再以样本与位置相关的 softmax 权重 ω_f 加权融合后由 MLP 解码为修正量，每个未来 patch 拥有独立可学习的 tanh gate ζ_f 与基础预测相加。

Result: 在 ETTh1/h2、ETTm1/m2、Weather、Electricity、Traffic、Solar 八个基准、H∈{96,192,336,720} 共 32 组设置中，DuoTS 在 22 组取得最低 MSE、23 组取得最低 MAE；在 ETTh2 全部四个 horizon 上均领先（SRSNet 是最强基线，9/9）；消融实验表明二阶差分、跨通道混合、patch 内混合、轴混合与双上下文均对结果有贡献；将双上下文修正器迁移至 SRSNet、TimeKAN、PatchTST，在 24 组设置中 15 组提升 MSE；与检索增强模型 RAFT、SARAF 的跨论文比较中，DuoTS 在 28 行中 18 行取得最低 MSE。

Conclusion: DuoTS 将预测—检索—修正思路系统化为可学习的双上下文逐 patch 修正，证明检索证据与最近动力学在长期预测中具有互补价值，且修正模块可作为模型无关的即插即用组件；主要局限为类比仅来自有限 look-back、弱匹配与重叠 patch 会使 detail 证据失真，且固定宽度投影与逐 patch 修正在小通道数据集上带来额外开销，未来工作将引入多样性感知检索与弃权机制、扩展记忆范围并增强可解释性。

Abstract: Most long-term time-series forecasting models map the look-back window directly to the full horizon in a single pass. While efficient, this design does not explicitly identify which historical states are most relevant to different future segments or exploit what followed those states. Analog forecasting addresses this by retrieving past states similar to the present and using their observed continuations, but single nearest matches can be unreliable and overlapping patches may produce redundant candidates. We propose DuoTS, a Dual-Context Time Series forecasting model that uses retrieved evidence without relying on it exclusively. DuoTS first produces a base forecast with a parallel patch encoder and linear prediction head, then progressively refines it one future patch at a time. Each refinement combines two views: a current context that attends to recent tokens and captures the latest dynamics, and a detail context that provides distinct retrieved analogs together with their subsequent trajectories. Patch-wise refinement allows the model to balance these views across the forecast horizon and associate each future segment with evidence appropriate to its temporal distance from the present. Experiments on multiple real-world datasets show that DuoTS achieves state-of-the-art performance, while ablations confirm the contribution of each context. The refinement mechanism is also model-agnostic, requiring only an encoded look-back window and the future-patch position, and can therefore be integrated into existing forecasting models.

</details>


### [299] [Most-Recent Anchoring with Recurrent Ordering for Time Series Forecasting](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.03494)
*Jung Min Choi,Ngoc Son Le,Ibram Abdelmalak,Vijaya Krishna Yalavarthi,Lars Schmidt-Thieme*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: MARO提出一种以最近patch为锚点、按从新到旧方向进行循环扫描的时间序列预测架构，通过参数共享的循环模块将历史信息逐步融入以最新观测为中心的潜在表示，并利用多深度checkpoint融合机制区分近期与长期历史。在长短期预测任务上达到SOTA，且具有更优的计算效率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有patch-based预测模型对look-back窗口中的所有patch施加相同的固定计算深度，无法体现"近期证据"与"远期上下文"在信息贡献上的不对称性。位置编码只能隐式区分远近，但不能为不同patch分配不同的循环精炼步数，因此作者希望将这种recency偏置显式地编码进架构的计算深度中。

Method: 1) 可逆实例归一化(RevIN)后右对齐重叠patch，padding置于最旧一侧; 2) 稀疏通道混合(基于学习通道嵌入的top-κ邻域)融合跨通道信息; 3) 日历特征条件化; 4) 核心循环扫描：以最recent patch U_N初始化context state h和forecast latent z，从U_{N-1}到U_1逐步融合，使用共享bounded gate g_r和inter-patch MLP(含元素积交互ρ_s); 5) Checkpoint Fusion：在指数间隔深度D={1,2,4,...,N}处保存中间状态，通过softmax权重α融合为z̄，可证明其诱导单调非递增的recency先验λ_s; 6) 扫描后R次额外精炼 + MLP解码 + 原始输入与日历残差。整个过程参数与patch数量N无关。

Result: 在8个长期基准(ETT×4, Weather, Electricity, Traffic, Solar)和4个短期PEMS基准上，MARO在长期5组中4组达到最优(ETT合并MSE从0.335→0.329, Traffic降约5%, Electricity降约3%)，PEMS 16个MSE单元中8个第一。最近到旧扫描在6个对比中5个更优。消融证实：去除inter-patch mixer、channel mixing或recent anchor都会导致性能下降，全窗口MLP替代方案也劣于MARO。效率方面：Electricity上MARO训练比PatchTST快12.15倍、比TimeKAN快12.82倍，参数量约为PatchTST的1/6，FLOPs约为1/100；Weather上仅DLinear FLOPs更低。但ETTh1(仅7通道)上GPU利用率不足可能使其慢于DLinear/iTransformer/PatchTST。

Conclusion: MARO通过显式的recency锚定和从新到旧的循环顺序，使近期信息获得更多计算深度，同时保持参数独立于patch数量。在多个真实世界基准上达到SOTA，且在准确率-效率权衡上优于PatchTST和TimeKAN等强基线。核心贡献是recent anchor与渐进集成；checkpoint fusion使预测头能分别权衡短程与长程历史。未来方向包括并行化扫描、输入自适应的稀疏通道路由，以及扩展到不规则采样和分布偏移场景。

Abstract: Long-term forecasting models commonly process all patches in a look-back window using the same fixed stack. Older contextual patches and recent evidence therefore receive the same computational depth. Yet the information closest to the forecast and the more distant context do not contribute equally. Uniform processing leaves this distinction unexpressed in the architecture. We propose MARO, a Most-Recent Anchoring with Recurrent Ordering model that processes the look-back window from the most recent patch to the oldest. The most recent patch serves as the anchor. It initializes the latent state and conditions each subsequent step, so older patches are folded into a representation that remains centered on recent evidence. A single shared module is reused at every step, so extending the scan further into the past introduces no additional parameters. Intermediate states retained during the scan allow the forecast head to weigh short and long portions of the history separately. This expresses recency through the order of recurrent refinement. Extensive experiments across multiple real-world time series datasets show that MARO achieves state-of-the-art performance on both long-term and short-term forecasting this http URL studies examine the contribution of the main architectural components.

</details>


### [300] [Below what training size do deep tabular generators stop beating trivial baselines? A preregistered benchmark on a size ladder of clinical and standard datasets](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.03500)
*Shivam Shrivastava*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 这是一项预注册的基准测试研究，系统评估了深度表格生成模型（CTGAN、TVAE、TabDDPM）在小样本（200-20,000行）下相对于简单统计基线（独立边际、高斯copula、SMOTE、ucSMOTE）的效用表现。共完成2,220次运行，覆盖8个公开数据集和4个原生小样本临床数据集。主要发现：在23/24的数据集-深度模型配对中，深度模型在任何训练规模下都未显著优于最佳基线；最佳基线在40/49个（数据集,规模）单元中获胜；排名稳定性在最小样本量处最高而非最低；顶部两方法之间的差距在81%的单元中小于种子噪声；通过子采样大数据集来模拟小数据集的方法与原生小数据集的排名一致性仅为中等（Kendall τ 0.57-0.64）。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 深度表格生成模型（GAN、VAE、扩散模型）通常在数万行的数据集上进行基准测试，但临床数据通常只有几百到几千行。现有基准测试无法回答：在临床实际的小样本场景下，这些复杂模型是否真的优于简单的统计插值方法（如SMOTE）？此外，使用大数据集的子样本来模拟小数据集的方法是否有效？

Method: 预注册的"规模阶梯"基准测试协议。8个公开数据集按200至20,000训练行进行子采样；7个生成器（4个基线+3个深度模型），每个方法固定20次Optuna TPE调优试验和5个评估种子；4个原生小样本临床数据集按真实规模运行；主要指标为TSTR AUROC（在合成数据上训练、在真实数据上测试的分类器AUROC，取逻辑回归、随机森林、XGBoost三者的平均值）。分析包括：(1)交叉点分析；(2)最佳基线获胜频率；(3)相邻规模间Kendall τ排名稳定性；(4)效应量与种子噪声对比；(5)子采样代理效度分析。所有结果文件、预注册文本及哈希值均公开。

Result: 主要结果：(1)在23/24的数据集-深度模型配对中，深度模型在任何规模阶梯上均未以超过合并种子标准差的幅度超越最佳基线；(2)最佳基线在49个单元中的40个获胜，在2,000行以上时获胜率达100%；(3)预注册假设"小样本下深度模型排名不稳定"被证伪——5,000行以下相邻规模的平均Kendall τ为0.806，超出0.8阈值，且稳定性在最小规模时最高（τ=0.917在200-500行之间）而非最低；(4)81%的单元中，顶部两方法间的差距小于种子间变异；(5)原生小数据集与子采样大数据集之间的排名一致性仅中等（平均τ=0.57-0.64）；(6)关节效用-隐私分析揭示SMOTE获胜的代价是高DCR泄漏率（0.925）和成员推理AUC（0.740），而TabDDPM在保真度（C2ST AUC=0.808）上最佳但效用不高。

Conclusion: 实用结论：在小样本临床数据场景下，没有可测量的理由选择CTGAN/TVAE/TabDDPM而非SMOTE，且深度模型运行成本高出3个数量级（TabDDPM 104.3秒 vs SMOTE 0.1秒）。预注册假设中关于排名不稳定的预测被证伪——深度模型在小样本下排名稳定是因为它们都以相似方式失败。方法论意义：使用子采样大数据集作为原生小数据集的替代品不可靠，未来基准测试应包含原生小数据集。隐私-效用权衡是SMOTE获胜的核心代价，这也为继续开发深度模型提供了理由——特别是结合差分隐私机制的后续工作。

Abstract: Deep tabular generative models are benchmarked on datasets with tens of thousands of rows; clinical datasets have hundreds. We preregistered and ran a size-ladder benchmark to find where the two regimes diverge: 8 public datasets subsampled from 200 to 20,000 training rows, seven generators (independent marginals, Gaussian copula, SMOTE, unconditional SMOTE, CTGAN, TVAE, TabDDPM) with a fixed 20-trial tuning budget and 5 evaluation seeds, plus 4 natively small clinical datasets at true size, for 2,220 committed runs in total. The primary metric is the AUROC of fixed classifiers trained on synthetic and tested on real data. In 23 of 24 (dataset, deep model) pairs no deep model ever beats the best trivial baseline by more than seed noise, at any training size we measured. The best baseline wins 40 of 49 (dataset, size) cells. Our preregistered prediction that the deep models' ranking would be unstable at small sizes is falsified: mean Kendall tau between adjacent rungs below 5,000 rows is 0.806, above our 0.8 threshold, and stability is highest at the smallest sizes rather than lowest. One caveat bounds all of this: in 81% of cells the gap between the top two methods is smaller than the variation between seeds. Finally, method rankings on natively small clinical datasets agree only moderately with rankings on subsampled large ones (mean tau 0.57 to 0.64), which questions whether a subsampled large dataset can stand in for a small one. All 2,220 result files, the preregistration and its hash, and the code that regenerates every figure and number from those files are public.

</details>


### [301] [Getting Your Guidance Weights Right in diffusion and flow-matching posterior sampling](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.03503)
*Liam Moroy,Jean-François Giovannelli,Yoann Altmann,Steve McLaughlin,Frédéric Champagnat,Guillaume Bourmaud*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出SIMCA，一种无需训练的离线校准方法，通过最小二乘求解自动调整扩散/流匹配后验采样中每个时间步的引导权重，显著提升重建性能并支持大幅减少采样步数。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有即插即用后验采样方法依赖启发式引导权重调参，而测量设置常变化，重新调参耗时且构成实际瓶颈，需一种自动、快速的离线校准方法。

Method: 将条件分数匹配/条件流匹配目标识别为最小二乘问题，使引导权重优化在每个时间步简化为2×2线性最小二乘；进一步提出贪心仿真式SIMCA算法，用单个minibatch采样轨迹逐时间步校准权重。

Result: 在FFHQ、ImageNet、CelebA、AFHQ-Cat四个数据集上匹配或超越多种扩散与流匹配SOTA方法；SIMCA-50步性能接近SIMCA-1000步，实现20倍推理成本降低。

Conclusion: SIMCA提供了一种原理性强、计算高效的离线引导权重校准方案，无需重训，可适配不同测量算子与采样器，为训练自由后验采样提供了实用化解决方案。

Abstract: Training-free posterior sampling methods, also known as Plug-and-Play methods, leverage pretrained unconditional diffusion or flow-matching models to solve inverse problems. Most existing approaches rely on guidance weights to balance, at each time step, prior information from the unconditional score or velocity network with measurement consistency, yet the tuning of these weights is often not discussed and is largely left to heuristics. We introduce a simple and principled offline strategy for automatically tuning these guidance weights. Our key observation is that, at each time step, the conditional denoising score-matching objective for diffusion models, or the conditional flow-matching objective for flow-matching models, is a least-squares objective. Therefore, when the conditional prediction is expressed as a weighted sum of the unconditional network output and a measurement-guidance term, optimizing over these weights reduces to a two-dimensional linear least-squares problem. The resulting time-dependent guidance weights can be optimized offline for a given measurement operator, noise level and sampler at the cost of a single minibatch of sampling trajectories, without retraining or fine-tuning the pretrained generative model. Instantiated with the standard Tweedie-based measurement-consistency term, our approach improves posterior sampling and achieves state-of-the-art reconstruction performance across diffusion- and flow-matching-based methods. Moreover, the optimized guidance weights enable diffusion samplers to reduce the number of sampling steps from 1000 to 50 with no significant degradation in reconstruction quality. Code will be made available.

</details>


### [302] [An Automated and Reproducible Workflow for Crack Identification and Damage Assessment of Fusion Materials](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.03505)
*Rinkle Juneja,Viktor Reshniak,Richard K. Archibald,John W. Duggan,Gregory R. Watson,Cory D. Hauck,Gary M. Staebler*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出了一个基于Galaxy科学工作流环境的可重现自动化工作流，用于从扫描电子显微镜(SEM)图像中识别裂纹并定量评估聚变材料损伤。该工作流在418张来自114次实验的电子束热冲击图像上进行了验证，涵盖五种钨级别和三种微结构状态，无需针对单个图像调参即可实现一致的裂纹分割。核心贡献是构建了一个端到端、可共享且计算可移植的工作流，将实验表征、自动化图像分析、损伤预测和模拟引导的数据采集联系起来。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 聚变系统中面对等离子体和结构材料在高热通量、热循环、粒子辐照等极端条件下会产生开裂、溅射、侵蚀等损伤。SEM是损伤表征的核心手段，但手动分析无法满足现代聚变材料实验中数据量大、异构性强、多分辨率的特点。MPEX设施即将投入运行，将产生海量异构表征数据流，亟需可重现、自动化的分析流程将图像转化为可量化的材料响应描述符，以支持模型验证、材料比较和数据驱动的实验规划。

Method: 方法主要包括：(1) 基于Galaxy平台构建工作流架构，通过XML包装器定义工具接口、输入输出数据类型、参数和容器化部署，实现跨工作站、云和HPC资源的可移植执行与执行历史全程记录；(2) 自动化裂纹识别流水线：Sato脊滤波增强(基于高斯二阶导数的Hessian矩阵特征值)→ 高斯平滑+反锐化掩膜进行直方图调理 → 三角形阈值法自动分割 → 形态学闭运算和小连通域去除 → 一像素宽骨架化并通过结构张量方向相干性过滤；(3) 尺度感知定量描述符：裂纹密度ρcrack = Ncrack/Nvalid，并按固定物理视场分割图像块以保证不同分辨率间的可比性；(4) 三级质量控制（输入校验、算法校验含阈值与前景比例记录、视觉校验）；(5) 下游建模接口：基于DINOv2预训练视觉模型的patch特征→ PCA与扩散映射降维的形貌信息预测模块，以及与CabanaPD近场动力学断裂模拟代码的标准化数据接口。

Result: 工作流在418张SEM图像（含纯W、W-UHP、WVMW、WTa1、WTa5五种钨级别，纵向/再结晶/横向三种微结构）上成功处理，无需针对单图调参即可在高度开裂、弱损伤及名义未损伤表面上一致地恢复裂纹网络，并输出裂纹掩膜、骨架、覆盖图、强度直方图和裂纹密度表。Galaxy执行历史完整记录输入、参数、软件版本和所有中间结果，支持可重现执行与协作共享。形貌信息预测和物理模拟接口演示了标准化表征输出如何与下游预测模型和断裂模拟对接，为闭环材料评估奠定了计算基础。

Conclusion: 本文的核心贡献是构建了一个可重现的Galaxy工作流，将尺度感知数据采集、自动化图像增强与分割、质量控制、描述符提取、溯源捕获以及模块化的数据驱动和物理建模接口整合为统一的聚变材料损伤评估流程。裂纹识别模块已具备可部署能力，而完整闭环评估（含预测、不确定性驱动采样、自动化模拟调度）仍是集成目标。该工作流为MPEX表面分析站的运行和AI辅助的闭环聚变材料评估奠定了可扩展的计算基础。详细预测模型开发与特定断裂模拟方法的验证将留待后续研究。

Abstract: Post-exposure microscopy is central to qualification of fusion materials. However, manual analysis does not scale to the volume, heterogeneity, and multiresolution character of modern fusion-materials campaigns. To address this challenge, we present a reproducible workflow, implemented in the Galaxy scientific workflow environment, for automated crack identification and quantitative damage assessment from scanning electron microscopy images. The workflow processes SEM images and experimental metadata to identify cracks, quantify damage, and retain the intermediate products and processing history needed for reproducibility. Outputs include crack masks, skeletonized crack networks, quality-control visualizations, and scalar damage descriptors. The method is designed to operate without image-specific parameter tuning across tungsten grades, microstructures, magnifications, and damage states. We demonstrate the workflow on a sparse electron-beam thermal-shock dataset containing 418 images from 114 experiments spanning five tungsten grades and three microstructural states. We define a crack-density descriptor, which provides standardized inputs for downstream machine-learning prediction and physics-based crack simulation. These predictive components are exposed in the same Galaxy environment and are intentionally treated here as extensible workflow modules. The principal contribution is therefore an end-to-end, shareable, and computationally portable workflow that links experimental characterization, automated image analysis, preliminary damage prediction, and simulation-guided data acquisition for fusion-materials research.

</details>


### [303] [Divergence controls entropy in distillation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.03529)
*Nicolas Zucchet,Scott W. Linderman*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文从熵的视角系统研究了蒸馏中散度选择对学生模型熵的影响，提出前向KL会精确地以残差散度的大小膨胀学生熵，而反向KL在任务可行时压缩熵、不可行时反而膨胀，揭示散度本身充当了隐式熵正则器。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 蒸馏已成为大语言模型训练的核心方法，但对其性质的理解仍不足。熵关系到输出多样性和强化学习中的探索，但现有实践中散度选择常由序列级推导继承而非主动设计，导致其对学生熵的隐式正则化效应被忽视。

Method: 理论分析：将蒸馏目标解耦为token级散度与采样分布两个独立选择；证明带softmax头的学生在前向KL驻点处满足熵恒等式（学生熵=教师熵+残差散度）；分析反向KL与广义Jensen-Shannon族的扩散高负载极限。实验：构造线性softmax玩具模型系统扫描散度类型、上下文数、教师困惑度、top-k限制；在OLMo 2、Pythia上验证交叉熵恒等式；在Qwen3上解耦采样策略与散度的消融实验；在SciKnowEval Chemistry和GSM8K上进行自蒸馏实验。

Result: 前向KL在所有语境下膨胀学生熵，膨胀量恰为残差KL散度；交叉熵训练的熵等于其损失值，在预训练和SFT中定量成立。反向KL在任务可建模时压缩熵，当上下文过多或教师过分散时转为膨胀。广义JS族的插值权重λ在训练初期平滑调节熵，训练收敛时则出现突变。on-policy蒸馏的较低熵主要源于token级反向KL而非on-policy采样本身。自蒸馏中教师来自学生本身，反向KL或实时教师会导致熵崩溃，需用能膨胀熵的散度补偿。top-k限制对熵的影响取决于由谁选top-k以及尾部如何处理（重归一化vs尾部桶）。

Conclusion: 实践上应将采样分布和散度选择分开对待，把散度视为熵调节旋钮而非采样选择的推论。给定教师，熵调节是散度的固有属性，散度在蒸馏中充当隐式熵正则器。

Abstract: Distillation has become a core primitive of large language model training, but its properties are not yet well understood. We take an entropic perspective, studying how the entropy of the student depends on the data and the divergence that define the distillation objective. We prove that forward KL inflates the entropy of the student above that of the teacher. Since cross-entropy training is a special case, this yields an identity that we verify quantitatively in pretraining and supervised finetuning. Other divergences come with no such guarantee: reverse KL deflates entropy until the gap between student and teacher gets too large, and interpolating between the two changes entropy smoothly early in training but abruptly at convergence. The lower entropy of on-policy distillation comes from token-level reverse KL, not from on-policy sampling. The divergence therefore acts as an implicit entropy regularizer, whose role is clearest in self-distillation: as conditioning on privileged information deflates entropy, the divergence hyperparameters that work best are those that compensate for it.

</details>


### [304] [ZeroMAG: Zero-Shot Multimodal Adapter Generation for Plug-and-Play EEG Foundation Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.03546)
*Yubo Wang,Jingying Ma,Xinliang Zhou,Yangxuan Zhou,Jiquan Wang,Sha Zhao,Yiyuan Yang,Yi Ding,Ziyu Jia,Chenyu Liu,Cuntai Guan*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: ZeroMAG是一个零样本多模态适配器生成框架，通过未标记的目标数据和条件扩散模型，为冻结的EEG基础模型生成插件式多模态适配器，无需目标标签或目标侧优化，在六个保留数据集和三个EFM骨干上显著优于基线方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: EEG基础模型(EFMs)在大规模EEG数据上学习了可迁移表示，但许多EEG记录同时包含提供互补生理信息的伴随信号(EOG、EMG、ECG等)。现有方法要么需要训练新的多模态骨干，要么需要目标侧有监督优化，而新记录通常无标签且标注成本高昂。如何在保留预训练知识的前提下，无目标标签地扩展EFM以处理异构多模态记录，是核心挑战。

Method: ZeroMAG采用两阶段训练流程：(1) 函数保持的表示学习阶段——使用VAE编码器将参考适配器按功能块分块编码为潜在令牌，经跨块Transformer(CBT)处理后通过MoE专家解码器重建，并通过参数重构损失、余弦对齐损失、KL正则化、专家平衡损失以及无标签的函数KL散度损失联合训练；(2) 函数约束的条件生成阶段——冻结表示学习阶段的编码器和解码器，训练DiT条件去噪器，从无标签校准子集构造的模态-主体-任务条件生成适配器潜在表示。适配器架构采用"1+N"组织：冻结的EEG表示作为锚点(1)，每种伴随模态附加一个分支(N)，每个分支包含时域-频域编码、特征投影和共享协调三个模块。条件编码器通过排列不变集合池化(模态因子)、注意力池化(主体因子)和任务嵌入(任务因子)融合形成统一条件。训练使用311个参考适配器构成的源库，每个目标主体提供64个无标签校准窗口，DDIM采样50步生成适配器。

Result: 在ISRUC-S3、HMC、MASS、SEED-V、EEGMAT和FoG六个保留目标数据集上，ZeroMAG在所有18个骨干-数据集评估中均优于无标签基线：相比仅EEG推理平均提升7.22个百分点平衡准确率(B-ACC)，相比直接权重回归(Direct MLP)提升4.89个百分点，同时与有监督多模态微调的平均差距仅0.50个百分点(恢复93.50%的监督增益)。在三个EFM骨干(CBraMod、CSBrain、CodeBrain)上的增益高度稳定(7.12-7.30点)。消融实验验证了各组件贡献：移除主体条件降低11.09点B-ACC；直接权重MLP降低11.07点；移除谱分支降低8.12点；移除Stage1/Stage2函数监督分别降低1.15/1.58点。在未见模态组合和模态类型上分别恢复89.7%和82.6%的监督增益；性能在约64个无标签校准窗口时饱和；仅使用50%源适配器库即可保留97.2%的完整多模态增益。目标侧适配器生成约需2分钟，比有监督目标适应的15分钟快7.5倍。ZeroMAG在CodeBrain上超越SleepFM 1.85点，与PhysioOmni仅差0.31点，与Brant-X差0.80点。

Conclusion: ZeroMAG成功证明了无需目标标签或目标侧优化即可为现有EFM添加多模态能力的可行性，通过配置不变的适配器架构、目标驱动的条件构造和函数约束的潜在生成三个核心设计，统一解决了异构模态配置(C1)、无标签目标适应(C2)和参数与功能一致性(C3)三大挑战。该框架在多个EEG骨干和任务上具有一致的泛化能力，效率显著优于有监督适应，且与需要多模态预训练的基础模型具有竞争力。局限性在于：依赖已提供的微调EFM和源适配器库覆盖范围；无法在不重新训练的情况下纳入支持模态集M之外的模态类型。

Abstract: EEG foundation models (EFMs) capture reusable knowledge from large-scale EEG data, while many EEG recordings also include companion physiological signals that provide complementary information beyond the EEG-only interface. The challenge is to preserve this pretrained knowledge while extending the EFM to heterogeneous multimodal recordings through an adaptation inferred from unlabeled target data. We introduce ZeroMAG, a zero-shot multimodal adapter generation framework that extends a frozen EEG encoder and prediction head using unlabeled target recordings, without target labels or target-side optimization. The target datasets are held out from all model training and selection in the ZeroMAG pipeline. ZeroMAG organizes companion modalities around a configuration-invariant adapter, constructs a modality-subject-task condition from unlabeled recordings and task context, and generates adapter weights in a function-constrained latent space learned from source adapters. Across six held-out target datasets and three EFM backbones, ZeroMAG improves balanced accuracy by 7.22 percentage points over EEG-only inference and 4.89 points over direct weight regression, while coming within 0.50 points of supervised multimodal adaptation on average. Ablations further show that removing functional supervision from either representation learning or conditional generation degrades generated-adapter performance, confirming the contribution of both components.

</details>


### [305] [Objects Without Morphisms: What LLMs for Mathematics Do Not Represent](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.03551)
*Yanli Wang,Suijin Wang,Xiaopeng Yuan,Haohan Wang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文研究大语言模型在数学子领域间翻译时的"作用域"（scope/level of generality）表征缺陷。核心发现：模型在不同框架间翻译时，能保持真值和内容，却系统性地无法正确迁移"隐含假设"（standing hypothesis/pin）。具体表现为：向更一般的框架翻译时，60.6%的改写扩大了量化域；反向翻译时，28.3%缩小了量化域；这种不对称在所有七个模型中存在，且最强能力的模型表现最差。作者提出这些系统只获得了子领域词汇间的"对象级对应"（object-level correspondence），而缺乏"理论态射"（theory morphism）的约束——即无法将公理映射为定理。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有LLM在竞赛数学上达到专家水平，很大程度上依赖于外部验证下的搜索（如验证器、过程奖励模型、证明核），这仅优化最终答案而不改善模型内部的表征。当不存在外部验证标准时（如在不同数学子领域方言间翻译），模型的真实表征能力未知。研究动机是检验：模型是否真正"理解"数学结构，还是仅在输出层面通过搜索产生正确答案。

Method: 方法学核心包括：(1) 设计无判断者的盲编码队列，分别编码真值(T)、内容(SE)、作用域(S)和错误类型(X)；(2) 用正则表达式对"隐含假设/钉子"(pin，如"域是场"模式)进行机械化、无需评判者的测量；(3) 通过planted-positive对照验证仪器灵敏度；(4) 使用预注册选择规则分割90条基准项为45条训练+45条保留测试集；(5) 跨7个模型（4个家族：Claude Opus 5/Sonnet 5/Haiku 4.5、GPT-5.6 Sol/Luna、DeepSeek V4 Pro、GLM-5.3）进行重写实验，k=3样本/项/方向；(6) 引入dsi指标衡量方向敏感性；(7) 用ProofWiki的25条数学家人工撰写陈述作验证；(8) 通过指令阶梯测试（B-E五个条件）检验提示能否修复。

Result: 主要结果：(1) 向一般框架翻译时，60.6%的改写扩大量化域，0%缩小；反向翻译时28.3%缩小，0.3%扩大（Fisher p=1.1×10⁻⁷³，n=315）；(2) 在保留测试集和数学家人工陈述上复制同样结果；(3) 所有七个模型均呈现该不对称，最强模型反而扩大最少；(4) 只有21.6%的模型改写和4.2%的人类陈述明确陈述所需假设；(5) 跨四个供应商的21对模型在项级相关性平均ρ=+0.503，说明失败由项目和目标框架决定；(6) 错误集中于"结论泛化"(ΔC)和"类型强制"(ΔT)，而非"假设遗漏"(ΔH)；(7) 失败集中在无验证器能检测的位置——扩大的语句在共享域上与源相同；(8) 明确指令"陈述每个所需假设"将推广率从8/37提升至33/37，但dsi仍仅+21.6，无方向控制；(9) 跨家族判断者一致性κ=1.000，与盲专家阅读一致性κ=0.900；(10) 来源继承模型最优描述Claude（log L领先21.2），目标语域模拟最优描述GPT。

Conclusion: 结论：这些LLM系统获得了数学子领域间的对象级词典映射（仅名词和符号被搬运），但缺乏理论态射的约束（即将假设映射到假设）。模型执行的是"对象级替换"而非"箭头级映射"——保留真值和内容，却无法在不同抽象层级间正确迁移一般性程度。能力扩展不能消除该缺陷（最强模型表现最差），指令亦非解药。该失败模式无法被证明器、类型检查器或等价性评分基准检测，构成当前数学推理评估的盲区。未来工作应检验数学专用模型和形式化系统是否同样存在此缺陷。

Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) have reached expert-level performance on competition mathematics largely through the volume of search placed around them: candidate solutions are sampled in quantity and retained only when an external criterion accepts them. Such a procedure improves the outcome that survives it while leaving untouched what the model represents. We examine that question where no external criterion exists: translating statements between the dialects of neighbouring subfields, where fidelity turns on the level of generality at which content is asserted. The source leaves that level implicit in its vocabulary, so a faithful translation must recover it from the relation between the theories. We introduce an instrument that codes truth, content and scope in separate blind queues, with a judge-free measure of whether a rewrite states the hypothesis implicit in its source, and establish its sensitivity with a planted-positive control. Across seven models from four families, translating towards the general framing widens the domain of quantification in 60.6% of rewrites and narrows it in none; translating towards the concrete framing narrows it in 28.3% and widens it in 0.3%. The hypothesis that would prevent it is stated in 21.6% of model rewrites and 4.2% of human statements. Capability does not govern the asymmetry: it appears in every model tested, and the most capable widens least. It replicates on the half of the benchmark held out by a pre-registered rule, and on statements written by mathematicians. Instructing a model to state every hypothesis it requires raises that rate but not its sensitivity to direction. We argue that these systems have acquired an object-level correspondence between subfield vocabularies without the constraint under which a translation between theories carries hypotheses to hypotheses.

</details>


### [306] [Get a GRIP, this will be a long TRIP: A Quantifiable Long-Range Framework for Verifying Over-squashing](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.03556)
*Ferran Hernandez Caralt,Simon Heilig,Adrián Bazaga,Asja Fischer,Moshe Eliasof,Pietro Liò*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文针对GNN过挤压(over-squashing)研究中长程基准缺乏认证标准的问题，提出了四个可验证公理(Predictability、Tightness、Strictly k-Range、Topology-Invariance)来严格刻画长程任务，并基于此构建了TRIP/GRIP框架，可在任意拓扑上生成满足所有公理的长程基准，同时提供闭式逐范围MLE oracle作为先验误差下界。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: GNN中的过挤压问题与长程建模能力的实证研究长期依赖LRGB等基准，但这些基准存在两个根本缺陷：(1) 缺乏对"长程性"的形式化定义和可验证证书；(2) 已有研究表明精心调参的短程模型即可在LRGB上匹配甚至超越长程架构。合成替代方案又局限于特定拓扑。因此，亟需一个原则性的框架来认证长程性。

Method: 1) 提出四个公理刻画长程任务：可预测性(Ax1)、紧致性(Ax2)、严格k-范围性(Ax3，子k跳邻域不携带目标信息)、拓扑不变性(Ax4，条件熵跨图一致)。证明违反任一公理均会导致基准失效。2) 引入f-稳定分布概念(广义化Gaussian/Cauchy/Gumbel的稳定性)，基于此定义TRIP(单范围任务)和GRIP(多范围广义任务)构造性框架。3) 推导GRIP的闭式逐范围MLE oracle(定理5.7)，给出首个先验逐范围测试误差下界。4) 对4个主流基准(LRGB、LRIM、GLoRa、ECHO)进行公理审计，识别各失败模式。5) 在TRIP上实证：(a) Balanced-Forman曲率与GNN误差不相关；(b) ECHO基准的模型排名差异不仅源于长程性。

Result: (i) 审计结果：LRGB违反Ax3(短程模型即可匹配)；GLoRa在声称范围10-15时，约35%实例可用≤9跳解决；ECHO多子任务的实测范围与误差无关。(ii) 22-环图TRIP实验成功复现过挤压转变(k∈{7,8})。(iii) 曲率分析中SDRF与原始图在k≤5时MSE几乎一致，Spearman |ρ|<0.4。(iv) 在ECHO拓扑实例化TRIP时，PHDGN显著优于其他基线，而该差距在原始ECHO任务中不存在。(v) 发现后验范围度量公式(1)存在平均化伪影，会系统性低估有效范围。

Conclusion: 本文填补了长程基准缺乏形式化认证的根本空白，提出的四公理+TRIP/GRIP框架使长程性可被先验证而非依赖后验测量。该框架不仅能审计现有基准，还能量化地将性能提升归因于长程建模能力，为过挤压研究提供了更严格的实验基础。未来工作包括将f-稳定性扩展到核方法以模拟真实数据，以及放宽Ax1以引入噪声。

Abstract: Empirical claims about the connection between over-squashing and long-range interactions in GNNs, can only be trusted if the benchmarks used to validate them genuinely require long-range interactions. The de-facto standard, the Long Range Graph Benchmark, has been repeatedly shown to be saturated by tuned short-range models, with existing synthetic alternatives being tied to specific topologies. As such, there is a lack of principled certificate of long-rangedness on arbitrary graphs. This state reflects the absence of a precise characterization of long-ranged benchmarks. We address this fundamental gap by introducing four verifiable axioms: Predictability, Tightness, Strictly $k$-Range, and Topology-Invariance, that any task claiming to test $k$-hop interactions must satisfy. We formally prove that violating any one of them admits failure modes that undermine conclusions drawn from the task. Based on these axioms, we introduce TRIP (Truly Ranged Interactions Problem) and its generalisation GRIP (Generally Ranged Interactions Problem), constructive procedures that turn any graph into a provably long-ranged task by drawing features from stable distributions. Moreover, by construction, GRIP admits a closed-form, per-range Maximum-Likelihood oracle that yields the first a priori per-range lower bound on test error available on any benchmark. Using our framework, we: (i) audit 4 common long-range benchmarks and identify their failures modes with respect to our axioms; (ii) on TRIP-instantiated topologies, we find a popular notion of curvature is uncorrelated with GNN performance, supporting topological-vs-computational bottleneck distinction; and (iii) we show that a novel benchmark's over-squashing measures factors beyond pure long-rangedness. Code to use the framework and reproduce experiments is released this https URL .

</details>


### [307] [Mastering Atari 2600 Games with Discovered Options](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.03604)
*Erik M. Lintunen,Marlos C. Machado*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: Wayfarer 是一个通用的、领域无关的在线深度强化学习智能体，通过从高维观测中进行拉普拉斯表示学习（Laplacian representation learning）来自动发现选项（options），并在 Atari 2600 的"挑战性游戏集"（challenging set）上取得了单流智能体（single-stream agent）的最先进性能，尤其在需要长视野探索和策略性行为的游戏（如 Montezuma's Revenge 和 Private Eye）中表现突出。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 时间抽象（temporal abstractions）以选项（options）的形式被长期视为加速信用分配（credit assignment）、促进探索和实现泛化的机制。然而，开发在大规模高维领域中有效的通用选项发现方法仍是根本性挑战。现有方法要么局限于简单领域，要么依赖手工或准符号表示，要么相比不使用选项几乎没有改进。本文旨在开发一种能从高维观测中在线、自动发现有效选项的通用深度强化学习方法。

Method: Wayfarer 耦合了三个同时在线训练、从单一经验流中学习的神经网络：(1) 表征网络（representation network）通过多步逆动力学预测（multi-step inverse-dynamics prediction）进行正则化，近似代理中心（agent-centric）的拉普拉斯特征空间中的特征函数（eigenfunctions），使用 ALLO（Augmented Lagrangian Laplacian Objective）目标；(2) 技能网络（skill network）为每个非平凡特征函数学习一对选项（增加和减少方向），通过表征求得的内在奖励进行训练；(3) 主网络（main network）在扩展了选项的原始动作集合上学习最大化任务奖励，使用 IQN（Implicit Quantile Networks）和 Rainbow 的组件结合分布式 Q 学习。三个网络形成良性循环（virtuous loop）：表征定义选项的内在奖励，选项扩展动作集塑造经验收集，经验反过来改进表征和选项。

Result: Wayfarer 在 Atari 2600 挑战性游戏集（10 个游戏）上以单一超参数配置进行训练，5 次运行，200M 帧。在单流智能体（Rainbow、IQN）中达到最先进的聚合性能（人类归一化分数的均值 0.54、IQM 0.65、中位数 0.69），并匹配了使用多个并行环境实例和基于模型的 DreamerV3。在 Montezuma's Revenge（人类归一化中位数约 0.69，超过 DreamerV3）和 Private Eye（IQM 38,749 分，略低于 DreamerV3 的 28,539 但优于 IQN 的 171）上获得最大收益。消融实验表明：学习选项贡献了 100M 帧时 2.51 倍的中位数改进；从代理中心特征空间学习拉普拉斯表征有帮助；学习选项值优于仅将选项用于探索；NoisyNet 优于 ε-贪心策略。同时验证了发现的选项能改善探索（跨越危险水坑、洞穴区域等）、加速信用分配（在 Montezuma's Revenge 中将约 70 个原始动作决策压缩为少量高层决策），并泛化到未见过的设置（在仅见过第一个房间时学到的选项可在未见过的房间中沿绳索移动并避开致命骷髅）。

Conclusion: Wayfarer 是在线深度强化学习中通过拉普拉斯表示学习发现并有效利用选项的通用方法。它在 Atari 挑战性游戏集上兑现了选项的承诺：同时改善探索、加速信用分配并泛化到未见设置，使得复杂策略的学习显著加快，并达到与基于模型的 DreamerV3 相当的性能，仅使用单一经验流，无需领域特定知识或语义监督。未来的工作方向包括结合帧堆叠之外的记忆机制、通过如 Normalize-and-Project（NaP）维持可塑性（在 Montezuma's Revenge 上 200M 帧内达到 7,000+ 分）以及使用发现的选项进行规划。作者认为 Wayfarer 是一个能在多个时间抽象层次推理并从环境中持续发现新知识的通用智能体的原型。

Abstract: Temporal abstractions, often instantiated as options, have long been regarded as a mechanism for accelerating credit assignment, facilitating exploration, and enabling generalisation in reinforcement learning (RL). However, developing general option discovery methods that are effective in large-scale, high-dimensional domains remains a fundamental challenge. Existing option discovery methods are either confined to relatively simple domains, depend on handcrafted or quasi-symbolic representations, or offer little improvement over learning without options. We present Wayfarer, a general, domain-agnostic, online deep RL agent that discovers options through Laplacian representation learning from high-dimensional observations and leverages them for control. We show that the resulting options simultaneously improve exploration, accelerate credit assignment, and generalise effectively to unseen settings, enabling substantially faster learning of complex policies. Wayfarer achieves state-of-the-art performance among single-stream agents on the most challenging Atari 2600 games, with the largest gains in games that require long-horizon exploration and strategic behaviour, such as Montezuma's Revenge and Private Eye.

</details>


### [308] [UniIntervene++: An Adaptive Intervention Agent for Efficient Real-World Reinforcement Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.03620)
*Yudong Lin,Haoyuan Deng,Zhuoxuan Yuan,Zaijia Yang,Yuanjiang Xue,Ziwei Wang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: UniIntervene++ 是一个面向真实世界在线强化学习的自适应干预代理，通过统一的SMDP框架学习在自主执行与异构辅助行为之间动态分配控制权，在五个真实机器人操作任务上以89.67%的平均成功率超越基线，并将人工干预率降至0.77%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在线强化学习训练机器人策略时，所需的辅助会随策略能力的变化而变化。现有干预策略基于离线估计或固定决策规则，无法适应策略的在线演进，导致早期有效或后期过度的辅助与当前策略能力不匹配。需要一个能在在线RL过程中学习分配控制的统一干预代理。

Method: 1) 统一干预策略学习：将演进的RL策略、轨迹修正（TC）和任务结构化的CodePolicy（CP）作为Options在统一半马尔可夫决策过程（SMDP）中，使用基于可用性掩码的Double-DQN调度器在线学习其相对价值；2) 能力自适应干预（Adaptive RL Probe）：周期性通过无辅助执行探测RL策略，根据路径投影进度与偏差动态调整探测窗口B，直接获取策略当前能力的证据；3) 耦合经验学习：辅助行为产生的经验同时路由至在线回放缓冲区和示范缓冲区，通过离线策略混合训练RL策略，形成数据层面的耦合循环。

Result: 在Ring Transfer、Tube Insertion、USB Insertion、Wipe Whiteboard和Towel Folding五项UR7e真实机器人操作任务上，平均成功率达89.67%，超越最佳基线6个百分点；人工干预率仅0.77%，相对最佳基线AutoSERL降低94.6%；95.62%–100%的干预步骤由自动化Options完成。Ring Transfer任务中RL策略控制占比从35.78%上升至90.51%。消融实验表明移除CodePolicy成功率归零，移除Trajectory Correction降至50%/47%，固定先验随机调度器降至75%/80%。

Conclusion: UniIntervene++ 证明自适应干预代理能够在在线RL过程中联合决定何时干预、如何干预以及何时交还控制权，无需单独的离线干预学习阶段。该框架显著降低操作员负担并逐步将控制权归还给RL策略，为真实世界高效在线强化学习提供了可扩展的解决方案。

Abstract: Online reinforcement learning (RL) enables robot policies to improve through physical interaction, but the assistance they require changes as their competence evolves. Existing intervention strategies based on offline estimates or fixed decision rules can therefore become mismatched to the current policy. To address this, we propose UniIntervene++, an adaptive intervention agent that learns to allocate control between autonomous execution and heterogeneous assisted behaviors during online RL. Specifically, UniIntervene++ first formulates the evolving RL policy, trajectory correction, and a task-structured CodePolicy as Options in a unified semi-Markov decision process and learns their relative values online. Building on this, competence-adaptive intervention periodically probes the RL policy through unassisted execution, keeping control allocation responsive to its evolving capability. Finally, coupled experience learning allows assisted behaviors to improve the RL policy, whose evolving outcomes in turn reshape future intervention decisions. In this way, UniIntervene++ jointly determines when to intervene, how to intervene, and when to return control as the RL policy improves. Across five real-world manipulation tasks, UniIntervene++ achieves an average success rate of 89.67%, outperforming all baselines by at least 6 percentage points, while reducing human intervention to 0.77%, a relative reduction of at least 94.6% from the best baseline. Code is available in our \href{ this https URL }{GitHub repository}.

</details>


### [309] [Broken scale symmetries in undercomplete linear autoencoders](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.03640)
*Farhad Pashakhanloo,Jacob A. Zavatone-Veth*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文研究欠完备线性自编码器中SGD对尺度不变性的破坏行为，发现其解几何结构导致解码器权重偏好漂移，并最终在稳定性边界处饱和。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 神经网络损失函数存在连续对称性，梯度流保持这些对称性但有限步长SGD会打破它们。此前工作已记录SGD在平衡梯度噪声或最小化波动方面的偏好，但欠完备线性自编码器中尺度漂移的具体方向和终点尚不清楚。

Method: 以欠完备(k<d)线性自编码器 f(x)=WUx 为可解模型，分析其在PCA解流形上的SGD动力学。证明在流形上Q=W⊤W−UU⊤的单调增长性（方程4），利用快慢时间尺度分离推导有效尺度动力学ODE（方程5），使用Lambert W函数给出解析解（闭式解，方程6），计算Hessian谱分析稳定性边界与锐度。

Result: 1. 在PCA解流形上，Q变化恒为半正定（通过方程4），即解码器权重的有向尺度漂移；2. 有效动力学为ODE ∂τS+S⁻¹∂τSS⁻¹=S⁻¹/²CS⁻¹/²，尺度沿不同PC方向各向异性增长；3. 增长最终被稳定性边界ημ=κ(κ≈2)所限制，所有尺度饱和于s_a≈κ/(ηλ₁)；4. 不同锐度度量方向相反：最大特征值方向锐度增加，但批锐度（batch sharpness）随尺度减小。

Conclusion: 欠完备线性自编码器提供了SGD如何将残余梯度噪声转化为沿等效解流形的有向运动的实例。尺度漂移的方向由解几何结构（PCA投影）决定而非梯度噪声平衡，最终端点由有限步长的稳定性边界动态选择。这一现象表明渐进锐化（progressive sharpening）可以在不再学习函数的情况下，沿对称性流形发生。

Abstract: Neural network loss landscapes have many symmetries, which are preserved by gradient flow but broken by finite-stepsize stochastic gradient descent (SGD). A canonical example of such a symmetry is scale in homogeneous networks: one can scale up the parameters in one layer and down in the next without changing the network output. Previous work has documented cases in which SGD breaks this symmetry in favor of balancing gradient noise or minimizing fluctuations. Here, we show that the solution geometry of undercomplete linear autoencoders instead selects a preferred sign for scale drift: on the PCA solution manifold, SGD favors large decoder weights. This directed scale drift occurs on a slow timescale, and its dynamics admit an analytically-tractable effective description. However, it cannot continue indefinitely: increasing scale eventually drives the dynamics towards a finite-stepsize stability boundary. The resulting solutions are sharper than a balanced baseline in the sense of the maximum eigenvalue of the loss Hessian, but different sharpness measures can move in opposing directions. Thus, undercomplete autoencoders give a concrete illustration of how loss geometry can convert residual gradient noise into directed motion along a manifold of functionally-equivalent solutions.

</details>


### [310] [IDRF: Inverse-Distilled Reward Fine-tuning of Masked Discrete Diffusion Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.03641)
*Vladislav Gromadskii,David Li,Samson Gourevitch,Yazid Janati,Eric Moulines,Maxim Panov,Alexander Korotin*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: IDRF提出了一种面向少步掩码离散扩散模型的奖励微调框架，通过逆蒸馏正则化替代难解的序列级KL惩罚，结合轨迹级策略梯度，在DNA、图像、文本任务上以最高32倍少的去噪步数实现高奖励并缓解奖励黑客问题。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 掩码离散扩散模型（MDM）是自回归生成的有力替代，但迭代采样成本大，且序列似然难解使奖励微调中的KL正则化难以施加。纯奖励微调会破坏模型未被奖励度量的属性（即奖励黑客问题），而现有的KL近似方法要么依赖似然代理，要么将正则器绑定到参考模型的采样路径，无法让few-step生成器保留自己的采样器。

Method: 1) 理论层面：从标准reverse-KL正则化目标出发，用逆蒸馏间隙（参考denoiser的NELBO与最优辅助denoiser的NELBO之差）替代序列级KL。命题1证明在最优辅助denoiser下，群体逆蒸馏损失是学生分布与参考分布KL散度的上界。2) 实践层面：采用轨迹式代理，无需参考模型rollout，学生保留自有少步采样器；将few-step生成视为有限时域MDP，使用clipped leave-one-out策略梯度优化奖励；辅助denoiser在学生自身rollout状态上拟合，正则项与奖励项复用同一轨迹，最小化ℓ_R + λ·L_ID。3) 计算上只需一次学生评估加参考与辅助各一次前向传播。

Result: 在三个领域取得一致结果：(a) 调控DNA设计（200bp，K=8步）：IDRF在Pred-Activity达7.22、ATAC-Acc 95.3%（与128步SDPO的94.8%相当），3-mer相关性0.68，远优于16×步数预算下的所有基线；无L_ID时活动性升到7.68但ATAC-Acc骤降至37.8%并退化为缺失T碱基的CA/CG重复序列。(b) CLIP引导MaskGIT图像生成（K=4步）：IDRF在CLIP上达27.74，ImageReward从参考的-0.73提升至0.88，PickScore 22.11、HPSv2.1 27.72均优于128步参考与无L_ID消融。(c) 情感引导Amazon评论文本（16/32步）：无正则RLOO 90.6%不终止于EOS、生成重复无结尾文本；IDRF 100%发射EOS，归一化熵0.90–0.92，对真实一星评论的梯度矩距离10.9（比RLOO的28.8低2.6×）。正则权重λ_ID扫描显示活动性与ATAC-Acc间的可控权衡。

Conclusion: IDRF为少步掩码离散扩散生成器的奖励微调提供了首个理论上界保证（最优辅助下L_ID ≥ D_KL(p_θ‖p_ref)）且实际可行的框架，无需参考似然或参考rollout，无需预训练数据或奖励梯度；在DNA、图像、文本上以最多32×少的去噪步数获得高奖励并有效缓解奖励黑客，保持参考模型的属性。局限性：学生与辅助之间的对抗式min-max优化可能引入不稳定性与更新平衡敏感度，辅助增加训练成本；实际代理对单步补全分布的混合提供KL保证，但对最终采样分布的控制仍是开放问题。

Abstract: Masked discrete diffusion models offer a promising alternative to autoregressive generation, but iterative sampling can be costly, and intractable sequence likelihoods complicate reward fine-tuning. We introduce IDRF, a framework for reward fine-tuning of few-step masked discrete diffusion generators. Starting from a standard reverse-KL-regularized objective, IDRF replaces the intractable sequence-level KL penalty with inverse-distillation regularization. With an optimal auxiliary denoiser, we prove that the population inverse-distillation loss upper-bounds the sequence-level KL divergence to the reference distribution. IDRF optimizes a trajectory-based surrogate of this loss without reference-model rollouts, so the student keeps its own few-step sampler. We view few-step generation as a finite-horizon Markov decision process and optimize reward with a clipped policy-gradient objective over the student's trajectories. Across DNA, image, and text generation, IDRF achieves high reward with up to $32\times$ fewer denoising steps than the reference while mitigating reward hacking and preserving sample quality.

</details>


### [311] [On the Convergence of Success Conditioning for Policy Optimization](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.03642)
*Matthew Brun,Xu Andy Sun*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文研究"成功条件化"(Success Conditioning, SC)策略更新规则在马尔可夫决策过程(MDP)中的收敛性。SC通过增加产生成功结果的动作概率来改进随机环境下的决策策略。文章证明SC在一大类MDP上收敛到受限制的最优策略,并推导出在单周期MDP上$\mathcal{O}(\log(1/\varepsilon))$次迭代、在折扣MDP上$\mathcal{O}(1/\varepsilon^p)$次迭代即可达到$\varepsilon$-最优策略的收敛速率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 成功条件化(SC)广泛应用于现代AI中,如LLM后训练、机器人控制、生成模型的拒绝采样微调以及决策Transformer等。然而,SC的极限行为和收敛速率此前未被严格推导,Russo(2019)甚至将其作为一个开放问题提出。本文旨在填补这一理论空白。

Method: 1. **问题建模**:在标准MDP框架下定义SC更新规则 $\pi_{k+1}(a|s) = \pi_k(a|s) Q_k(s,a)/V_k(s)$。
2. **极限行为**:利用单调性(Lemma 1)、AM-GM不等式以及闭式表达(等式7)证明比值 $V_k/V_k'$ 的均值收敛到1,从而证明 $V_k \to V^*$ (Theorem 1),即SC收敛到初始策略所支持动作集内的最优策略。
3. **单周期MDP收敛速率**:利用初始概率分配和动作奖励比值,推导出 $\mathcal{O}(\log(1/\varepsilon))$ 和 $\mathcal{O}(1/\varepsilon)$ 两种收敛上界(Theorem 2)。
4. **折扣MDP收敛速率**:将SC迭代分组为近似值迭代(AVI)块,通过Lemma 2(AVI误差传播)和Proposition 2(SC到AVI误差界)以及可调参数 $B$ 进行误差分配,最终在Theorem 3中给出 $\mathcal{O}(1/\varepsilon^p)$ 的显式收敛速率。

Result: 1. **Theorem 1**: 在假设1成立的MDP上,SC值函数收敛到受限制的最优值函数。
2. **Theorem 2**: 单周期MDP(等价于 $\gamma=0$)上,达到 $\varepsilon$-最优策略的迭代次数上界为 $\mathcal{O}(\log(1/\varepsilon))$。
3. **Theorem 3**: 折扣MDP($\gamma < 1$)上,达到 $\varepsilon$-最优策略的迭代次数上界为 $\mathcal{O}(1/\varepsilon^p)$,其中指数 $p$ 由问题数据和参数 $B$ 决定。
4. **Corollary 1**: 通过选取 $B = \min\{\gamma/\Phi^2, (1-\gamma)/2\}$ 给出无参数显式收敛速率,并展示两种不同机制(基于 $\gamma$ 和 $\Phi$ 的不同关系)。

Conclusion: 本文解决了关于成功条件化(SC)收敛性的若干开放问题,严格证明了SC在一大类MDP中收敛到受限制的最优策略,并给出了单周期和折扣MDP的显式迭代复杂度。虽然与值迭代和策略迭代等方法的线性/二次收敛相比,SC的收敛速率较慢,但这是其"保守性"的体现——SC不会显著偏离初始策略,且保持随机策略结构,这有利于在线策略学习和稳定性的提升。本文还与Štrupl等人关于奖励加权回归(RWR)的研究进行了详细对比。

Abstract: Success conditioning is a strategy for improving decision-making policies in stochastic environments; it updates a policy by increasing the probability of taking actions that yield successful outcomes. Success conditioning is common to many reinforcement learning applications, yet its limiting behavior and convergence rates are not well understood. In this work, we demonstrate that success conditioning converges to an optimal policy on a broad class of Markov decision processes (MDPs). We also derive convergence rates in some common settings. For discounted MDPs, we prove convergence within $\mathcal{O}(1/\varepsilon^p)$ iterations to an $\varepsilon$-optimal policy, where the exponent $p$ depends on problem data. For single-period MDPs, such a policy is obtained within $\mathcal{O}(\log(1/\varepsilon))$ iterations.

</details>


### [312] [When May a Bandit Leave Its Anchor? E-Process-Authorized Thompson Sampling under Non-stationarity](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.03646)
*Mayand Gulati,Kerong Wang,WeiChen Au*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出e-ATS（E-Process-Authorized Thompson Sampling），一种用于非平稳多臂老虎机的方法。它通过 anytime-valid 的 e-process（一种序列检验方法）来授权（authorize）短记忆折扣Beta后验状态影响动作选择，并以乐观 Thompson sampling（OTS）为锚点（anchor，即默认策略）。在静态 Beta-Bernoulli 先验预测模型下，e-ATC在任何时刻偏离OTS的概率不超过预设的 α_E。在注册套件上授权机制使归一化动态伪遗憾（pseudo-regret，即累计机会成本）降低27.7%；而在文献回放套件上反而增加8.2%。实验表明证据控制适应何时开始，而非是否总有帮助。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在非平稳环境中，历史数据可能失效。现有方法采用折扣、窗口或预定重启动，但何时应该遗忘历史、允许策略偏离可信的静态锚点缺乏理论控制。作者希望用 anytime-valid e-process 将"何时允许偏离"转化为具有概率保证的统计授权问题。

Method: 1. 每个臂维护两个Beta状态：长记忆后验（锚点）和短记忆折扣后验（γ_S=0.995，有效记忆约200轮）。
2. 构建臂特异的 e-process E_{k,n}：在几何网格候选变点处计算似然比，加权求和（权重 π_j=1/[j(j+1)]）。
3. 当某臂的 e-process 首次跨过阈值 K/α_E 时，授权锁存器 C^E 永久置1。
4. 维护相关性分数 r_{k,n}（近期奖励与长记忆后验均值的指数加权偏差），控制适应强度。
5. 决策权重 w_{k,t} 由授权锁存、相关性分数和保留数据量共同决定。
6. 授权前 e-ATS 完全等价于 OTS；授权后短记忆动态自适应。

Result: 主要定理：路径上 τ_dep ≥ τ_auth，且在Beta(1,1)先验预测静态模型下 P(τ_dep ≤ T) ≤ α_E。实验：在注册套件（16,380个非平稳环境）上，e-ATS遗憾0.0390优于开放斜坡（open ramp）0.0540；在回放套件（4,500个文献匹配运行）上，e-ATS遗憾0.1530劣于开放斜坡0.1414。e-ATS在17种回放基线中平均排名第9.72。在1,820个平稳环境中，e-ATS仅授权一次，遗憾与OTS持平（0.01157），远低于开放斜坡的0.02937。

Conclusion: 1. e-ATS提供了任何时候有效的统计保证，将偏离锚点的概率限制在 α_E 内，无需根据数据估计定阈值。
2. 在平稳环境中几乎从不偏离锚点，在大多数注册的非平稳场景中减少遗憾。
3. 授权的效果具有环境依赖性：在文献回放套件上开放斜坡表现更优。
5. 证据的阈值"何时"而非"是否"始终有益，授权机制重要，但其遗憾影响取决于具体环境分布。

Abstract: Stationarity rewards memory, but after a change the same history can mislead. We ask when forgetting should be permitted. E-process-authorized Thompson sampling (e-ATS) gives each arm full-history and discounted Beta states. An anytime-valid e-process first authorizes the discounted state, then a reversible relevance score controls its influence. Before authorization, e-ATS exactly follows optimistic Thompson sampling (OTS). Under a Beta-Bernoulli prior-predictive stationary model, e-ATS's probability of ever departing from OTS is at most the chosen $\alpha_E$, without fitted thresholds. Relative to e-ATS, removing authorization increased mean normalized dynamic pseudo-regret by $38.4\%$ on the registered suite but reduced it by $7.5\%$ on the literature-derived replay suite. Therefore, evidence controls when adaptation begins, not whether it always helps.

</details>


### [313] [Forecasting from Counterfactual Simulator Rollouts: A Sim2Real Evaluation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.03662)
*Angel Wang,Dominique Perrault-Joncas,Alvaro Maggiar,Dean Foster,Carson Eisenach*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文研究在部署新决策策略时预测模型的冷启动问题，提出利用仿真器生成的反事实rollout训练预报器，然后在真实部署数据上进行回测评估。通过两个真实库存控制部署验证，基于仿真器训练的预报器比基于历史真实数据训练的预报器具有更低的MAPE，且部署后的在线校准可进一步降低误差。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 部署新决策策略时，预测目标依赖于策略动作的模型面临冷启动困境——历史观测反映旧策略，新策略下的真实观测尚未产生。仿真器可通过在新策略下进行反事实rollout生成训练数据，但这种仿真训练模型的Sim2Real迁移效果尚需实证验证。

Method: 1) 使用Exo-IDP（外生交互决策过程）仿真器，在固定目标补货策略下，通过截断Haar小波基采样生成多样化的容量成本轨迹，驱动仿真器产生反事实状态-动作-结果轨迹；2) 训练一个响应预报器 ψθ，输入历史窗口特征 Xt 和提议的成本轨迹 λ，输出聚合进库量预测 Ĵ（Global Aggregate与Bottom-Up两种，基于扩张因果CNN编码器-解码器架构）；3) 在两个历史真实部署上回测评估：零样本迁移（仿真训练 vs. 离策略历史数据基线），以及部署后利用早期真实观测的扩展窗口线性回归校准。

Result: 两个真实部署（Study 1约2万产品年部署，Study 2约10万产品三月部署）上：1) 仿真器对聚合进库量的保真度为11.8-13.2% MAPE，订单和进库量组件层面校准存在显著偏差；2) 零样本迁移：仿真训练的预报器MAPE比历史基线降低1.2-3.1个百分点（Study 1）和12.5-18.7个百分点（Study 2），所有预测期限均更优；3) 在线校准：部署后利用早期真实观测的回归校准进一步降低MAPE最多2.5个百分点（Study 2从9.4%降至6.9%），效果集中在三周以内的短期期限。

Conclusion: 实证证明仿真器生成的反事实数据可以支持新策略下的冷启动预报，即使仿真器本身存在可测量的偏差（订单和进库量的校准斜率显著低于1）。仿真训练作为训练数据生成器有价值，但保真度指标本身不足以衡量其训练价值。部署后的轻量级校准可与仿真冷启动互补，但效果并非在所有设置中均匀出现。该结论限于两个供应链部署，推广到其他仿真器和领域仍需进一步验证。

Abstract: Deploying a new decision policy creates a cold-start problem for prediction models whose targets depend on the policy's actions: historical observations reflect earlier policies, while real observations under the new policy are not yet available. Simulation offers a way to address this gap by rolling out the target policy across counterfactual scenarios and using the resulting trajectories to learn how the system responds to those controls. The simulation-to-reality (Sim2Real) transfer of this simulator-trained model can then be backtested by evaluating it against real observations from past deployments. Using two real-world inventory-control deployments, we evaluate this process from three angles: simulator fidelity, zero-shot transfer to real behavior, and adaptation as real target-policy observations accumulate. The simulator-trained forecaster achieves lower point-estimate mean absolute percentage error (MAPE) than the same architecture trained on historical real data, reducing MAPE by 1.2-3.1 percentage points in Study 1 and 12.5-18.7 points in Study 2. After deployment, lightweight calibration using early real observations further reduces error by up to 2.5 percentage points. These results provide empirical evidence that simulator-generated counterfactual data can support cold-start forecasting under a new policy, and the resulting model can be further refined as real deployment data become available.

</details>


### [314] [Pivot-SD: Efficient Self-Distillation for Masked Diffusion Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.03665)
*Seo Hyun Kim,Sunwoo Hong,Younwoo Choi,Chen-Hao Chao,Se-Young Yun,Rahul G. Krishnan*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: Pivot-SD 是一种面向掩码扩散语言模型（dLM）的离线自蒸馏框架，仅在去噪过程中对那些显著降低剩余掩码位置不确定性（即信息增益最大的步骤）所提交的"关键令牌（pivots）"施加监督。成功轨迹的关键令牌用交叉熵训练，失败轨迹的关键令牌用非似然（unlikelihood）训练，仅用 200 个问题和 4 次采样就在数学和代码基准上超越了全序列 SFT 和预算匹配的扩散 RL 基线。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 掩码扩散语言模型在推理中展现出并行潜力，但其后训练面临独特的信用分配难题：在去噪过程中，仅有少量"承诺"会急剧降低剩余掩码位置的不确定性并塑造整个响应。现有后训练方法要么对最终文本统一加权，要么对整个去噪步分配奖励，未能利用这一信号选择应被训练的关键令牌。

Method: 1) 轨迹生成：从冻结的基线模型 θ₀ 采样完整去噪轨迹 τ，记录每步状态 M_t、活跃掩码位置 B_t 及提交位置 U_t；2) 关键令牌选择：以信息增益 g(t) 衡量每步承诺前后剩余掩码位置的平均熵下降，选择得分最高的 K=10 个步骤的提交令牌作为 pivots，记录其提交时的部分掩码状态 M_t；3) 训练目标：对成功轨迹的 pivots 使用交叉熵 ℓ⁺_p，对失败轨迹的 pivots 使用令牌级非似然惩罚 ℓ⁻_p，其余位置不计算损失，构成离线数据集 D_pivot 并以此微调模型。负样本权重 λ_neg 根据正负轨迹比例设定（MATH=1, GSM8K=5, 代码=0.02）。

Result: 在 LLaDA-8B-Instruct 上，仅用 200 个训练问题、每个 4 次采样、1000 个优化步，Pivot-SD 在 MATH500、GSM8K、HumanEval+、MBPP+ 四个基准上均取得 256 令牌预算下的最高平均准确率（MATH 37.47 vs 基线最佳 35.47, GSM8K 79.51 vs 77.63, HumanEval+ 40.43 vs 35.78, MBPP+ 47.12 vs 46.32），优于全序列 SFT 以及使用 10 倍问题数和 5 倍步数的 diffu-GRPO/wd1++ 等扩散 RL 基线；同时仅监督响应预算的约 3.9%（每轨迹 10 个令牌），计算量比预算匹配 RL 少约 1.65 倍，墙钟时间约为 5000 步 diffu-GRPO 的 1/8；在 Dream-7B-Instruct 上同样获得提升，且具有最佳的跨域平均迁移准确率（48.61）。消融实验表明，将损失限制在单个 IG 选择的 pivot 上、并在失败轨迹上施加定位化的非似然，是性能提升的关键因素。

Conclusion: Pivot-SD 证明了对掩码扩散语言模型中由信息增益定位的关键承诺进行定位化、自蒸馏式的离线监督的有效性。其以极少的训练数据（200 题）和极少监督令牌（约 4% 响应预算）即可超越全序列 SFT 与在线扩散 RL，是一种高效、稳定的离线后训练方案，为 dLM 上的信用分配提供了新的解决思路。

Abstract: Masked diffusion language models (dLMs) offer a promising parallel alternative to autoregressive models for complex reasoning. However, they face a distinct credit-assignment challenge, since a few commitments during denoising sharply reduce the uncertainty over the remaining masked positions and shape much of the response. Most post-training recipes for dLMs do not use this signal to decide which tokens to train on: they typically train on the final text or assign rewards to whole denoising steps, rather than selecting the individual commitments that shape the response. We introduce Pivot-SD, an efficient offline self-distillation framework that supervises only these high-impact commitments (pivots). Pivot-SD selects pivots using an information-gain metric measuring uncertainty reduction over the remaining masked positions. Pivots from successful trajectories are trained with cross-entropy, and pivots from failed trajectories with targeted unlikelihood, leaving the rest of the failed trajectory untouched. Using only 200 questions and four rollouts each, Pivot-SD improves LLaDA-8B-Instruct over full-sequence SFT and budget-matched diffusion RL baselines across math and code benchmarks.

</details>


### [315] [Planning to Learn](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.03667)
*Ian Osband*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出"horizon loss"（视野损失），将分类训练视为在有限预算下的序贯资源分配问题。通过截断交叉熵所代表的"耐心精度"积分到一个随剩余学习预算收缩的有限视野，horizon loss 在训练初期近似交叉熵，后期趋向精确策略梯度。在 MNIST 和 ImageNet 上的实验显示其优于交叉熵，且优势随标签噪声增大而扩大。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 精确策略梯度（即便排除了探索、信用分配和动作采样噪声）在分类任务上仍输给交叉熵——ResNet-50 上仅 4.2% vs 62%。作者认为根因在于梯度是"短视"的：它只评估当前一步的收益，而忽略了每次更新会改变下一步更新的位置，因此更新的价值取决于还剩多少训练。交叉熵虽更"耐心"，但也过度乐观——它把所有例子都视为有无限学习时间，从而浪费预算在"无望案例"（lost causes）上。

Method: 1. 将分类重构为资源分配模型：N 个独立样本各有 logit gap z_i，学习者有 H 单位预算分配。
2. 揭示两种权重规则的失败：
   - 精确策略梯度权重 σ'(z) = p(1-p)（即时斜率）→ 抛光陷阱
   - 交叉熵权重 1-p（剩余误差）→ 无望陷阱
3. 提出 horizon loss：L_H(z) = C_H(z)/(1-e^{-H})，其中 C_H(z) = ∫₀^H [1-σ(z+s)]ds。
   - 负梯度权重为 σ(z+H)(1-p)，即"剩余误差 × 视野内成功概率"
   - H→∞ 时退化为交叉熵；H→0 时退化为精确策略梯度
4. 在神经网络中将剩余视野 H_t 估计为未来学习率之和 × 标定常数 κ（MNIST κ=1，ImageNet κ=3）。
5. 规划算子 P_H[ℓ](z) = ∫₀^H ℓ(z+s)ds 可应用于任何损失，衍生出 horizon cross-entropy 用于降低 NLL。

Result: 1. 理论（分配模型）：
   - 命题1：最优分配随预算变化反转——短预算给简单样本，长预算给困难样本
   - 命题2：精确策略梯度在抛光陷阱中仅获得 4σ'(a) 的最优增益（指数衰减）；交叉熵在无望陷阱中增益趋于零
   - 命题3：horizon loss 同时逃出两个陷阱——抛光遗憾 ≤ 2ae⁻ᵃ；无望遗憾 ≤ HMe^{H-a}
2. 实验：
   - MNIST（MLP，30 seeds）：horizon loss 降低 top-1 误差 0.16±0.04 点
   - ImageNet（ResNet-50/101、ViT-S/16，平坦学习率）：top-1 准确率提升 1.0–2.4 点；ResNet-50 期望准确率从 4.2%（精确策略）跃升至 67.5%（horizon）
   - 余弦衰减下增益收窄至约 0.6 点
   - 标签噪声：ResNet-50 上增益从 10% 噪声的 3.3 点扩大到 50% 噪声的 7.3 点
   - horizon cross-entropy 将 ResNet-50 测试 NLL 从 1.467 降至 1.364
   - 消融：固定/增长视野无法复现增益；增益确需"先长后短"的视野

Conclusion: 分类训练本质是有限预算的序贯分配问题。horizon loss 通过将损失与剩余学习预算耦合，在训练初期保留交叉熵的"耐心"，在后期通过抛弃无望案例获得精确策略梯度的效率。这一"先长后短"的视野机制是改进的关键。该框架同样适用于 RL：随着训练推进向期望奖励插值。局限包括：horizon 来自启发式标定而非优化器动力学推导，且分离式规划在对称同质样本上必失败（命题6）。开放问题是如何在采样动作的 RL 中估计成功概率与剩余学习价值以进行规划。

Abstract: Policy-gradient methods are central to modern reinforcement learning, including LLM post-training. When they struggle, the usual suspects are exploration, credit assignment and action-sampling noise. Classification has none of them. A classifier is a policy whose expected reward, its \emph{expected accuracy}, is the probability it assigns to the correct label, and because that label is known, the policy gradient is exact and smooth. Yet exact policy gradient loses to cross-entropy, even on expected accuracy. The exact gradient is myopic: it values an update only by what it buys now, but each update also sets where the next one starts, so an update's value depends on how much learning remains. Viewed this way, cross-entropy is patient accuracy, the total error an example would pay if its log-odds rose at unit speed forever, while exact policy gradient is the zero-horizon limit. Truncating this total at the learning that remains yields the horizon loss, a one-line change that moves from cross-entropy toward exact policy gradient as training runs out. In a simple allocation model, it provably escapes the trap that catches each endpoint. On MNIST and on ImageNet with ResNet-50, ResNet-101 and ViT-S/16, the horizon loss improves top-1 accuracy over cross-entropy at a flat learning rate, and the gain grows with label noise.

</details>


### [316] [Simulation-Free Learning of Population Dynamics with Wasserstein Lagrangian Residuals](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.03679)
*Fedor Sergeev,Markus Heinonen,Daniel Waxman,Tim Cooijmans,Ricardo Baptista,Dmitry Batenkov,Eli Bingham*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出Double-Stitch，一种用于从无配对快照中学习Wasserstein拉格朗日群体动力学的无模拟方法。它通过沿学习路径惩罚运动方程残差来训练，结合Clebsch变分原理处理非梯度速度场，相比基于模拟的WLM方法训练速度提升4-14倍，并在多数任务上表现相当或更优。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 从无配对时间快照中学习概率分布的动力学演化是单细胞生物学、动物行为和流体力学的核心问题。现有方法存在局限：Wasserstein梯度流（WGF）方法无法描述保守或周期动力学；基于模拟的Wasserstein拉格朗日力学（WLM）方法虽然能处理保守系统，但每步训练都需运行数值求解器，计算开销巨大。亟需一种既能处理一般拉格朗日动力学（包含非梯度速度场），又无需在线模拟的无模拟训练方法。

Method: 1. 理论推导：使用Clebsch变分原理（含连续性约束和粒子标签输运约束）从Caldirola-Kanai作用量推导出一般速度场（非必须为梯度场）下的运动方程，得到Lagrangian残差公式。2. 参数化：用核密度估计（KDE）参数化分布曲线，势能包含外势、对数熵和粒子相互作用项，分别用神经网络参数化。3. 损失函数：数据损失（KL散度）+ 残差损失（沿粒子轨迹的运动方程平方误差），加上可选的初始速度约束。4. 优化：直接对轨迹节点位置、KDE带宽、势能网络参数和摩擦系数进行有限差分离散化，通过Adam优化器联合训练，无需模拟轨迹演化。

Result: 在合成数据集（保守谐振、阻尼谐振、梯度流）上，Double-Stitch在保守流上W1误差从Stitching的1.324降至0.389。在单细胞胚胎体（EB）数据集的三个评估协议（LPO、L1O、L2O）上，Double-Stock匹配或优于最佳梯度方法和WLM。在海洋涡旋数据集上，插值任务中静态Double-Stitch匹配WLM重运行；预测任务中WLM在pushforward下最优。训练速度比WLM快4-14倍（EB上3.93-11.50分钟 vs 15.80-53.92分钟；海洋上6.81-10.44分钟 vs 96.54-145.05分钟）。在合成Wasserstein Hamiltonian流任务中，Double-Stitch达到相同性能的时间为30秒，而WLM需225秒（约7.6倍加速）。

Conclusion: Double-Stitch是一种有效的无模拟残差方法，通过Clebsch变分原理推导的拉格朗日运动方程能处理一般非梯度速度场，扩展了可建模的动力学范围（包括保守和耗散系统）。实验证明其在多个任务上匹配或优于梯度流方法Stitching和基于模拟的WLM方法，同时训练效率显著提升。该方法代表了一种新的"配置法"范式，与JKOnet/WLM的"打靶法"形成对比，为群体动力学习提供了新的计算框架。

Abstract: The dynamics of cells, organisms, and fluids are often modeled as probability distributions evolving over time. Reconstructing and extrapolating this evolution from unpaired snapshots requires assumptions about the underlying process. Wasserstein gradient flows are a common choice, but they cannot describe conservative or periodic dynamics. Lagrangian mechanics in Wasserstein space covers both, but existing methods for learning it are simulation-based: they run a numerical solver at every training step, which makes training expensive. We propose Double-Stitch, a simulation-free method that learns these mechanics by penalizing the residual of the equation of motion along a learned population path. We derive this equation from a Clebsch variational principle that does not require gradient velocities, and show that the residual vanishes exactly when the equation holds. We test Double-Stitch on synthetic, single-cell and ocean vortex datasets and find that it matches or outperforms gradient-flow methods and simulation-based WLM on most tasks, while training $4$-$14$ times faster than WLM. We provide a JAX implementation of Double-Stitch at this https URL .

</details>


### [317] [LESSER: Post-Training Data Selection with Output-Layer Gradients](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.03702)
*Lyuxin David Zhang,Eric Wong,Surbhi Goel,Anton Xue*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出LESSER，一种在LLM后训练数据选择中用输出层梯度替代全参数梯度的即插即用包装器，仅需单次前向传播，可大幅降低特征提取的计算成本，同时在下游任务上保持与全梯度方法相当的选择效果。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 基于梯度的数据选择方法（如LESS、GIST、GradAlign、GRACE）需要为每个候选样本计算完整模型梯度的反向传播，对于大规模候选池计算成本极高，可能超过在所选数据上训练本身的成本。是否存在一种近似全梯度特征但计算成本大幅降低的替代方案？

Method: LESSER的核心思想是利用仅需前向传播即可计算的输出层（最后一层）梯度替代全模型梯度。对于标准SFT和RL的加权token级损失形式，输出层梯度可以表示为softmax(Wh_t) - e_{y_t} 与 h_t 的外积加权和，仅依赖前向传播中已有的隐藏状态和输出概率，无需反向传播。方法作为包装器保留原有选择规则不变，分别应用于LESS（SFT）、GradAlign（RL）和GRACE（蒸馏教师选择）中。为高效存储和相似度计算，还采用了两侧随机投影（64×128）。

Result: 计算成本方面：SFT特征提取FLOPs降低9.7×，实测wall-clock加速17.8×；RL评分FLOPs降低3.0×，wall-clock加速3.5×；GRACE特征提取加速3.9–5.4×且峰值显存更低。下游表现方面：SFT在4个模型×5个任务×3个预算共60个cell中，与LESS的平均绝对分差仅1.3分（优于RDS+的2.2分和Random的2.6分）；RL中LESSER与GradAlign达到相同的最终准确率；GRACE在所有场景中选出相同的最佳教师。令人惊讶的是，尽管LESSER和LESS在SFT中选择的具体样本差异很大（Jaccard相似度仅约0.037），但所选批次在基础模型上的全模型梯度高度对齐（居中余弦相似度0.29，远高于RDS+的0.03和Random的约0），且选择带来的收益在前10步训练中即已显现。

Conclusion: 输出层梯度可以作为全模型梯度在经济高效的数据选择中的替代方案，关键原因是各应用场景作用于聚合层级（SFT为批量梯度、RL为响应聚合、GRACE为教师统计量），而非逐样本层面，因此无需逐样本恢复完整梯度保真度，只需保留各场景所需的聚合几何结构。LESSER在SFT、RL、蒸馏三种后训练设置中均能大幅降低特征提取成本并保持与全梯度方法相当的性能。

Abstract: The choice of post-training data for large language models substantially affects downstream performance. Gradient-based data selection is a popular approach that ranks training data by how well their gradients align with those of a small validation set. However, ranking with full-parameter gradients requires an expensive backward pass on every sample, making computation intractable for large candidate pools. This raises a natural question: can we approximate full-gradient features at a fraction of the cost? Conveniently, we find that output-layer gradients suffice for effective data selection, yet require only the cheaper forward pass. We implement this as LESSER, a drop-in wrapper for selection methods that reduces the feature-extraction FLOP cost by $9.7\times$ for SFT and $3.0\times$ for RL benchmarks, while tracking full-gradient performance on downstream tasks. Empirically, we find that even when output-layer and full gradients rank individual samples differently, they select batches with aligned gradients.

</details>


### [318] [RNADyn: A Benchmark for Generating and Understanding RNA Dynamics](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.03712)
*Yiming Huang,Lennart Bastian,Hanqun Cao,Luis Vollmers,Tolga Birdal*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: RNADyn提出了RNADynBench和RNADynNet，分别是一个标准化的RNA分子动力学基准数据集和一个统一模型，用于RNA轨迹生成和单构象动力学表示学习，通过物理接地策略同时提升两者的性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: RNA的功能依赖于构象变化，而静态结构无法完全捕捉这些动态信息。然而，大规模标准化的RNA动力学数据有限，且现有方法通常将轨迹生成和动力学理解视为独立任务。

Method: 该工作引入了RNADynBench（包含2,585条质量受控的100ns全原子轨迹）作为基准，并开发了RNADynNet——一种使用共享时空扩散骨干网络来同时处理轨迹生成和单构象动力学指纹提取的统一模型。关键创新是物理接地（PG）策略，通过MD导出的残基协方差和运动耦合来监督中间表示学习。训练结合了坐标去噪、单帧到轨迹对齐和物理接地三个目标。

Result: 在test_struct和test_flex测试集上，生成的轨迹实现了0.875和0.766的RMSF相关性。单构象预测在RMSF相关性上分别达到0.867和0.783，在归一化运动耦合（NMC）上分别达到0.811和0.761。物理接地改善了生成轨迹和可从单构象指纹中恢复的物理信息。模型在RNA-配体结合的下游迁移任务中也显示出改进。

Conclusion: RNADynBench和RNADynNet共同为生成和理解RNA动力学建立了基准和统一建模框架，推动了RNA建模从静态结构向构象动力学的转变。物理接地被证明是一种有效策略，可同时提高生成质量和可学习的表示能力。

Abstract: Ribonucleic acid (RNA) functions through conformational changes that are not fully captured by static structures. However, large-scale standardized RNA dynamics data remain limited, and existing approaches typically treat trajectory generation and dynamics understanding as separate objectives. Here, we introduce RNADynBench, a standardized RNA molecular dynamics (MD) benchmark with 2585 quality-controlled 100-ns all-atom trajectories and leakage-controlled splits. Building on RNADynBench, we develop RNADynNet, a unified model for RNA dynamics learning that uses a shared backbone for both trajectory generation and dynamics fingerprint extraction from a single conformer. It combines coordinate denoising, single-frame-to-trajectory alignment, and physical grounding to connect all-atom trajectory generation with dynamics representation learning. Physical grounding improves both generated dynamics and the physical information recoverable from these fingerprints. Across both test sets, including the high-flexibility challenge set, the generated trajectories achieve RMSF correlations of 0.875 and 0.766, while single-conformer predictions show comparable agreement with MD-derived dynamics. RNADynBench and RNADynNet together establish a benchmark and unified modeling framework for generating and understanding RNA dynamics.

</details>


### [319] [A Manifold-Aware Topic Modeling Approach via Rank-Based Prototypes](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.29630)
*Thiago César Castilho Almeida,Daniel Carlos Guimarães Pedronette*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出了MARETopic，一个无需训练的主题建模框架，将主题发现重新定义为基于排序的原型选择问题。它通过在低维流形上构建排序列表，贪心地选择K个真实语料文档作为主题代表，从而规避高维空间中的hubness和各向异性问题，并提出了一种新的跨主题MMR多样化步骤。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有主题模型存在两大缺陷：一是神经模型将主题表示为潜在向量，无法明确锚定到具体的语料文档；二是基于聚类的方法（如BERTopic）事后选择代表性文档，且依赖被高维病态扭曲的绝对距离。此外，神经模型需要大量训练成本。

Method: MARETopic采用Sentence-BERT编码文档，UMAP投影至低维流形后构建排序列表。贪心算法选择K个"领袖"文档，使其邻域覆盖整个语料。提出两种变体：MARETopic_Corr使用查询性能预测器（Reciprocal Density）和排序相关性度量（JaccardMax）；MARETopic_Diff使用基于排序的扩散矩阵。提出跨主题MMR步骤提升词汇多样性。

Result: 在20NG、NYT、WoS三个基准上，MARETopic_Corr在类别最多的两个数据集（20NG和NYT）上的Purity和NMI领先所有基线，包括训练200轮的神经模型。在C_v上，两个变体分别在20NG和WoS取得最佳。MARETopic_Diff速度比Corr版本快1.7-1.9倍，且无需计算QPP和相关性。提出的MMR步骤是模型无关的，同样能提升BERTopic的主题多样性。

Conclusion: MARETopic是无需训练的流形感知主题模型，将每个主题锚定到真实可检视的语料文档。其基于排序的设计天然规避了高维空间的距离扭曲问题。未来工作将扩展至层次主题建模、动态主题建模，并评估在更大规模和多语言语料上的可扩展性。

Abstract: Recent topic models leverage pretrained embeddings, but neural architectures produce latent representations without grounding in specific texts, and clustering-based pipelines assign representative documents only post hoc, relying on absolute distances distorted by hubness and anisotropy in high-dimensional spaces. We introduce MARETopic, a training-free framework that casts topic discovery as rank-based prototype selection. After projecting embeddings onto a low-dimensional manifold, MARETopic builds ranked lists encoding ordinal neighborhood structure. A greedy algorithm selects exactly K exemplar documents, real corpus texts, whose neighborhoods cover the corpus. Two variants share this criterion. MARETopic$_\text{Corr}$ scores candidates with a query performance predictor and a rank correlation measure, leading Purity and NMI on the two benchmarks with the most categories, ahead of both neural and clustering-based topic models. MARETopic$_\text{Diff}$ scores them with a rank-based diffusion matrix, needs neither measure, and runs 1.7 to 1.9 times faster. Without a single gradient update, MARETopic leads topic coherence on two of three datasets. A novel inter-topic Maximal Marginal Relevance step raises vocabulary diversity at little cost in coherence. Our code is available at this https URL .

</details>


<div id='cs.AI'></div>

# cs.AI [[Back]](#toc)

### [320] [MintFlow: Minimal Trajectory Intervention for Constrained Flow Matching](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.02260)
*Yesom Park,Kelvin Kan,Qifan Chen,Thomas Flynn,Hayden Schaeffer. Xihaier Luo*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出MintFlow，一种无需训练的约束流匹配采样框架，通过对预训练流轨迹上的中间状态施加最小范数扰动来满足终端约束，利用伴随方程（adjoint equation）以闭式形式高效计算扰动，并自适应选择干预时间，在保证约束满足的同时显著减少对预训练生成分布的偏离。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有的约束采样方法（无论是修改速度场的引导方法、终态投影方法还是轨迹优化方法）在强制满足约束条件时，往往会使生成样本严重偏离预训练的生成分布。作者认为应遵循"只修改必要的，且只修改必要的程度"这一原则，提出在不修改预训练向量场的前提下寻找最小的中间扰动。

Method: MintFlow的核心方法包括三个方面的技术：①将约束强制生成建模为最小范数轨迹干预问题（公式3），即寻找对中间状态 $u_s$ 的最小扰动 $\delta$，使得扰动后的状态 $u_s+\delta$ 在预训练流场下演化到终端时满足约束 $H(\Phi(T,s)(u_s+\delta))=0$；②基于伴随方程（adjoint equation）的高效求解（公式7），通过反向求解伴随ODE获得 $A_s=\nabla H(u_T)D\Phi(T,s)$，避免显式构造高维Jacobian，从而以闭式形式 $\delta_s^*=-A_s^\dagger H(u_T)$ 计算最小范数扰动；③自适应干预时间选择（公式8），通过目标函数 $J(s)=\|\delta_s^*\|^2+\lambda(T-s)^2$ 在候选时间集中选取最优干预时刻，平衡扰动幅度与剩余传播时间的放大效应。方法还包含迭代细化策略（Algorithm 2），收敛速度为二次（$|F(u^{(n+1)})|\leq K|F(u^{(n)})|^2$），以及针对Rectified Flow的离散灵敏度特例化（公式15-17）。

Result: MintFlow在三类任务上均取得优异表现：①图像逆问题（在AFHQ-Cat和FFHQ上的修复、超分、去模糊），约束误差降至~1e-4，FID降至6-8，显著优于D-Flow、DPS、Freedom、PNPFlow和FlowChef，且推理时间最短（0.19-0.22s）；②图像编辑（PIE-Bench+InstaFlow），约束误差最低（0.0069），CLIP-T最高（0.2926），推理效率最佳（8.79s）；③物理系统建模（Heat和Reaction-Diffusion方程），在分布保真度（FID、MMD、W₂）和动力学一致性（仿真误差）上均取得最佳点估计，约束残差降低约3个数量级。理论保证包括二阶约束残差和 $W_2(\nu_T^*,\nu_T)\leq e^{L_f(T-s)}\|\delta_s^*\|_{L^2(\nu_s)}$ 的分布稳定性界。

Conclusion: MintFlow成功实现了约束满足与分布保真度的最佳平衡，避免了后验投影和速度场修改方法引入的显著分布偏移。理论分析证实了约束残差的二阶收敛性和Wasserstein距离的指数稳定性界。未来方向包括扩展到更复杂的非线性/不可微约束、降低计算开销以及推广至其他动力学生成模型。

Abstract: Flow matching models excel at generative modeling, and many downstream applications require their samples to satisfy prescribed constraints, such as observed measurements and physical laws. However, existing constrained samplers often face a trade-off: \textit{enforcing constraints can substantially displace samples from the pretrained data distribution}. To address this trade-off, we introduce \textbf{MintFlow}, a training-free constrained sampling framework that formulates constraint enforcement as a minimal intervention on the pretrained flow trajectory. MintFlow seeks the minimal perturbation of an intermediate flow state such that its subsequent evolution under the pretrained flow field satisfies the target constraint. By minimally perturbing the flow state while keeping the pretrained flow field unchanged, MintFlow enforces the constraint while minimizing unnecessary deviation from the pretrained distribution. An adjoint formulation yields a closed-form expression for this perturbation, eliminating expensive iterative optimization. Furthermore, MintFlow adaptively selects the intervention time to balance the required perturbation magnitude with its amplification by the remaining flow. Across a range of tasks in generative vision and physical system modeling, MintFlow achieves competitive constraint satisfaction while preserving the pretrained generative distribution substantially better than state-of-the-art constrained methods.

</details>


### [321] [Fast Models, Slow Evidence: A Paired and Self-Audited Evaluation of System-1 Decision Models for LLM Agent Harnesses](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.02267)
*Jiawei Li*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文对两类"系统1型"决策模型（开源的Laya与托管的Jev）在智能体框架11个决策点上进行配对评估，并对自己的评估流水线进行了严肃的自审计。研究发现Jev在多数任务上显著优于Laya（11个决策点中9个胜出，差距+10.8至+46.0个百分点），但两个模型在零样本模型路由和RAG相关性门控上表现不佳。同时论文坦诚地揭示了初版评估中四项关键错误（包括漏算成本、指标误标、阈值过拟合与渠道效应），并通过对照实验加以纠正。核心贡献不仅是基准结果，更是一套可迁移的评估审计方法论。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 当前LLM智能体框架中大量"小型、类型化"的决策（如选模型、选工具、判断检索相关性、检测注入攻击等）均由同一个LLM完成，耗时耗资。然而，新兴的"系统1型"模型号称能在一次前向传播中以分类概率形式回答这些决策问题，大幅降低成本与延迟。但从业者缺乏对其准确性、鲁棒性以及作为"门控"组件时真实节省效果的严格评估。论文试图回答三个具体问题：(1) 系统1模型在哪些决策点上足够准确？(2) 其可靠性如何（对选项顺序、措辞、输入渠道、模型版本的稳定性）？(3) 作为LLM门控时实际节省多少，代价是什么？

Method: 方法包括：(1) 构建覆盖11个决策点、源自18个公开数据集的基准（7,283基础样本+6,640鲁棒性变体），两系统接收字节相同的输入；(2) 采用配对统计（精确McNemar检验+渐近置信区间）、Wilson区间、ECE校准指标、选择性预测视角；(3) 加入DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash作为参考LLM（但因输入格式不同不参与配对比较）；(4) 进行跨硬件（RTX 2080 Ti vs Apple M4 CPU）与跨日复现性检查；(5) 对每项可疑混淆因素设计对照实验（B2用TF-IDF近邻干扰项替代随机项；G2用渠道原生文档；J2用自然化占位符）；(6) 对自身评估流水线进行全面自审计（Table 2列举了所有被修正的错误）。
