Result: 主要结果：(1) Jev在2,100例套件上准确率76.7% vs Laya的63.1%，在智能体基础设施套件上80.2% vs 66.0%；最大差距出现在大标签集（F：81.0% vs 35.0%，+46.0 pp）；两个持平点——模型路由（A：双方均接近随机水平，Jev对99.5%请求回答"cheap"）和RAG相关性（D：61.0% vs 60.5%）；(2) Laya对选项顺序高度敏感（30.3%答案会随顺序反转而改变，60-77标签时升至53%），Jev仅1.8%；Laya在相似候选下急剧退化（K=50时降至31.3%，而Jev在唯一正确工具项上保持98.9%）；(3) 措辞变化使两模型各任务准确率波动5-15 pp，但Jev在8/8的B/C/E/F组合中均领先；(4) 作为RAG门控，完美门控最多节省58%的LLM调用（受无关检索比例上限限制），远低于初版报告的45-58%端到端正确率（实为门控自身准确率）；(5) 两层安全审核中，预筛自身的token成本必须计入：τ=0.1时实际节省仅4.3%，τ=0.05时反而多花4.7%；主要收益是延迟（34-41%请求约0.3秒即可放行）；(6) 自审计纠正四项重大错误：漏算预筛成本（23.9%→4.3%）、指标误标（45-58%是门控准确率而非端到端质量，实为97.9%）、同数据选阈值（5%目标在hold-out上p95达16.7%）、渠道效应（G2对照显示该效应仅在"移植"的非原生文本中出现，渠道原生文档上消失）；(7) 注入检测中Laya在payload嵌入文档时仅检测47.5-50.8%（独立payload为70.8-82.5%），Jev则保持88-94%。

Conclusion: 结论与建议：(1) 强系统1模型（如Jev）可用于工具选择、大标签意图分类、工具输出注入筛查与基于性的检查——这些是封闭集上的"一眼判断"，Jev接近LLM质量；(2) 不应将零样本系统1模型用于LLM间路由、RAG相关性跳过生成、PII筛查，也不应作为唯一安全门；(3) 使用Laya时应保持K≲10个不相似的选项，固定选项顺序或对排列投票，按max p_k计算置信度，并按域重校准；(4) 评估门控时应报告呼叫率与hold-out漏报率，包含所有组件成本，并用各渠道原生内容测试渠道效应。本文最重要的元结论是：评估系统1模型本身比使用它们更难——改变部署建议的错误不在模型的评分预测中，而在围绕模型的"账目"中。这一自审计方法（识别部署核算错误：成本、端到端质量、阈值选择、渠道效应）可迁移到任何门控组件的评估中。

Abstract: Agent harnesses make many small, typed decisions per task: which model to call, which tool to use, whether retrieved text is relevant, whether an input carries an injection. System-1 decision models answer such questions in a single forward pass with class probabilities, promising large cost and latency savings over LLM calls. We present a paired evaluation of an open-weight (Laya) and a hosted (Jev) System-1 model on 11 agent decision points built from 18 public sources: 7,283 base cases plus 6,640 robustness variants, with byte-identical inputs, paired tests, and cross-hardware and cross-day reproducibility checks. Jev is significantly more accurate on 9 of 11 decision points (+10.8 to +46.0 pp). Neither model beats chance on zero-shot model routing, and they tie on RAG relevance gating. Laya changes 30% of its answers when the option order is reversed and degrades sharply with many or similar candidates (31% at 50 nearest-neighbour tools, vs. 98% for Jev on items with a unique correct tool). We also audit our own pipeline. Three analysis errors and one design confound distorted headline deployment claims: an omitted pre-screen cost (reported 23.9% saving, actual 4.3%), gate accuracy reported as end-to-end quality (58% vs. 98%), in-sample thresholds (5% target, up to 17% held-out misses), and a "channel effect" on injection false positives that vanishes with channel-native content. Two other suspected confounds did not change the conclusions. All cases, raw outputs and analysis code are available at this https URL .

</details>


### [322] [The AI Risk Observatory: What Can We Learn from AI Disclosures in Annual Reports About Societal Resilience?](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.02281)
*Bart Jaworski*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出"AI风险观察站"方法，利用LLM对英国上市公司2020-2025年共9,821份年度报告进行两阶段分类分析，研究AI风险披露的可行性、模式与信号质量，发现披露数量快速增长但实质性披露极少。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 社会韧性研究需要可操作的数据来追踪AI风险在经济中的积累，特别是关键国家基础设施(CNI)领域。现有数据来源（调查、事件数据库、监管文件）各有局限，而年度报告具有法律强制、董事会问责、结构稳定等特点，可能成为有价值的替代来源。

Method: 采用两阶段LLM分类管道：第一阶段使用AI关键词门控识别24,189条AI提及段落，并分类为采用(adoption)、风险(risk)、供应商(vendor)、伤害(harm)、一般/模糊(general/ambiguous)或误报(none)；第二阶段对采用、风险、供应商进行细粒度分类，包括十大风险类别分类、三级实质性评分（模板化/中等/实质性）。方法通过474条人工标注段落验证，分类器使用Gemini 3 Flash。

Result: 三个主要发现：(1) 2020-2025年间，AI风险披露比例从2.8%升至41.2%（增长约15倍），AI采用披露从13.8%升至45.2%，供应商提及集中在Microsoft等少数主要提供商；(2) 披露在不同CNI行业和市场板块间差异显著——主板市场AI风险披露率是AIM的9倍，能源和数据中心基础设施行业披露率最低；(3) 伤害披露几乎为零（9,821份报告中仅7份）。实质性分析显示：2025年41.2%的报告提及AI风险，但仅4.3%包含实质性披露，差距持续扩大。

Conclusion: 年度报告经LLM大规模处理后，可提供关于公司如何披露AI回应的有用信号，方法可复现且趋势与已知的AI发展时间线一致。然而，披露广度远超披露深度——多数披露属于"中等"级别而非模板化或实质性。这一差距可能反映数据源固有局限、AI风险治理框架尚不成熟、或战略性模糊。对社会韧性研究的启示是：年度报告是追踪CNI行业AI风险披露演变的可行工具，但将其与底层风险管理的质量和运营准备程度联系起来需要互补的数据源和方法。

Abstract: Societal resilience research relies on access to useful and actionable data, which motivates our main research question: Can annual reports, processed at scale with LLMs, provide a useful signal about how companies disclose their response to AI? We test this by applying a reproducible two-stage classification pipeline to 9,821 annual reports from 1,362 UK listed companies (2020-2025, with partial 2026 data). We first validate the method against 474 human-annotated passages, finding high recall and moderate label-level agreement. We then report three empirical patterns: (i) between 2020 and 2025, the share of reports mentioning AI risk rose from 2.8% to 41.2%, while AI adoption disclosure also rose, from 13.8% to 45.2%, and named vendor mentions cluster around a small set of major providers led by Microsoft; (ii) disclosure varies substantially by Critical National Infrastructure sector and market segment: AIM reports disclose AI risk at far lower rates than Main Market reports, and sectors such as Energy and Data Infrastructure lag behind the rest in AI risk disclosure; and (iii) harm disclosures are near-absent (seven reports across the entire corpus). We develop a substantiveness classification to assess the quality of the disclosure and find that most AI risk disclosure is not substantive: in 2025, 41.2% of all reports mention AI as a risk, but only 4.3% contain AI risk disclosure we classify as substantive.

</details>


### [323] [Keep It CALM: Analyzing the Limits of Global Unsafety in Text-to-Image Generation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.02300)
*NaHyeon Park,Minhyun Lee,Hyunjung Shim*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文针对文本到图像生成中的训练时安全防护方法（推理时无训练安全防护）依赖全局不安全子空间的问题，提出几何分析揭示"覆盖度-选择性"权衡，并提出CALM方法，通过提示局部反事实修正替代全局移除。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有的训练时免费安全防护机制（如SLD、SAFREE）假设不安全语义可在文本编码器空间中由一个全局不安全方向或子空间表示，并统一应用于所有提示。然而，这一"全局不安全"假设缺乏理论验证：(1) 不同不安全类别是否共享紧凑的共同结构？(2) 该结构是否能泛化到未见过的类别？(3) 扩大覆盖范围是否会损害安全相关良性内容（如医疗急救、历史冲突、格斗运动）？

Method: 1. 几何分析：在SD-v1.4文本编码器（CLIP ViT-L/14）的冻结表征空间中，使用主角度、投影重叠、谱有效秩和最近邻保留等度量，诊断池化不安全子空间的覆盖度与选择性。
2. CALM（反事实自适应局部调制）：一种训练时免费的安全防护方法，使用匹配的"不安全-良性"反事实锚点替代全局移除。具体包括：(a) 提示路由——基于反事实边际将提示路由至至多K=3个活跃不安全类别；(b) 文本侧局部反事实修正——对违反路由安全半空间的标记进行最小投影，使其移向匹配的良性侧（通过凸二次规划求解）；(c) 残差侧反事实修正——在去噪早期步骤中，沿路由不安全方向仅抑制正对齐的CFG残差分量（带范数上限）。

Result: 1. 几何分析揭示了持续存在的覆盖度-选择性权衡：紧凑的不安全子空间无法覆盖异质的不安全语义（单类别子空间学习性能与良性类别无显著差异；跨类别重叠接近异质良性控制而非同质狗品种控制；留一类别迁移率远低于1）；扩大投影范围则越来越扭曲安全相关良性内容（误报率0.270 vs 一般良性0.034）。
2. CALM在SD-v1.4上，Ring-A-Bell、UnlearnDiff-Atk、MMA-Diffusion三个有害提示基准上均取得最低ASR与TR，同时保持最高的文本保真度（CLIP-T）和良性效用（COCO FID与CLIP-T）。
3. 跨骨干网络迁移：在SDXL、FLUX.1、SANA1.5、OmniGen2上均有效降低ASR（41%-69%）和TR（38%-62%）。
4. 多类别I2P评估：将平均不安全率从0.378降至0.159（Qwen3-VL评判）。
5. 消融实验验证各组件（文本修正、残差修正、稀疏路由）的必要性。
6. 推理时间与SAFREE变体相当，显著快于STG。

Conclusion: 本文的核心结论是：全局不安全信号移除策略存在固有的覆盖度-选择性权衡——不安全语义过于异质以至于无法用紧凑子空间覆盖，又与安全相关良性语义过于纠缠以至于无法用宽泛投影选择性移除。CALM通过将干预对象从"全局移除目标"转变为"提示局部反事实修正"，将每个不安全类别表示为局部修正模式，仅对提示实际涉及的不安全方向进行最小良性侧校正，在无需训练的情况下同时改善了安全性与良性内容保留。该工作鼓励未来研究在决定"如何干预"之前，先思考"在何处干预"。

Abstract: Training-free safeguards for text-to-image generation often rely on a reusable safety signal, such as an unsafe direction or global toxic subspace, applied broadly across prompts. We provide a controlled geometric analysis of this global-unsafety assumption and reveal a consistent coverage-selectivity trade-off: compact unsafe subspaces fail to cover heterogeneous unsafe semantics, whereas broader aggregation increasingly distorts safety-adjacent benign prompts. Motivated by this finding, we propose CALM (Counterfactual Adaptive Local Modulation), a training-free safeguard that replaces uniform global removal with prompt-local counterfactual correction. Using matched unsafe-benign anchors, CALM routes each prompt to active unsafe categories, minimally edits only violating token representations toward the safe side, and suppresses positively aligned unsafe residual components. Across broad evaluation, CALM significantly improves unsafe content suppression while preserving benign utility, demonstrating that local counterfactual correction provides a more selective alternative to global unsafe signal removal.

</details>


### [324] [Choosing Before Acting: Comparative Value Estimation for Long-Horizon Tool-Use Agents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.02330)
*Yu Li,Zheng Zhang,Xin Liu,Shengtian Yang,Guangfeng Cai,Lei Feng*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出CITA（Comparative Inference for Tool-use Agents）框架，在长程工具使用场景中，让智能体在执行下一个工具调用前，先估计并比较各候选调用的长期价值。通过训练一个比较推理模型（CIM），结合三种配对监督信号（真实轨迹、贝叶斯工具图模拟器、LLM语义比较），CITA在GRPO训练中同时充当rollout引导和奖励信号源，在Toolathlon、TOUCAN、TRAJECT-Bench三个基准上均显著提升了Tool F1和任务成功率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在长程工具调用中，最终结果的奖励信号归因困难，步骤级监督又难以可靠获取（人工标注成本高、LLM判断不稳定、rollout估计代价大且噪声大）。预分析显示任务成功率随调用步数急剧下降、错误难以恢复、模型局部偏好与真实成功率在49%的分叉点上不一致，凸显在执行前评估候选调用长期价值的必要性。

Method: 提出Comparative Inference for Tool-use Agents (CITA)框架：训练一个Comparative Inference Model (CIM)，输入为(s, a)输出长期价值V_φ(s,a)和置信度c_φ(s,a)。CIM在配对信号上训练，比较同一上下文下两种替代工具调用的价值差Δv。训练数据来自三个互补来源：(1) D_obs——从真实日志轨迹挖掘，构造同前缀下的替代调用对并用下游成功率作为标签；(2) D_sandbox——基于工具转移图构建贝叶斯模拟器，对工具节点采样Beta分布成功概率、对转移边采样可靠性概率，在沙盒中评估分叉点的两条扩展路径；(3) D_cmp——用LLM在配对prompt中模拟两种调用后的短期续延并判断任务成功概率，经多次重复和置信度过滤后形成语义比较对。训练目标包含L_value（逐调用BCE）、L_gap（价值差MSE）、L_cons（自一致性和传递性正则）、L_conf（置信度校准）。训练采用阶段式调度。在GRPO rollout时，策略采样K=3个候选工具调用，CIM按S_φ(s,a)=V_φ·c_φ评分并执行最高分者；rollout完成后对已执行轨迹按置信度加权聚合得到r_cmp，与任务级奖励r_task组合（w_task=0.4, w_cmp=0.6）计算群体相对优势。推理时复用相同的CIM引导选择流程，不更新策略。

Result: 在Toolathlon（~13.5次/任务）、TOUCAN（~3.2次/任务，15294个工具）、TRAJECT-Bench（~6.4次/任务，715个工具）三个基准上，使用Qwen2.5-7B和Llama3.1-8B两个骨干，CITA在六组（基准×骨干）设置中Tool F1和TSR均最优，相对最强基线平均提升7.55和9.93个百分点。CIM价值估计评估显示完整目标将Value Gap MAE从0.4752降至0.2083（TOUCAN），Direction Accuracy提升至0.92。消融实验表明L_gap、D_sandbox贡献最大；ECE从0.460降至0.087。计算成本上CITA每任务4.84秒（2×H100），比WebDreamer快2.46倍；每成功任务时间9.74秒最低。案例分析显示CIM在依赖前置工具的场景中正确抑制了局部看似合理但会导致死锁状态的工具。

Conclusion: CITA通过"执行前比较"的范式，有效解决了长程工具使用中的信用分配和局部偏好失准问题。CIM的配对监督设计、贝叶斯工具图模拟器和LLM语义比较的三源互补信号，以及CIM同时作为rollout引导和步骤级奖励的双重角色，是性能提升的关键。局限在于依赖已记录的工具轨迹和工具图结构，未来工作应扩展到工具动态增删更新的场景。

Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) rely on long-horizon tool invocation sequences for complex tasks, where each invocation can alter the task state and condition subsequent decisions. In long-horizon tool use, final-outcome rewards provide weak credit assignment over long interaction traces. Step-level rewards can offer more targeted feedback, but obtaining reliable step supervision often requires human or LLM judgment, or additional rollouts to estimate the downstream effect of an intermediate decision. In this paper, we argue that effective tool-use agents should estimate the long-horizon value of a possible next tool invocation before executing it. This objective requires comparative supervision over alternative invocations under the same context, while logged trajectories only contain the invocation that was actually taken. Therefore, we propose Comparative Inference for Tool-use Agents (CITA). CITA trains a Comparative Inference Model (CIM) from paired signals that combine observed tool behavior, scalable supervision from a Bayesian tool-graph simulator, and semantic judgments from LLM-based comparison. The resulting CIM learns to estimate how likely a possible next tool invocation is to support final task success under the current context. Across three tool-use benchmarks and multiple backbone LLMs, CITA consistently improves Tool F1 and task success. Additional analysis shows that CIM learns accurate step-level value estimates for comparative tool choices.

</details>


### [325] [World Editing: Intervening on Executable Worlds at Increasing Depth](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.02331)
*Max Ku,Nok-Kan Law,Yu-Chien Tang,Shih-Ying Yeh,Ping Nie,Andy Zheng,Tat Hei Lai,Fei-Yueh Chen,Nikko Yu,Wei-Chieh Sun,Suzy Huang,Chiao-Wei Hsu,Chih-Chuan Huang,Chak-Wing Mak,Ho Yin Sam Ng,Edisy Kin Wai Chan,Min-Hung Chen,Ho Kei Cheng*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 该论文提出"世界编辑"(World Editing)任务，即智能体对已存在的可执行世界进行有目的的修改，同时保持不应改变的性质。引入"干预深度"(intervention depth)作为衡量修改耦合强度的轴，分为属性(L1)、实体(L2)、动力学(L3)、系统(L4)四级。通过Minecraft和Terraria游戏的工业级mod构建了IGMWorld环境及IGMBench基准(110个任务、1161项评估标准)。评测了7个前沿编码智能体，最强配置(GPT-5.6 Sol)在严格任务级指标上达到78.2% WSR、标准级CPR达94.8%。主要发现：可靠性随干预深度下降(无法仅由评估标准数量解释)；大多数失败发生在可执行性通过之后，体现在行为验证阶段；视觉一致性是独立短板，所有配置联合通过率均低于50%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有研究主要关注世界生成和与世界交互两种AI-世界关系，但对"有目的编辑现有可执行世界"研究不足。论文提出两个核心问题：(1)更深层的干预更难，是因为需要协调更多世界组件，还是仅因为包含更多要求？(2)编辑失败发生在基础可执行性层面，还是在游戏运行后行为不正确层面？游戏mod为研究这些问题提供了天然测试床。

Method: 1. 将世界编辑形式化为对W=(S,T,R,...)的干预变换W→W'=f(W,Δₖ)，k∈{property, entity, dynamics, system}，以干预深度衡量修改对世界实体、动力学、系统的耦合程度。2. 构建IGMWorld环境，提供edit→build→run→observe循环，固定时间预算T=3600秒，基于Minecraft 1.21.1+Fabric+Java 21与tModLoader+ .NET 8.0。4. 构建IGMBench基准，由11位有mod经验标注者创作110个任务(57 Minecraft+53 Terraria)，覆盖L1-L4四级，共1161项状态/行为评估标准(含状态检查、行为检查、225项回归检查)。5. 三阶段评估：可执行性(编译加载)、世界编辑正确性(状态/行为/回归检查)、视觉一致性(基于TPIPS的语义与风格度量，类别条件k-NN聚合，α=0.15, k=5阈值)。6. 评测7个前沿配置(DeepSeek-V4-Glank、GLM-5.3、Kimi-K3、Gemini 3.5 Flash、Claude Opus 4.8、GPT-5.6 Luna、GPT-5.6 Sol)，指标包括CPR与WSR。

Result: 1. 功能性能：GPT-5.6 Sol总体WSR达78.2%、CPR达94.8%；Claude Opus 4.8 WSR达71.8%；所有配置WSR在L1最高，随深度下降(如GPT-5.6 Sol: L1 96.3% → L4 48.1%)。2. 干预深度独立于标准数量：在相似标准数量范围内L1仍显著可靠，说明深度反映耦合结构而非要求数量。3. 失败阶段：大多数失败发生在行为验证阶段而非构建/加载；L2起交互/进展失败占比从L2增至L4的43%，资源/注册失败稳定在13-24%。4. 视觉一致性弱：原生资产联合通过率0.80(MC)/0.78(Terraria)，所有智能体联合通过率均<0.50，最佳为0.47(MC)、0.29(Terraria)，且视觉表现与功能表现排名不一致。5. 消融：Luna无技能配置WSR从64.5%降至57.3%，但视觉质量反而略升。6. 回归保留率≥96.9%，表明智能体对未修改属性的保持较好。7. 定性案例证明干预分类法可推广至PEAK、Palworld、Starbound等其他游戏。

Conclusion: 世界编辑是与世界生成、交互并列的一类独立能力，可执行游戏提供了可验证其具体形式的实用测试床。当前前沿编码智能体已展现显著的世界编辑能力，但可靠性系统性地随干预深度下降，且这一趋势无法化约为评估标准数量。功能正确性与视觉一致性构成两个正交的难题：大多数失败发生在行为验证而非可执行性阶段；视觉资产整合仍是独立短板。可靠地编辑现有可执行世界(同时保持连贯性)仍是向更具能力的智能体迈进的重要前沿方向。论文将IGMWorld与IGMBench开源以推动世界编辑作为生成与交互之外的一类基础能力研究。

Abstract: Interactive world models are increasingly capable of generating environments and acting within them, yet deliberately editing an existing executable world remains underexplored. We formulate world editing as intervening on an existing world while preserving properties that should remain unchanged, and introduce intervention depth as an axis describing how strongly an edit couples world entities, dynamics, and systems. We instantiate this capability through industry-grade game modding and introduce IGMWorld, together with IGMBench, a benchmark of 110 tasks and over 1.1K executable state and behavioral criteria across Minecraft and Terraria. The tasks span property, entity, dynamics, and system interventions and are evaluated through deterministic executability, behavioral, preservation, and visual checks. Frontier coding agents already exhibit substantial world-editing capability: the strongest configuration solves 78.2% of tasks under a strict task-level criterion, while criterion-level performance reaches 94.8%. Reliability generally decreases with intervention depth, and this pattern persists even among tasks with similar numbers of evaluation criteria. Most failed edits still build and load successfully, suggesting that the main difficulty is making the edited world behave as requested. Visual consistency remains a separate weakness, with all evaluated configurations below 50% joint visual pass rate. These results show that world editing is a distinct capability from world generation and interaction, and that executable games provide a practical testbed for studying it.

</details>


### [326] [A Multi Method Importance and Performance Efficiency Analysis of Topological Metrics for Natural Visibility Graph Based Cyber Attack Detection](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.02342)
*Ali Melih Kanca,Ilker Turker*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出基于自然可见图(NVG)的网络流量分类框架，通过共识排序策略筛选关键拓扑特征，在显著降低计算成本的同时提升分类性能。Top3特征子集以97.148%准确率超越全21特征方案(95.999%)，并将运行时间减少96.06%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: NVG拓扑描述符能有效刻画网络流量结构，但21个度量并非同等重要，全集使用会带来高计算开销。本文旨在通过特征重要性分析找到紧凑子集，在保持分类能力的同时提升效率。

Method: 1) 从NVG中提取21个拓扑度量；2) 整合SHAP、分组置换重要性、Boruta和RFE四种重要性方法构建共识排序；3) 构建Full21/Top15/Top10/Top7/Top5/Top3六种配置；4) 使用CICIDS2018数据集和CNN分类器配合分层5折交叉验证进行评估。

Result: Top3配置(avg_clustering_coeff_median、avg_clustering_coeff_std、avg_clustering_coeff_mean)表现最佳：准确率97.148%，加权F1为97.055%，MCC为0.9675；Full21分别为95.999%、95.521%、0.9549。Top3运行时间从14,961.39秒降至589.22秒(降幅96.06%)。

Conclusion: 研究表明基于重要性引导的NVG度量筛选能构建紧凑表示，在评估设置下既获得更高的观测平均预测性能，又大幅降低计算成本。聚类系数相关度量被识别为最具区分力的特征。

Abstract: Natural Visibility Graph (NVG) based analysis characterizes network traffic through topological descriptors reflecting different structural properties. However, not all descriptors contribute equally to cyber-attack classification, and extracting a large metric set can increase computational cost. This study evaluates 21 NVG derived topological metrics and investigates whether a compact subset can preserve classification capability while improving computational efficiency. Four importance analysis methods SHAP, grouped Permutation Importance, Boruta, and Recursive Feature Elimination (RFE) are integrated through a Consensus Ranking strategy. Based on this ranking, Full21, Top15, Top10, Top7, Top5, and Top3 configurations are evaluated using the CICIDS2018 dataset, a CNN classifier, and stratified 5 fold cross validation. The three highest ranked metrics are avg_clustering_coeff_median, avg_clustering_coeff_std, and avg_clustering_coeff_mean. Top3 achieved the highest observed mean performance, with 97.148% accuracy, 97.055% weighted F1 score, and an MCC of 0.9675, compared with 95.999%, 95.521%, and 0.9549 for Full21, respectively. It also reduced total runtime from 14,961.39 s to 589.22 s (96.06%). These results indicate that importance guided metric reduction can provide a compact NVG representation with higher observed mean predictive performance and substantially lower computational cost under the evaluated setting.

</details>


### [327] [DeReAct: Decomposed Reasoning and Acting for Reliable AI Agents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.02351)
*Ajay Vohra,Tao Chen,Neeti Narayan,Caron Zhang*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: DeReAct提出了一种模块化智能体架构，将ReAct循环中单一LLM策略负责的"动作授权"与"完成控制"两个可靠性关键决策外部化，由独立的Critic（执行前动作验证）和Context Manager（基于环境证据重建State并认证完成）分别承担。在GAIA和SWE-bench Verified上，Brain能力越弱，DeReAct对Pass@1的提升越显著（Qwen3-Coder-480B提升6.5-7.0分，Claude Sonnet 4.5提升4.2-5.2分），而最强Brain（Claude Opus 4.5）下Pass@1与ReAct持平但轨迹的证据完整性和约束满足度更高。论文引入"policy sufficiency"概念来诊断外部门控何时有效。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 标准ReAgent让单个LLM策略同时负责推理、动作授权和完成判定，导致错误沿轨迹传播、过早终止或提交无证据支撑的最终答案。现有护栏、自校正和上下文管理方法未同时将动作授权与完成控制从任务策略中解耦，也未将其锚定在独立重建的环境证据上。

Method: DeReAct将ReAct循环分解为三个可独立配置的模块：(1) Brain提出意图与可执行命令并接收滑动窗口原始历史；(2) Critic作为执行前硬门控，检查安全/语法/任务约束，返回accept/reject及置信度；(3) Context Manager在每次执行后从环境反馈重建不含Brain未验证推理的State，并判定Success或Continue。Brain使用标准ReAct提示以隔离架构效应。

Result: 在GAIA（165题）和SWE-bench Verified（489实例）上使用三种能力级别的Brain评估：Qwen3-Coder-480B获得6.5-7.0 Pass@1绝对提升（多数p<.05），Claude Sonnet 4.5获得4.2-5.2提升，Claude Opus 4.5提升不显著（-0.3至+1.0）。Opus下DeReAct轨迹证据完整性提升8.4pp、约束满足提升6.4pp、承认猜测减少5.9pp。消融显示Critic与CM贡献因Brain和领域而异，且门控效果受"policy sufficiency"制约：CM模型规模、提示设计和Brain历史窗口大小三个杠杆互补而非可互换。代价方面，Opus Brain下SWE-bench上DeReAct达到与ReAct相当的成本，而GAIA上仍有约2.9×开销。

Conclusion: 动作授权和完成控制不必内嵌于任务求解策略中；将其外部化能在Brain较弱时显著提升成功率，并在Brain增强后仍保留轨迹接地性优势。外部门控的有效性取决于目标失败的普遍性以及门控策略本身的充分性（提示、模型、上下文三个可调杠杆），该充分性可从轨迹中诊断。未来工作需验证该模式在更多模型族、领域和部署约束下的泛化性。

Abstract: ReAct-based agents typically rely on a single LLM policy to propose actions, interact with the environment, and decide when a task is complete. This coupling makes action authorization and completion control difficult to enforce independently, allowing errors to propagate and unsupported completion claims to terminate execution. We introduce DeReAct, a modular agent architecture that externalizes two gating policies: a Critic that validates proposed actions before execution, and a Context Manager that reconstructs an environment-supported \textsc{State} and certifies task completion. Across GAIA and SWE-bench Verified, DeReAct improves Pass@1 most for weaker Brain models, with gains of 6.5--7.0 points for Qwen3-Coder-480B and 4.2--5.2 points for Claude Sonnet~4.5; gains diminish as Brain capability increases. Trajectory and ablation analyses show that external gating is effective when targeted failures are sufficiently prevalent and the gating policy is itself sufficient. With Claude Opus~4.5, Pass@1 remains comparable to ReAct, while DeReAct produces more evidence-complete and constraint-satisfying trajectories, indicating that completion control can trade earlier termination for stronger grounding. Overall, DeReAct improves weaker agents while retaining grounding benefits as models strengthen.

</details>


### [328] [Traversing the Satisfaction-Diversity Frontier in Text-to-Image Diffusion](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.02372)
*Kevin Zhai,Siva Rajesh Kasa,Soumya Roy,Sumit Negi,Mubarak Shah*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出SatisDive，一种无需训练的推理时方法，通过将文本到图像生成建模为"满意化"问题（每张图像必须满足奖励下限，整批图像必须满足多样性要求），解决了现有方法在奖励最大化和多样性之间难以兼顾的难题。在FLUX.1-dev和SANA-1.6B等模型上，在匹配DreamSim时，SatisDive在最差候选奖励上比FK steering最多提升0.43和0.70。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有文本到图像生成方法在奖励最大化和多样性之间存在根本矛盾：奖励引导方法（如FK steering）倾向于生成视觉相似的图像，无法为用户提供多样化选择；纯多样性方法（如NegToMe）不考虑用户偏好，可能产生低质量图像；而联合目标方法（聚合奖励和多样性）允许高多样性抵消低奖励，无法保证每张图像都满足用户偏好。作者借鉴Simon的"满意化"（satisficing）理论，将生成问题重新定义。

Method: 1. 满意化形式化：定义目标分布π*，要求每张图像奖励≥ρ且整批多样性≥δ；2. SatisDive目标函数：使用softplus惩罚替代硬约束，包含奖励惩罚（Jr）和多样性惩罚（Jd），通过批次相对奖励截断τ=max rk-Δ区分高低奖励候选；3. 晚期潜在替换：对于在去噪后半阶段仍低于截断的候选，根据奖励外推预测未来奖励，若仍低于τ则替换为高奖励候选的潜在表示；4. 理论证明：证明变化奖励下限ρ定义了一个满意化-多样性Pareto前沿，且目标分布在零温极限下收敛于π*；5. 方法无需训练，在推理时通过梯度更新候选潜在。

Result: 在Pick-a-Pic和HPDv2数据集上，使用FLUX.1-dev（配合HPSv3）、SANA-1.6B和SD1.5（配合ImageReward）：1. 在匹配DreamSim时，SatisDive的最差候选奖励比FK steering最多提升0.43（FLUX）和0.70（SANA）；2. SatisDive的满意化-多样性曲线在所有设置中Pareto支配FK steering的曲线；3. 在保持高于基础模型的满意率的同时，DreamSim显著高于DAS和VASR等奖励引导方法；4. 在SD1.5上将候选数量从K=4扩展到K=16时仍保持竞争力（DreamSim 0.77 vs DAS的0.04）；5. 组件消融证实晚期潜在替换和多样性惩罚均为必要组件；6. CMMD评估显示生成图像分布最接近真实图像分布。

Conclusion: 满意化框架为文本到图像生成中奖励-多样性的权衡提供了原则性解决方案，SatisDive在无需训练的情况下有效遍历满意化-多样性Pareto前沿，显著优于现有方法。局限包括仅支持单一奖励下限，未来工作可扩展到多奖励约束。

Abstract: Text-to-image generation enables users to explore several images generated from the same prompt. For these generated images to be useful, each one must reflect the user's preferences, measured by a learned reward, and differ visually from the others to maintain diversity. Existing methods are limited: they either address reward and diversity separately or combine them in one aggregate score, enabling high diversity to offset low rewards. In this paper, we address these limitations by formulating generation as satisficing: every image (candidate) must satisfy a reward floor and the batch of images must satisfy a diversity cutoff. The reward floor controls the balance between worst-candidate reward and batch diversity; we show that varying this floor defines a Pareto frontier. To traverse this frontier, we introduce SatisDive, a training-free inference-time method. SatisDive uses a batch-relative reward cutoff to distinguish lower- from higher-reward candidates, emphasizing reward improvement for candidates below the cutoff and diversity among candidates above it. On Pick-a-Pic, at matched DreamSim, SatisDive improves worst-candidate reward over FK steering by up to 0.43 with FLUX.1-dev as the base model and HPSv3 as the reward, and by up to 0.70 with SANA-1.6B as the base model and ImageReward as the reward. More broadly, across their overlapping DreamSim ranges, SatisDive's satisfaction-diversity curve Pareto-dominates FK steering's curve in each setting.

</details>


### [329] [THPL: A Vision-to-Language Decision Support Framework for Rainbow Trout Feeding Management in RAS](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.02378)
*Meng Liang,Guanbo Feng,Haozhuang Chi,Shilong Zhao,Zhixin Xiong,Yuhang He,Wenfeng Han,Tianhao Zhao,Zhihong Ma,Ying Liu*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出THPL框架，用于循环水产养殖系统（RAS）中虹鳟的精准投喂决策。该框架通过Fishsort提取鱼类轨迹并计算活动系数（AC），利用分层行为编码器（HBE）建模个体时间序列与群体动态，生成物理与软语义双重证据表征，并结合环境参数与专家规则，通过LoRA微调大语言模型（LLM），辅以反事实多模态直接偏好优化（mDPO）增强因果推理。实验验证了AC与专家标注投喂强度的强相关性，并显著提升决策准确率与生成质量。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在循环水产养殖系统（RAS）中，精准投喂对降低成本与提升鱼类福利至关重要。现有方法缺乏鱼类行为与管理知识之间的认知对齐，难以转化为可执行、可解释的投喂决策。论文旨在通过结合连续运动学数据与语言模型推理，弥补行为表征与管理知识间的认知鸿沟。

Method: 1. **Fishsort轨迹提取与活动系数（AC）**：从视频中提取鱼群轨迹，量化投喂强度。2. **分层行为编码器（HBE）**：结合Temporal Transformer（建模个体时间进展）与Set Transformer（建模群体动态），将轨迹张量转换为显式物理token与隐式软token的双重证据表征。4. **LLM微调与对齐**：将双token与环境参数、元数据、专家规则融合，通过LoRA微调LLM。5. **反事实多模态直接偏好优化（mDPO）**：通过反事实推理强化因果一致性与操作安全性，抑制模板化与执行偏差。

Result: 1. AC与专家标注的投喂强度呈统计显著的强单调正相关（Spearman ρ = 0.925, p < 0.001）。2. 消融实验验证双重证据token的必要性：决策准确率从33.33%（纯文本基线）提升至93.33%。3. 反事实mDPO相比标准LoRA进一步将准确率从93.33%提升至96.67%，METEOR从58.10%提升至85.30%，Self-BLEU-2从58.79%降至52.88%，Distinct-3从6.68%提升至7.81%，有效抑制模板化偏差并增强因果一致性。

Conclusion: THPL框架通过融合连续运动学表征与语言模型推理，为精准水产养殖提供了一种新颖的决策支持范式，显著提升了投喂决策的可执行性、可解释性与操作安全性。

Abstract: In Recirculating Aquaculture Systems (RAS), precision feeding is critical for minimizing costs and improving fish welfare. However, existing methods lack cognitive alignment between fish behaviors and management knowledge, impeding translation into executable, interpretable feeding decisions. To address this, we propose THPL, a generative feeding decision framework tailored for rainbow trout (Oncorhynchus mykiss) in RAS. First, Fishsort extracts trajectories to establish an Activity Coefficient (AC) quantifying feeding intensity. Second, a Hierarchical Behavior Encoder (HBE) models individual temporal progression and collective dynamics using Temporal and Set Transformers, transforming trajectory tensors into dual-evidence representations of explicit physical and implicit soft tokens. Finally, these tokens are integrated with environmental parameters, metadata, and expert rules to fine-tune an LLM via LoRA, followed by counterfactual multimodal Direct Preference Optimization (mDPO) to reinforce causal reasoning. Results show that AC exhibits a statistically significant monotonic positive correlation with expert-annotated feeding intensity (Spearman $\rho = 0.925$, $p < 0.001$). Ablations indicate that decision accuracy improves from 33.33% (text-only baseline) to 93.33% with dual-evidence tokens, confirming that continuous spatiotemporal tokens provide necessary physical grounding for LLMs. Compared with standard LoRA, counterfactual mDPO elevates decision accuracy from 93.33% to 96.67%, advances METEOR from 58.10% to 85.30%, reduces Self-BLEU-2 from 58.79% to 52.88%, and increases Distinct-3 from 6.68% to 7.81%, suppressing templating and actuation biases while reinforcing causal consistency and operational safety. Overall, by integrating continuous kinematics with LLM reasoning, this study provides a novel decision support paradigm for precision aquaculture.

</details>


### [330] [FlashSinkhorn 2: Block-Sparse Entropic Optimal Transport](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.02395)
*Felix X.-F. Ye,Yu Chin Fabian Lim,Naigang Wang,Davis Wertheimer*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: FlashSinkhorn 2 (FS2) 是一个面向平方欧几里得代价、低维点云上大规模离散熵正则化最优传输（EOT）的单 GPU 求解器。它通过耦合"粗阶段（基于单元质心的 Sinkhorn）"与"块稀疏细阶段（基于 Morton 排序块的屏蔽与张量核执行）"，并采用基于抽样边缘残差的停止规则，在保证边缘残差达到容差的前提下，将复杂度从 O(nm) 降至 O(nm/B²)。在单张 A100 上，FS2 在不到 2.5 小时内求解了两个 1.34×10⁸ 粒子（来自宇宙学 N 体模拟 Quijote）的离散 EOT 问题，达到全粒子边缘残差低于 0.01，是迄今在该精度下几小时内可求解的最大规模离散 EOT 问题。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有流式 GPU Sinkhorn 求解器（如 FlashSinkhorn、GeomLoss/KeOps）虽然避免了存储 nm 密集核，但仍需在每次迭代中评估所有 nm 个点对，限制了可处理的规模（通常 ≤ 10⁵–10⁶ 粒子）。多尺度 Sinkhorn 方法通过空间粗化和基于势的截断减少计算量，但存在三个实际问题：粗化解精度检查需 O(nm)、点对筛选需 O(nm)、且幸存点对在行间分布不均不适合张量核的固定大小瓦片。宇宙学等领域已出现 10⁸ 量级的点云，亟需能在单 GPU 上求解的大规模离散 EOT 方法。

Method: FS2 包含两个阶段：(1) 粗阶段——将点按 Morton 排序分组为单元，用质心代替点进行退火 Sinkhorn 迭代，将势"提升"到原始点，并用 O(md) 成本的抽样边缘检查判断是否满足容差 τ，若失败则在质心上继续迭代或进入细阶段；(2) 块稀疏细阶段——将点划分为大小为 B 的连续 Morton 块，使用两阶段屏蔽（包围盒筛选 + 瓦片验证），基于定理 1（块质量控制的可忽略瓦片边界）构建索引 A，仅在保留的 B×B 瓦片上通过 FlashSinkhorn 的流式 Triton 内核执行对称半步，并在张量核上做 TF32 矩阵乘；自动策略按 L2 预算选择 B∈{64,128,256} 和单元层数 t。理论保证包括：命题 1 分离了粗阶段残差与质心替换误差；定理 1 保证被省略瓦片对每行每列的贡献以 δ_rel 为界；命题 2 给出稀疏更新与密集更新的差距以及质心投影误差界。

Result: 在 32 个合成问题（n=m 从 2¹⁹ 到 2²³，ε 从 0.001 到 0.02，d=3）上，FS2 全部达到 τ=0.005 的边缘残差，而 GeomLoss 多尺度仅在 10 个问题（全部异构）上达标；在两者都达标的问题上 FS2 比 GeomLoss 快 74–645×。在 n=2²¹、ε=0.001 的聚类问题上 FS2 用 15.4 s（R=0.0048），GeomLoss 用 21.4 s（R=0.054 未达标），FlashSinkhorn 用 312 s。消融实验显示：粗阶段贡献 153× 加速、稀疏细阶段贡献 8× 加速、瓦片验证贡献 1.04× 加速。在 Quijote 宇宙学 N 体模拟上（512³ 粒子），FS2 在 τ=0.05 下从 2²⁴ 扩展到 2²⁷ 粒子（时间仅增长 9.2×，内存 ≤80 GiB）；τ=0.01 下完整 2²⁷ 盒子（2⁵⁴ 个点对）在单 A100 上 2.5 小时内达到全粒子边缘残差 <0.01。位移重构的归一化 RMSE 比零位移预测器低 35.7%。

Conclusion: FS2 通过粗-细两阶段耦合、基于块质量的势依赖截断和 Morton 排序的空间局部性，将单 GPU 上的离散 EOT 求解规模推进到 1.34×10⁸ 粒子并保证边缘残差，是目前在该精度下几小时内可解的最大问题。其局限在于：仅适用于平方欧几里得代价和 d≤3（高维下模糊球内点数指数增长使筛选失效）；要达到 10¹⁰ 量级需跨多 GPU 分布块并使用次二次的点对搜索（如双树遍历）。作者开源了实现以供复现。

Abstract: Streaming GPU solvers for entropic optimal transport (EOT), such as FlashSinkhorn, avoid storing the dense kernel but still evaluate all $n\times m$ point pairs in every Sinkhorn iteration. We present \textbf{FlashSinkhorn~2} (FS2), a solver for squared-Euclidean cost on low-dimensional point clouds that solves large discrete EOT problems to a prescribed marginal residual on a single GPU by coupling two stages. A coarse stage solves on cell centroids, lifts the potentials to every point and, when a sampled marginal check rejects the lift, continues on the centroids, replacing most point-level updates. A block-sparse fine stage then removes the centroid error that coarse updates cannot. Its Morton-ordered blocks support screening and fused tensor-core execution, and a threshold set by the block masses bounds each omitted tile's contribution to every row and column. On synthetic benchmarks, FS2 reaches the target residual on all 32 problems and GeomLoss multiscale on 10. On one A100, FS2 solves discrete EOT between two $1.34\times10^8$-particle measures from a cosmological $N$-body simulation, at an entropic blur equal to the mean interparticle distance, to an all-particle marginal residual below 0.01 in under 2.5 hours. To our knowledge, it is the largest discrete EOT problem solved to this accuracy within hours. For reproducibility, we release an open-source implementation at this https URL

</details>


### [331] [When Terminal-Agent Training Stalls: Demystifying Data Generation and Verification Challenge](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.02405)
*Xi Qin,Isabel Kurth,Xin Cui,Elin Park,Alexander Schaefer,Yaad Oren*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文系统性地诊断了基于前沿大模型（如Claude Opus）作为元智能体（meta-agent）自动生成终端代理训练任务与验证器时所面临的管道失灵问题。作者提出了一套改进的五阶段数据生成与验证流程，生成了迄今最大的18,185个终端任务数据集，并通过实验证明RL训练信号质量高度依赖任务难度与目标模型的"可解性带"（solvability band）匹配，必须将可解性带校准、验证器审计与基础设施错误纳入一等评估标准。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 虽然可运行的Docker镜像和可执行的测试套件常被视为终端代理RL训练管道的合格标志，但作者发现这远不足以保证端到端管道的忠实性。前期工作（如Gandhi等2025的Endless Terminals）已暴露出约一半生成任务被丢弃的稀疏奖励问题，但未量化这种稀疏性对RL训练稳定性的影响。本文动机即在于揭示并量化这一"结构性有效≠基准有效"的差距。

Method: 1. **五阶段任务生成管道**：基于Endless Terminals骨架改造为Docker+Harbor格式，阶段1生成任务模板与真值，阶段2-3生成初始/终态pytest，阶段4生成Dockerfile，阶段5打包为Harbor任务目录。  
2. **提示工程三大维度**：工程师化叙事口吻（避免worksheet voice）、反泄漏规则（防止评分标准泄露）、领域轮询覆盖（10类任务桶）。  
3. **三档认知难度替代命令计数难度**：简单（单一明显原因）、中等（需调查后行动）、困难（误导症状/冲突约束/领域知识/大状态空间/逆向工程）。  
4. **代理前验证（Pre-Agent Validation）**：Docker镜像构建后，要求初始状态测试通过且终态测试失败，否则丢弃。  
5. **解采样与三数据集构建**：V1（4k上下文,5038任务,pass@1≈10%）、V2（8k上下文,4929任务,pass@1=56.5%）、V3（5k上下文,8218任务,pass@1=39.6%）。  
6. **三组训练实验**：E1用Qwen2.5-3B+PPO在V1上、E2用Qwen3.5-9B+GRPO在V1+V2上、E3在V1+V2+V3困难子集上。  
7. **三类失败模式诊断框架**：基准无效性、测试框架脆弱性、奖励失准。

Result: 1. **提示重设计与上下文扩展使基线可解性提升5.6倍**（V1的10% → V2的56.5%）。  
2. **E1（3B模型+V1稀疏任务）**：基线pass@1=7.8%，训练后仅5.9%，验证分数在3.9%–5.9%间震荡——稀疏奖励使梯度信号缺失。  
3. **E2（9B模型+V1+V2）**：20步内平均pass@2达81.3%，其中4步达到100%——分布饱和，优势函数塌缩。  
4. **E3（9B模型+V1+V2+V3困难任务）**：同样配置下平均pass@2降至20.6%，190步仅提升1pp，证明可解性带具有模型特异性。  
5. **失败模式量化**：Docker heredoc解析错误约占错误试验74%；Docker网络池耗尽9.1%；构建失败9.7%；去重阈值0.85下移除26.2%原始候选；并发容器从16提升至40使151任务验证集pass@2从76.8%暴跌至4.6%。  
6. **断言语义权衡**：V1到V3过程断言从5.7降至2.7、文件内容断言从5.8降至1.7，提示存在评分漂移风险。

Conclusion: 本文核心结论为：**结构性有效不等于基准有效**。元智能体生成管道必须将可解性带校准、验证器审计与基础设施错误作为一等评估标准，而非事后诊断。具体启示包括：(1) RL训练分布必须针对目标策略校准，不能依赖单一全局通过率；(2) 终端环境的低分可能反映的是Dockerfile缺陷、启动超时、网络池耗尽或异步采样偏差，而非智能体真实能力不足；(3) 应将端到端基准测试拆解为三个独立问题——环境结构是否有效、验证器是否忠实测度目标、目标策略能否求解；(4) 建议在live环境评估中将任务级错误率与pass@k联合报告，避免前缀pass@k在异步采样下的偏差。

Abstract: Using a frontier model like Claude Opus as a meta-agent to generate terminal tasks and verifiers for RL training is increasingly common. Yet a runnable Docker image and executable test suite do not guarantee a faithful end-to-end pipeline for terminal agent training. We present a meta-agent pipeline motivated by this gap, diagnosing three classes of failure: benchmark invalidity, harness brittleness, and reward misalignment. Prompt redesign and context extension raise baseline solvability 5.6 times, but a 9B model saturates at 81.3% mean pass@2 within 20 steps on Claude Opus-generated tasks. Adding hard tasks reduces mean pass@2 to 20.6% without changing the training configuration, a strong evidence that the solvability band is model-specific. These findings demonstrate that meta-agent reliability requires solvability-band calibration, verifier audits, and infrastructure error accounting as first-class evaluation criteria, not post-hoc diagnost.

</details>


### [332] [Reinforcement Learning Techniques for the Optimization of Target Polarization in Nuclear Physics Scattering Experiments](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.02452)
*Armen Kasparian,Torri Jeske,Monibor Rahman,Chris Keith,James Maxwell,Thomas Britton,Malachi Schram,David Lawrence*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文针对杰斐逊实验室动态极化靶（DNP）中微波频率的人工调谐难题，提出了一套结合替代建模（surrogate modeling）与强化学习（RL）的数据驱动控制框架。使用APOLLO系统的运行数据训练了MLP与高斯过程（GP/GPA）替代模型来预测极化度，并基于此训练TD3等RL算法。实验表明，基于多样本GPA模型的RL智能体相比人类操作员实现了约2倍的累积极化度提升。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在核物理实验中，动态极化靶需要持续手动调节微波频率以补偿辐射损伤，传统方法依赖专家经验试错，认知与操作负担重且难以扩展。ML在加速器在线控制中应用有限，亟需兼顾可靠性、可解释性的数据驱动控制方案来提升极化效率。

Method: 1. 数据预处理：对APOLLO系统P07、P11、P14运行期数据归一化处理，单样本921个事件、多样本5617个事件。2. 替代模型：构建MLP（两隐层512个神经元+NLL损失）和GP（RBF/Laplace/Cauchy核）模型预测极化度，并引入基于随机傅里叶特征的GPA以处理多样本数据。3. 模拟环境：使用Gymnasium封装替代模型，设计8维观测空间（含LCB、频率导数等）和基于下置信界的奖励结构。4. RL算法：评估DDPG、TD3、SAC三种actor-critic算法，并提出可微分轨迹优化与可微分TD3（Diff-TD3）方法融入环境梯度。5. 计算优化：对多样本GPA采用预计算查找表（LUT）方法解决33倍计算开销问题。

Result: 单样本GP模型上RL智能体性能与人类操作员相当（受LCB奖励函数约束）；基于多样本GPA的RL智能体实现了比人类操作员高约33%（最终报告为接近2倍）的累积极化度。可微分方法在小规模状态空间中优势不明显，但在收敛步数上更优。GP/GPA模型在分布外（OOD）区域表现出明显增大的不确定性，而MLP对此不敏感。

Conclusion: 数据驱动的替代模型加强化学习可有效用于极化靶微波频率优化，GP类模型因校准良好的不确定性估计优于MLP；多样本GPA结合RL能显著超越人类操作员水平。未来工作将聚焦操作集成、部署准备以及融合Bellman长期价值与可微分环境梯度的RL算法。

Abstract: The operation of dynamically polarized targets in nuclear physics experiments relies on continuous tuning of the microwave frequency to compensate for radiation damage and evolving material properties, a task that is traditionally performed through manual trial-and-error by expert operators. This work presents a data-driven control framework that combines surrogate modeling with reinforcement learning to optimize the target polarization. Using operational data from the APOLLO cryogenic target system, we train and evaluate multilayer perceptron and Gaussian process regression models to predict polarization as a function of microwave frequency, beam current, and accumulated radiation dose. We show that Gaussian process-based models provide calibrated uncertainty estimates and reliably identify regions outside the training distribution, while MLPs exhibit limited sensitivity to distributional shift. To enable learning and control across multiple target samples, we introduce a Gaussian process approximation and embed the surrogate model within a standardized simulation environment. A reinforcement learning agent is trained using a lower-confidence-bound reward formulation that balances performance maximization against uncertainty. We are able to show an almost 2x improvement on the operators actions utilizing our RL agent.

</details>


### [333] [Tropical Reinforcement Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.02478)
*Arip Asadulaev,Aladin Djuhera,Karim Salta,Holger Boche,Fakhri Karray,Martin Takac*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出"热带强化学习"(Tropical RL)，将经典期望回报中"加法"聚合备选轨迹的方式改为"取最大值"（即热带半环），使状态值等于最优已验证路径的对数概率。该方法能够跨rollout拼接从未完整采样过的解片段，实现真正的组合推理。基于此提出的TROPIC算法在Sokoban、Countdown、FrozenLake、WebShop四个智能体任务上全面优于PPO、GRPO、DAPO、SNR-Aware等强基线，最多领先16个百分点。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 大语言模型的强化学习（RLVR）通常最大化期望回报——将所有成功轨迹的概率求和。这种聚合方式存在三个根本缺陷：(1)非选择性——无法指明具体哪条路径成功；(2)作用于归一化权重——强化一条解必然抑制另一条，使已验证解在未被证伪的情况下被遗忘；(3)非幂等——同一计算被发现多次会被重复加权。这使得期望回报不适合组合推理任务，因为组合解的每个片段可能出现在不同rollout中，但完整解被一次性采样的概率随片段数d呈ρ^{-d}指数衰减。

Method: 核心方法是将Bellman方程中聚合备选轨迹的"加法"⊕替换为"取最大值"，得到max-plus（热带）半环。关键定理（定理2）证明：在连续性、(Cert)选择性（聚合结果必须是某一参与项的得分）和(Ret)保持性（加入新路径值不降）三个要求下，max是唯一满足的聚合算子。由此得到热带值V_trop(s)=max_{τ∈Y⁺} W(τ)=log P(τ*|s)，即最优已验证路径的对数概率。由于加法对max满足分配律，最优路径可在任何共享状态拆分为最优前缀和最优后缀，从而支持跨rollout拼接。算法TROPIC维护一个持久图结构，存储所有有效转移（无论来自成功还是失败rollout），前缀值F_t和后缀值V_t通过正反向DP分别计算，新路径通过采样和组合两种方式加入档案库，训练时对最佳验证路径做最大似然梯度更新（无critic、无baseline、无clipping）。附录进一步证明了：组合策略改进定理（定理4/12）保证训练一条路径可提升图中所有状态的值；指数vs对数逃逸分离定理（定理15）证明在链式任务上期望回报需要ρ^{-d}步而热带方法仅需O(log(1/ρ))步。

Result: 在四个agentic任务上使用Qwen2.5-3B-Instruct和Gemma-4-E4B-it两个模型进行实验。TROPIC在所有任务和模型上均取得最高成功率，且生成token数和训练时间均低于或持平于基线：Sokoban上相对最强基线SNR-Aware最多提升16.2个百分点（Qwen）；Countdown上提升5.9-6.0个百分点；FrozenLake上提升7.2-9.1个百分点；WebShop上提升4.6-6.9个百分点。消融实验表明：(1)禁用组合（No Composition）使成功率从58.4%降至40.8%，是最大降幅；(2)禁用前沿重启（Root-Only）降至51.8%；(3)仅允许成功rollout的片段组合（Succ.-Only）降至53.3%。31.6%的已解决训练问题是首次通过从未完整采样过的组合解被解决的。TROPIC还优于MaxRL（51.3%）、GiGPO（47.6%）和GiGPO+T-STAR（53.1%）。

Conclusion: 本文证明强化学习的"代数选择"（用max替代sum聚合备选轨迹）能从根本上改善语言模型的组合推理能力。热带值具备三个期望回报不具备的性质：选择性（指向具体路径）、幂等性（重复发现不增权重）、单调性（发现新路径值不降）。组合策略改进定理保证训练一个已验证路径可传播到图中所有相关状态，包括从未训练过的接口状态。这为持续自我改进提供了天然机制——已验证能力可保留并被后续能力复用。限制在于：对于参数共享的语言模型，单步更新对其他问题的干扰使严格单调性降为启发式保证；档案库向模型权重的无损迁移仍是开放问题。本文的核心启示是：组合推理的核心障碍不在估计器层面，而在聚合代数层面。

Abstract: Reinforcement learning for large language models typically maximizes expected return, adding up the probabilities of all successful trajectories. However, the classical sum formulation can only report how often the model policy succeeds, not which solution actually worked, and because probabilities sum to one, reinforcing one solution can make the model forget another that was never shown to be wrong. This makes expected return a poor fit for compositional reasoning, where a solution must be assembled from reasoning steps that the model produces in separate, often failed, attempts but rarely produces together. To address this, we propose Tropical Reinforcement Learning, which rests on a simple change of algebra: instead of adding the probabilities of alternative solutions, we take their maximum, which yields the tropical semiring. The value of a state then becomes the log-probability of its most likely verified solution, together with an explicit path that can be replayed and reused. This enables true composition, since the best prefix and the best suffix meeting at a shared state can be joined even when they come from different rollouts. To put this into practice, we introduce TROPIC, a training algorithm for deterministic, resettable environments with verifiable outcomes. On four agentic tasks (Sokoban, Countdown, FrozenLake, WebShop), TROPIC outperforms the strongest on-policy baselines by up to 16 percentage points. Changing the algebra of reinforcement learning, not just its estimators, can thus substantially improve compositional reasoning in language models

</details>


### [334] [MEA: A Reward-Driven Multi-Agent System for Faithful Model Explanations](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.02480)
*Yuyang Cheng,Raghav Kaushik Ravi,Srivarshinee Sridhar,Sriparna Saha,Akash Ghosh,Chirag Agarwal*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: MEA提出了一种基于强化学习的多智能体框架（Proposer+Actor），通过GRPO端到端优化，以扰动式忠实度为奖励信号，在表格/文本/视觉三种模态下生成自然语言解释。该框架在6个数据集上系统性地优于事后解释器、Agentic基线和闭源前沿LLM，跨数据集/模型/问题类型均展现强泛化能力。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: ML模型在高风险领域中的不透明性严重阻碍了信任建立。现有事后解释方法（如LIME、SHAP）输出固定类型且要求专业配置，对领域专家构成高知识壁垒；会话式解释系统(CEF)虽降低使用门槛但缺乏学习组件且未跨模态大规模评估，LLM系统性地产生不忠实的解释。

Method: MEA采用双智能体架构：(1) Proposer智能体根据问题类型Q_i、输入x和预测ŷ生成结构化策略S=(s_type, T_sel, A_auto)，从{autonomous, tools, hybrid}中选择推理模式；(2) Actor智能体执行工具并将原始输出合成为自然语言解释e∈E_m。两者共享同一LoRA微调的Qwen3.6-35B-A3B多模态骨干。通过GRPO联合优化，奖励为扰动式忠实度度量m_i配合模态自适应惩罚：视觉模态施加λ_size=0.3的边界框面积惩罚ρ，所有模态施加ℓ_1工具数量惩罚(λ_tool=0.05, n_max=9)。定义10类问题分三组（特征归因Q1-Q4、反事实Q5-Q7、虚假特征Q8-Q10），构建Mea-Bench基准（13K训练+3.5K测试，跨3模态/6数据集/6模型架构）。

Result: 在6个数据集上，MEA相对于未训练骨干在忠实度上提升+28%（表格）、+21%（文本）、+34%（视觉）。在反事实问题上：表格0.855（vs Base Agent 0.670），文本0.708（vs Gemini-3.1 0.574），视觉0.598（vs GPT-5.4 0.328）。在Q1特征归因上优于最佳post-hoc解释器（表格+30%，文本+12%，视觉统计等价p=0.944）。OOD泛化测试（Yelp+BERT/German Credit+NN/CIFAR-10+ResNet-18）上整体忠实度均领先基线（表格0.581 vs 0.379；文本0.689 vs 0.625；视觉0.576 vs 0.448）。合成短路合理性检验：MEA在注入verification_flag的人工偏置分类器上正确识别短路的比例(12/13)显著高于基线(9/13)。消融实验证明：(1) Hybrid训练避免Sequential训练的灾难性遗忘；(2) RL训练优于推理时Critic反思（文本反事实+36%，视觉反事实+30%）；(3) Proposer自由选择hybrid策略(0.748)优于强制tool_only(0.731)和autonomous_only(0.668)；(4) 4B小骨干同样获得显著提升（视觉+258%）。统计显著性经Welch's t检验验证。

Conclusion: MEA验证了"学习如何解释"比"提示如何解释"更为有效：AI智能体本身可作为ML可解释性的可扩展、自适应接口，开辟了超越固定单一用途工具的自然语言可解释性路径。未来工作包括扩展至分类以外的任务、可扩展工具库以及非扰动式忠实度信号。

Abstract: Recent years have seen the employment of a plethora of machine learning (ML) models in high-stakes domains, but they remain largely opaque to the practitioners who act on their predictions. While post-hoc explanation methods offer a lens into this model behavior, wielding them effectively demands expertise most domain experts lack: navigating high-dimensional outputs, selecting the best explanations, and synthesizing evidence across disparate tools. To this end, we present MEA, a multi-agent framework that removes the explanation knowledge barrier entirely: a Proposer agent selects and configures explanation tools based on the question and modality, while an Actor agent is optimized end-to-end against faithfulness, transforming the outputs into natural language explanations grounded in model behavior across tabular, text, and vision modalities. Further, we introduce diverse question types spanning feature attribution, counterfactual reasoning, and spurious feature detection, each paired with a perturbation-based faithfulness metric. We find that frontier LLMs systematically produce unfaithful explanations. By optimizing against faithfulness rewards augmented with a modality-adaptive penalty, MEA consistently outperforms post hoc explainers, agentic, and closed-source baselines across six datasets, with reward-driven optimization yielding faithfulness gains of +28% (tabular), +21% (text), and +34% (vision) over the untrained backbone. More broadly, our findings suggest that AI agents themselves can serve as a scalable, adaptable interface to ML explainability, opening a path toward natural-language explainability that generalizes beyond the fixed, single-purpose tools that have long defined the field.

</details>


### [335] [What Does a Token Cost? A Mixture-of-Agents Measurement of Sufficient Per-Token Compute](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.02491)
*Zhixu Du,Weijia Han,Hai Helen Li,Yiran Chen*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 论文提出"充分计算"概念，通过token级Mixture-of-Agents方法测量LLM生成每个token所需的最小计算量，揭示计算集中在少数"昂贵"token上，并证明该测量可改进模型路由和推测解码的效率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 当前LLM为每个token分配相同计算量，但许多token无需如此多计算即可正确生成。推测解码、模型路由等方法均基于"部分计算冗余"的假设，却从未被直接测量过单个token真正需要多少计算。论文旨在填补这一空白。

Method: 构建一个由15个不同容量语言模型组成的专家组（覆盖Qwen2.5、OLMo-2、DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Qwen三个家族），在参考序列的每个token位置让所有模型尝试复现下一token。能成功复现该token的最小模型所耗FLOPs定义为该token的"充分计算"（sufficient compute），作为token实际所需计算的上界。通过teacher-forcing评估，并控制惊奇度、位置等因素比较不同家族的复现排序一致性。

Result: 1) 0.5B模型可复现92-95%的参考token；2) 跨Qwen、OLMo、R1蒸馏专家组，最昂贵的10% token占总FLOPs的64-80%；3) 控制混杂因素后，不同家族的部分秩相关系数为0.32-0.48，表明复现难度排序存在跨家族共识；4) 基于测量图的MATH-500路由将投影延迟从7.59秒降至5.12秒，精度略优于最佳置信路由基线；5) 基于测量图的推测解码起草减少32.6%的草稿token，投影延迟降低约20%。

Conclusion: LLM生成中绝大多数token可由小模型复现，少量"昂贵尾"token贡献了大部分计算；不同模型家族共享复现难度排序；但低复制成本不能保证可靠续接。利用充分计算图改进路由和推测解码存在显著效率空间，无需预知参考答案即可利用该结构是实际部署的核心挑战。

Abstract: Large language models spend the same amount of computation on every token they generate, regardless of how difficult each token is to produce. Methods such as speculative decoding and model routing are built on the premise that much of this computation is unnecessary, yet the computation an individual token actually requires has not been measured. We measure it through a Mixture-of-Agents (MoA) lens: a panel of fifteen language models of increasing capacity, drawn from three families, in which every agent attempts to reproduce a reference sequence token by token, conditioned on the correct preceding tokens. We define the inference cost of the smallest agent that succeeds as the token's sufficient compute, which upper-bounds what the token requires. On three core benchmarks, a 0.5B agent reproduces 92--95\% of reference tokens. Across Qwen, OLMo, and R1-distilled panels, the most expensive 10\% account for 64--80\% of estimated FLOPs. On all 500 MATH-500 problems, the MoA-derived map helps model routing reduce projected latency from 7.59 to 5.12 seconds while slightly improving accuracy, relative to the best confidence-routing baseline. The MoA-map helps drafting use 32.6\% fewer draft tokens and approximately 20\% lower projected latency than fixed-window drafting at similar accuracy. These comparisons reveal remaining allocation headroom, motivating controllers that exploit sufficient-compute structure.

</details>


### [336] [Right Order, Wrong Scale: Auditing LLM Judges for Occupational AI Measurement](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.02492)
*Harry Lyu,Neil Thompson*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 该论文提出 O*NET-BENCH 审计套件，系统评估了 33 种 LLM 评判器配置在职业 AI 测量中的有效性，核心发现是：评判器在响应排序上的高度一致性并不意味着其在评分水平、接受率和职业级聚合指标上与人类工作者一致，排序准确率作为选择标准具有误导性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 随着 LLM 评判器被广泛用于评估 AI 输出是否满足工作要求，研究者通常仅依据排序一致性（如配对准确率、相关性）来选择评判器，但这种方法忽视了评分量表本身的差异。作者将这种做法称为"量表盲选择"（scale-blind selection），旨在审计其后果，并探究排序协议变化是否会在提升响应级排序的同时损害聚合级一致性。

Method: 1. 构建 O*NET-BENCH：基于 Mertens 等人 45,796 条工作者评分语料，定义任务和工作者不相交的数据划分；2. 评估 33 种预存评判器配置（涵盖 6 个模型家族）与 6 种训练拟合基线；3. 在三个层面进行审计——序数有效性（配对准确率）、基数有效性（均值偏差、SD 比、接受份额）和聚合有效性（任务/职业级均值相关性）；4. 在微调系列中进行预注册协议反转验证；5. 通过交叉验证校准和预测辅助估计（PPI）测试评分修复方法。

Result: 1. 排序信号广泛但浅层：25 种配置的平局感知配对准确率 ≥0.60，但仅基于响应的 TF-IDF 基线几乎追平最强评判器；2. 评分水平系统性偏离：所有 33 种配置的均值偏差区间均排除零值，接受率范围 3.0%–97.9%（工人为 61.1%）；3. 排序性能与评分放置几乎无关（Pearson 相关性 -0.22）；4. 在双轮微调系列中，从逐点评分切换到少样本/列表式协议使响应排序提升（Spearman +0.049）但任务级（-0.119）和职业级（-0.167）均值相关性下降，该反转在预注册验证中复现；5. 校准虽能消除均值偏差，但校准后评分至多解释 8.5% 的个体评分方差；6. 预测辅助估计仅带来微小精度提升。

Conclusion: 仅靠排序一致性不足以支撑职业测量；评判器应针对其将用于估计的接受率和聚合指标进行验证。报告应明确目标决策层级、报告带平局和覆盖率的排序指标、报告评分分布、纳入简单基线控制、进行分层聚类的不确定性估计，并在独立确认数据上验证配置比较。作者提出六项报告标准以指导职业 AI 评估实践。

Abstract: LLM judges are increasingly used to assess whether AI outputs meet workplace requirements, but agreement on response rankings does not establish agreement on acceptance rates or occupational aggregates. We introduce O*NET-BENCH, an audit suite derived from an existing survey of 45,796 worker ratings, and evaluate 33 pre-existing judge configurations across six model families on 4,501 test ratings. Twenty-five configurations achieve tie-aware pair accuracy of at least 0.60, although a train-fitted response-only TF-IDF baseline nearly matches the strongest judge. Despite this ordering agreement, judges estimate that 3.0%-97.9% of responses are acceptable, compared with 61.1% for occupation-matched workers. In one fine-tuned lineage, changing from pointwise scoring to a bundled few-shot/listwise protocol improves response ordering while reducing agreement with worker means at the task and occupation levels; this reversal replicates on a task- and worker-disjoint validation split under prespecified criteria. Cross-validated calibration largely removes mean bias, but calibrated scores explain at most 8.5% of individual worker-rating variance. Prediction-assisted estimation yields at most small precision gains at the studied label budgets. These results show that ranking agreement alone is insufficient for occupational measurement. Judges should be validated against the acceptance rates and aggregates their scores will be used to estimate.

</details>


### [337] ["I just assumed that it would translate": examining MT risk awareness among healthcare staff with abbreviations as a use case](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.02496)
*Eleanor Taylor-Stilgoe,Félix do Carmo,Constantin Orăsan*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文研究了英国医护人员使用机器翻译（主要为Google Translate）与非英语患者沟通时存在的风险，特别是以医学缩写为案例，揭示了对MT潜在风险认识不足及由此可能引发的患者安全问题。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 英国公共医疗系统的员工广泛依赖Google Translate进行跨语言沟通，但现有研究多聚焦于人际交流场景或面向患者的文档翻译，对患者医疗记录翻译的关注不足。鉴于医学缩写在单语环境下已具有较高风险（误用可能导致患者受到暂时伤害甚至死亡），作者选择医学缩写作为切入点，探讨MT翻译医学缩写可能带来的风险，以及医护人员对此类风险的认知程度。

Method: 研究采用定性研究方法。作者从权威临床语料库中选取具有上下文情境的法语和西班牙语数据示例，通过Google Translate进行翻译，并基于这些翻译结果对21名来自不同职位和专科的医护人员进行半结构化访谈。随后对访谈结果进行定性分析及交叉分析。

Result: 论文摘要未明确列出具体结果数据。但从方法描述可推断，研究揭示了医护人员在高风险场景下使用MT（尤其是翻译医学缩写）时存在的风险认知不足问题，并可能呈现出不同角色和专科人员对MT风险理解的多样性。

Conclusion: 论文摘要未直接给出明确结论，但研究旨在填补MT在医疗记录翻译场景中风险研究的空白，凸显对医护人员开展MT风险教育与制定相关使用指南的必要性，以保障患者安全。

Abstract: In the UK, public healthcare staff report turning to machine translation (MT) - predominantly Google Translate (GT) - to communicate with patients across language barriers. Though intended to support their duty of care, potentially uninformed reliance on MT in such contexts could have serious consequences for patient safety. Research nonetheless remains limited on staff awareness of the possible risks posed by higher-stakes MT use in general and with patient medical records in particular, most existing literature instead examining its use in interpersonal situations or with patient-oriented documentation. Moreover, medical abbreviations are well-documented as increasing patient risk even monolingually, with outcomes from their misuse and/or misinterpretation ranging from temporary harm to the death of the patient. Abbreviations were therefore selected as a use case for identifying the potential risks posed by their translation with MT. Contextualised French and Spanish data examples drawn from authoritative clinical corpora and translated via GT were presented during semi-structured interviews to 21 healthcare staff participants in diverse roles and specialties. The results were then subject to qualitative analysis and cross-analysis.

</details>


### [338] [HXAI: Hierarchical Privacy-Preserving Explainable AI in Distributed Energy Systems](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.02504)
*Poushali Sengupta,Sabita Maharjan,Frank Eliassen,Yan Zhang*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: HXAI提出了一种分层隐私保护可解释AI框架，在分布式能源系统中实现家庭级噪声自由SHAP解释与区域级差分隐私聚合的协同，通过语义结构（特征身份、排序、方向性）而非数值精度作为隐私下可解释性的关键标准。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 可再生能源的间歇性和家庭用电的随机性使电网负荷管理日益困难，电网运营商需要细粒度的可解释信号来设计需求响应策略，但传统XAI（如SHAP、LIME）可能泄露敏感家庭行为；标准差分隐私虽能保护隐私，却会损害解释的有用性，且现有方法（联邦学习、本地差分隐私、加密方法）缺乏对家电级细粒度可解释性、重复查询下的隐私泄露控制以及动态隐私预算协商的支持。

Method: HXAI采用两层分层架构：(1)本地层——每户在私有数据盒（基于TEE的Private Data Box）内训练预测模型并生成噪声自由的SHAP解释，原始数据永不离开家庭边界；(2)区域层——通过Laplace机制对各家庭SHAP摘要加噪并聚合，形成差分隐私保护的区域解释。核心机制包括：信息控制协议（ICA）管理查询范围、输出粒度和累积隐私预算；隐私效用协商目标（max U(ε_i)−λ_i·ε_i）实现动态预算协商；累积泄露阈值L_i^max在查询序列超限时自动拒绝进一步查询。理论上证明了区域DP-SHAP的无偏性、误差上界以及余弦相似度效用下界。

Result: 在UCI Appliances、UCI Household Power和UCI Bike Sharing三个真实数据集以及50户模拟系统上的实验表明：(1)HXAI在MAE、Spearman秩相关和余弦相似度上均显著优于Central DP-SHAP，排名稳定性和方向一致性接近oracle；(2)在同质归属场景（UCI Appliances、Bike）均匀隐私分配最优，在异质场景（UCI Household Power）协商式分配更优；(4)区域解释在ε=6.73等中等隐私预算下保持家电级稳定结构，洗衣机的峰值驱动角色在区域汇总中得以保留；(5)引导家电升级干预后24小时电价峰值显著降低，负荷曲线更平滑；(6)累积隐私泄露在阈值达到后自动停止查询；(3)家电量在差分隐私下保持语义结构稳定（特征身份、排序、方向性），证明语义稳定性而非数值精度才是DP下可解释性的核心标准。

Conclusion: HXAI为分布式能源系统提供了一个分层、查询感知、以解释为中心的隐私保护架构，证明了透明度与隐私可同时兼顾。语义稳定性（而非数值精度）才是隐私保护下可解释AI的关键标准。该框架理论上保证DP-SHAP聚合的无偏性、可预测的线性误差增长和有界累积泄露；通过层次聚合、本地噪声自由可解释性、动态隐私预算协商与查询感知隐私核算，在严格隐私约束下为电网运营商提供决策相关的区域洞察，同时确保家电级消费数据始终本地化、永不外传。该方法可推广至医疗健康等需要在形式化隐私保证下兼顾本地可解释性与聚合洞察的其他敏感领域。

Abstract: Balancing electricity demand and supply is increasingly difficult due to the inherent intermittency of renewable power generation and the stochastic power consumption. Grid operators require fine-grained, decision-relevant insights into household energy consumption to manage peak loads and design responsive tariffs, but increased transparency at this level raises significant privacy concerns. Traditional methods for explainable AI (XAI) can reveal sensitive information, while standard privacy techniques often reduce the usefulness of explanations. To address this issue, we introduce HXAI, a hierarchical framework that preserves privacy while enabling reasonable explainable analysis for grid-level demand management. HXAI consists of two main components: (1) a local model that generates fine-grained explanations within a secure, private environment, and (2) a zonal model that aggregates these explanations to support grid-level analysis while enforcing privacy through flexible privacy-budget management. We explicitly limit cumulative privacy exposure under repeated operator queries and show that the proposed framework preserves decision-relevant information without compromising household privacy. Experiments on both simulated and real-world energy datasets demonstrate that HXAI provides useful insights for zonal load management while ensuring that appliance-level consumption remains local and is never transmitted to grid operators. Our results show that preserving the semantic structure of explanations, rather than minimizing numerical error, is the key to XAI under differential privacy. This framework provides a way to achieve both privacy and explainability in energy management.

</details>


### [339] [World Action Modeling with Progressive Visual Planning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.02508)
*Fei Zhang,Zhaochong An,Duncan Frost,Yikai Wang,Pengfei Liu,Ya Zhang,Michal Drozdzal,Amir Bar*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: ProWAM 提出了一种渐进式世界动作模型，通过联合预测动作和按相对进度索引的稀疏视觉子目标序列，为长视域机器人控制提供显式视觉引导，避免了密集视频展开的高计算成本，在仿真和零样本真实实验中均达到 SOTA 性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有世界动作模型（WAM）在长视域预测上存在权衡：full-imagination WAM 需要密集视频展开，计算开销大；zero-imagination WAM 缺乏中间进度引导；ImageWAM 仅预测单一终点帧，忽略任务推进过程。本文旨在解决这一权衡，通过稀疏、按进度排序的视觉子目标提供显式中间引导。

Method: ProWAM 采用视觉-动作混合 Transformer（MoT）架构，包含视频生成专家和基于扩散的动作专家。视频专家在统一潜在序列中联合预测近未来转换与按归一化进度 r∈[0,1] 索引的 k 个稀疏视觉子目标，通过 adaLN 调制注入进度条件。子目标 token 之间双向注意、与视频 token 双向潜在交流，跨视觉-动作采用非对称耦合（动作→视觉，但视觉↛动作）。训练分两阶段：Stage 1 在大规模无动作视频（DROID、AgiBot、OpenX）上预训练视频专家；Stage 2 在任务数据上联合微调视频与动作专家。推理时采用 KV-cache 策略，单次视频前向传播缓存子目标特征，动作去噪复用缓存，避免重复计算。

Result: 仿真基准上：LIBERO-Plus 达到 85.8% SOTA（相对最强基线提升 +35.9%）；随机化 RoboTwin 达 75.7%（OOD 鲁棒性提升 +20.0）；RoboCasa365 综合 48.1% 排名第 4，Composite-Unseen 上 18.2% 排名第 2。零样本真实实验中，ProWAM 在 Franka 上达到 70.0% 成功率，较 DreamZero（55.0%）提升 +15.0（相对 +27.3%）。效率方面，KV-1 推理将视频专家调用从 10 次降至 1 次，计算量减少约 86.7%。消融实验验证：k=4 子目标在 OOD 上达到峰值（75.7%）；Near 进度区间（[0.1, 0.5]）优于 Mid 和 Far；移除显式子目标条件（ProWAM-Light）使 OOD 性能从 85.8% 降至 80.3%。

Conclusion: ProWAM 通过原生集成进度条件视觉子目标预测与动作生成，在统一生成框架中实现视觉规划与物理控制的结合，无需独立高层规划器。其可扩展的无动作视频预训练特性使其能利用大规模视频语料提升样本效率。仿真与真实实验验证了渐进式视觉预测作为视觉想象与机器人控制之间有效接口的价值。局限包括：推理时子目标进度表需手动设置、模型规模与预训练数据量受算力限制、任务多样性有待进一步扩展。

Abstract: World action models (WAMs) have emerged as a promising paradigm for robotic control by jointly predicting future visual dynamics and actions from an initial observation and instruction. However, existing WAMs struggle with long-horizon prediction, as generating dense video rollouts is highly inefficient. Some recent WAMs address this by predicting a single future frame without generating the full video, but this approach neglects how to progress toward the goal. We present ProWAM, a progressive world action model that jointly predicts actions and an ordered sequence of sparse visual sub-goals, providing explicit visual guidance to anchor action generation throughout task execution. This design scales naturally, as sub-goal prediction can be learned from large-scale action-free videos, allowing the video backbone to offload complex visual planning from the action policy. For efficient action generation, ProWAM executes a single video-backbone forward pass to cache sparse sub-goal features, eliminating iterative full-video generation and requiring only lightweight action denoising during replanning. Across extensive evaluations, ProWAM achieves superior out-of-distribution robustness. On simulation benchmarks, it sets new state-of-the-art results on LIBERO-Plus (85.8%) and randomized RoboTwin (75.7%), outperforming the strongest baseline with relative gains of up to +35.9%. On RoboCasa365, ProWAM achieves a 48.1% success rate and 18.2% on the challenging Composite-Unseen split, ranking 4th overall. Crucially, in zero-shot real-world experiments, ProWAM achieves 70.0% success, outperforming the strongest baseline by +15.0 (from 55.0% to 70.0%, a +27.3% relative gain) in novel scenes. These results demonstrate the value of progress-indexed visual foresight for closed-loop control. Our program is in this https URL .

</details>


### [340] [On-Premises Multi-Course RAG Tutoring for Business Education: Hardware-Software Trade-offs in a Campus AI Tutor](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.02510)
*Sidney Shapiro,Joshua Lindemann*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文介绍了CourseChat——一个部署在校园内部、为本科商科教育设计的多课程RAG（检索增强生成）辅导系统。文章重点报告了在双节点边缘AI主机上的硬件-软件权衡实验，包括两轮生成模型对比、固定证据源忠实度测试以及会话与测验审计，最终保留了8B模型作为生产部署。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 商科课程需要AI辅导系统既能基于指定教材给出有依据的回答，又能将教材和学生对话保留在校园基础设施内（数据合规与隐私）。核心挑战在于：如何在有限的GPU内存、并发课堂使用、LMS嵌入以及严格的课程隔离要求下，将模型选择、检索配置和服务兼容性作为一个整体的工程权衡问题来处理。

Method: CourseChat系统采用FastAPI+Qdrant+Ollama的本地化双节点（Node A/B）架构，通过CRN（课程参考号）实现六门课程的隔离；RAG流程包括查询嵌入、混合检索、元数据过滤、交叉编码器重排序和带引用生成。系统包含会话路由（处理社交、课程、混合、跟进和澄清轮次）和预构建测验题库（65个模块共435题）。评估方法包括两轮Ollama模型对比（固定检索与token限制）、12案例的固定证据忠实度诊断、20对话/80轮次的多轮会话冻结夹具测试，以及10请求的现场教材审计。

Result: 第一轮对比中，所有更大的稠密模型（Qwen2.5 14B、Gemma 12B、Qwen3 14B）虽通过12/12现场探针，但延迟为8B基线的1.75–3.36倍，全部未通过30%延迟上限的课堂速度门槛。第二轮中，Qwen 7B（1.01倍）和Mistral Nemo 12B（1.24倍）通过速度门槛，但教师配对评审尚未完成。35B-A3B混合专家候选在3项修正上有改进但引入了新的事实性和连续性错误（如将有条件的现金持有益处夸大为保证），故未激活。软件改进方面，共享解析器将五门课程的跟进主题命中率从23.3–40.0%提升至90–100%，且无需更换生成器。435道预构建题目在双节点上通过完整工件审计，温暖延迟中位数仅4.8–5.8毫秒。

Conclusion: 保留llama3.1:8B是依据不完整质量证据下的部署决策，而非声称8B是最优规模；可信的7B和12B候选仍待进一步评估。模型选择、证据选择、服务兼容性和产品设计应被视为一个联合工程决策。文章未声称已证明学习收益——教师评分、峰值负载能力和完整公网关验收仍是独立的评估需求。下一步需要延迟期独立评估、并发浏览器到网关时序测量以及配对的教师评审。

Abstract: Campus AI tutors based on retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) must ground answers in assigned course materials while keeping textbooks and student dialogue on institutional infrastructure. We present CourseChat, an on-premises, multi-course RAG tutor for undergraduate business education, deployed behind a campus web gateway and intended for use embedded in Moodle. Six isolated course offerings, each keyed by its own course reference number (CRN), share twin-edge AI hosts running a FastAPI service, a local vector database, and a local large language model (LLM) served by Ollama. We report two generation-model bake-off rounds, a separate fixed-evidence source-fidelity comparison, and conversation and quiz audits. Several larger models failed the classroom speed gate, but a 12B model and a 7B alternative passed. A separate mixture-of-experts candidate improved some corrections while introducing new factual and continuity errors. We therefore retain the 8B production model pending a demonstrated overall improvement, rather than claiming that 8B is universally optimal. Software changes improved follow-up topic resolution while preserving course scope; 435 prebuilt questions across 65 modules decouple practice from live generation. The results support treating model choice, evidence selection, serving compatibility, and product design as a joint engineering decision. They do not establish learning gains: faculty ratings, peak-load capacity, and complete public-gateway acceptance remain separate evaluation needs.

</details>


### [341] [Hypothesis-guided discovery of cognitive algorithms via program refinement](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.02523)
*Huiwen Alex Yang,Mark K. Ho,Bill D. Thompson*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种将认知算法发现视为程序精化（program refinement）问题的混合框架。该框架将人类编写的认知模型表示为概率程序，由大语言模型（LLM）智能体在研究者指定的约束下进行迭代修改，识别模型与行为之间的不匹配并提出代码级修订，再通过概率推断模块评估修订后程序的拟合度。在一个需要推理颜色依赖关系的有色灯网格问题解决任务上，该方法在150名被试的数据上系统性地改进了模型拟合度，并揭示出一组以"损伤修复"为核心的反复出现的算法创新。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统认知建模依赖固定的候选模型集合，依赖人类专业知识但缺乏灵活性，难以捕捉算法结构化行为中丰富的个体差异。新兴的基于大语言模型的认知模型自动生成方法虽然灵活可扩展，但缺乏人类专家知识的引导，且多应用于较为简单的决策任务，较少涉及算法恢复这一更具挑战性的领域。因此需要一种既能利用人类专家理论假设、又能借助LLM扩展性的混合方法。

Method: 系统包含四个模块：(1) Game模块（LLM驱动）——分析参与者行为轨迹，生成结构化的策略修订信号及自然语言解释；(2) Coding模块（LLM驱动）——将修订信号转换为可执行的FlipPy概率程序代码；(3) Audit模块（LLM驱动）——在FlipPy运行时环境下验证程序语法与运行正确性，必要时进行有界修复；(4) Inference模块（非LLM）——使用标准概率推断方法计算修订后程序的数据似然。研究者提供三个先验认知模型（空间策略SP、按色分块CB、两阶段层次填充TP）作为基线，LLM智能体在研究者指定的结构约束内进行针对性修订。每个参与者与每个基线策略组合运行两次系统，生成的修订程序按语义相似性聚类，每个聚类选取3个代表性变体（共24个）进行后续评估。

Result: 基线模型在三种实验条件下（小复杂、小简单、大简单）的拟合覆盖率95%–100%。系统共生成846个候选修订程序，审计通过733个（86.6%），识别出8个反复出现的修订聚类（CB族3个、SP族2个、TP族3个）。在53.2%（74/139）的参与者中，修订策略提供了优于基线策略族的最佳拟合；在三个策略族内部均有提升（CB: 54%，SP: 76.9%，TP: 80.4%）。在137个留出试验中，52.6%仍表现出修订策略的改进，表明改进可泛化。合成数据恢复测试中，215个修订程序中51.6%在留出数据上优于基线CB，8.4%恢复了CB与CB_damaged_2之间至少75%的预测差距。修订高度集中在以"局部损伤修复"为核心的主题上——CB族73%、SP族67%、TP族79%的修订与损伤检测/修复行为有关。

Conclusion: 该框架成功地将人类专家的理论假设与LLM的程序合成能力相结合，能够在保留原有模型可解释性的前提下，发现更准确地刻画人类算法结构化行为的认知模型。修订模式在策略族之间高度一致，揭示出"局部损伤感知与修复"是一类关键的算法创新。该方法为认知建模中数据似然提升与理论意义之间的平衡问题提供了一个原则性方案，但如何避免对单个被试/轨迹的过拟合、如何在不同上下文间进行部分池化与程序压缩、以及如何系统评估所发现程序与更广泛理论框架的关系，仍是亟待解决的核心问题。

Abstract: Developing cognitive models of algorithmic reasoning from behavioral data is a central problem in cognitive science that challenges current methods. Traditional approaches to cognitive modeling are interpretable and benefit from human expertise, but lack flexibility and scalability. Emerging techniques using large language models (LLMs) for de novo generation of cognitive models are scalable and flexible, but lack a role for human expertise and have mostly been applied to simpler tasks than algorithm recovery. We propose a hybrid system that treats discovery of cognitive algorithms as a program refinement problem. Human-created cognitive models are expressed as probabilistic programs and provided to a system of LLM agents with a mandate to: identify mismatches between model and behavior; propose code-level modifications within researcher-specified constraints; and verify structural fidelity. Revisions propagate to a probabilistic inference module that performs inference for latent variables and data likelihood computations. We evaluate the pipeline on human behavior in a problem-solving paradigm that exposes a variety of cognitive algorithms. Revised models consistently improve model fit relative to ancestral models and reveal a small set of recurring innovations that capture meaningful behavioral variability in this task.

</details>


### [342] [Learning What to Investigate Next: Meta-Reasoning for Long-Horizon Research Agents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.02525)
*Ankur Samanta,Yonathan Efroni,Paul Sajda,Kaveh Hassani,Anirudh Goyal*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出 MIRA（Meta-reasoning for Iterative Research Agents），一种用于长程科研智能体的分层架构，将"下一步研究什么"的元推理决策与执行分离，并基于此开发 MIRA-AC，一种共享的生成式 actor-critic，用于在元推理决策边界处进行延迟信用分配和长程强化学习。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 长程科研智能体需要在证据积累过程中决定下一步研究什么。这类决策稀疏于长执行轨迹中，且后果可能在多个调研之后才显现。学习这类决策面临稀疏奖励与延迟后果两大挑战。论文借鉴 Russell & Wefald (1991) 的元推理思想，将其形式化为可训练的序贯决策过程：单位动作是研究决策（写工单或终止），执行过程（包括实验、工具调用等）成为环境转移的一部分，从而隔离信用分配边界。

Method: 方法分三层：（1）MIRA 架构——持久化 Git 仓库承载研究状态 H_t，外层元推理策略基于策划上下文 o_t 采样完整决策响应 a_t（推理+工单或终止），每次工单由全新内层执行器（Codex harness）完成。（2）决策级生成式评论家——使用语言模型自身的 next-token 分布（限制在 K 个支持标签上）预测剩余回报 V_π(o_t)，目标为 Monte Carlo 返回 G_t 的 KL 投影；跨环境 LOO 预训练提供可迁移的部分进度价值先验。（3）MIRA-AC——共享参数 θ 的 actor-critic，决策级优势经 GAE 反向传播（带跨版本桥接项 B_t 对齐异步更新中不同版本评论家基线），actor 损失仅作用于采样的完整元推理决策响应（推理+工单/终止），屏蔽执行器轨迹；采用缓冲单滚动异步优化（独立 actor/critic 缓冲，原子事务更新，活跃 episode 在下一决策边界采纳新参数）以适应变长调研。

Result: 实验涵盖四阶段：（1）未训练的 MIRA 在 IMOProofBench 上将 GPT-5.5 得分从 67.1% 提升到 100%（30/30 满分），在 HillClimbBench-RMT 与 Loop 上均优于 GPT-5.5/Codex 基线，分别发现按单元残差写入门控（每单元门仅增 0.056% 参数）和 signed attention + 渗漏循环更新（ρ=0.25）。（2）决策级生成式评论家在 RMSE 上比 token 级生成式降低 0.110 绝对值；LOO 跨环境预训练在零样本与 5 episode 适应后均降低 0.053 RMSE。（3）四环境（BNLearn、Physics、SRBench、HillClimbBench-CPU）的策略学习消融显示，proxy-marginal 监督下的 MIRA-AC 在所有四个环境中均超越未训练 MIRA 的主指标；跨环境 MIRA-AC（在 BNLearn 上只做评论家预训练、不做 actor 更新）迁移后与最佳独立适配器结果持平或更高。（4）行为分析（400 配对 LLM 评判）：MIRA-AC 在 60.8% 决断配对中贡献更大，更频繁地区分竞争想法（28.0% vs 16.8%）并减少局部搜索停滞（18.8% vs 33.5%），但训练信号同样带来更大的方差——当代理评估奖励捷径时风险更高。决策响应仅占决策与执行输出 token 的 25.8%，却承担全部 actor 损失；策划保持平均每 episode 1060 万输入 token，低于无压缩/自动压缩回放投影。

Conclusion: 论文证明：(a) 将"下一步研究什么"显式化为可学习策略（而非长程生成的副产品）可行且有效；(b) 决策级生成式评论家 + 跨环境价值预训练为部分进度提供可迁移先验；(c) 决策级信用分配使长程强化学习无需直接优化执行轨迹，actor 仅在完整决策响应上更新；(d) 共享 actor-critic 表征（评论家损失直接塑造策略对证据的识别）进一步提升策略；(e) 跨环境训练的元推理策略可迁移至 actor 训练中完全保留的环境。局限包括：仅训练动作选择而保持策划/执行固定；策略训练塑造"研究气质"（更愿意大改 vs 耐心微调），存在过度探索或被代理评估误导的风险；LoRA 与当前基础设施下的异步优化尚未覆盖更长调研时长；决策级抽象在调研重叠/分支/连续演化场景下是否仍有效仍是开放问题。未来方向包括联合学习策划、分配与执行；扩大训练分布以覆盖多样化研究风格；研究异质化执行器下的元推理迁移；以及明确代理-金标准对齐度对策略改进稳定性的影响。

Abstract: Long-horizon research agents must decide both how to investigate and what to investigate next as evidence accumulates. This is hard to learn because such decisions are sparse in long execution traces, and their consequences may emerge several investigations later. We introduce Meta-reasoning for Iterative Research Agents (MIRA), a hierarchical architecture separating research allocation from execution. An outer-loop meta-reasoner curates context from a persistent research record, then writes a work order for the next investigation or ends the episode. A fresh inner-loop executor carries out each work order, making execution part of the transition between meta-reasoning actions. Without policy training, MIRA improves long-horizon inference and allocates additional compute more effectively in theorem proving and open-ended neural-architecture research. Its decision boundaries also provide natural units for credit assignment. At each boundary, we train a generative critic to forecast expected remaining return from partial states, outperforming token-level alternatives. Cross-environment pretraining improves forecasting and adaptation, yielding a transferable prior for valuing partial progress. We use this prior to initialize MIRA-AC, a generative actor-critic jointly trained to forecast remaining return and choose the next investigation, without a separate critic model. MIRA-AC concentrates policy optimization on meta-reasoning decisions, enabling efficient long-horizon reinforcement learning without directly optimizing the longer execution traces they initiate. Training MIRA-AC on the model's own proxy hill-climbing signals improves gold performance across four autoresearch environments; the actor transfers with cross-environment value initialization. Together, these results show that meta-reasoning can be learned as an explicit policy for directing long-horizon autonomous research.

</details>


### [343] [How To Train Your World Model: Fine-tuning vs RAG for LM-based World Modeling](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.02542)
*Dhananjay Ashok,Shantanu Agarwal,Vivek Datla,Jonathan May,Alfy Samuel*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文系统比较了微调（Fine-tuning）与检索增强生成（RAG）在基于语言模型的世界建模（World Modeling）中的表现，涵盖5类任务、共20种模型-环境组合。研究发现微调在15/20场景中优于RAG，且两种方法均受益于多样化的探索数据；进一步分析表明RAG检索阶段存在显著错误率（Recall@5低于70%），而分层检索策略能显著改善检索质量。最终，作者提出一种融合微调与检索的混合世界模型（HWM），在17/20设置中取得最佳性能，达到Oracle上限77%的效用。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 当前基于LM的世界建模主要采用微调方法，但RAG作为非参数化方法在知识获取任务中表现优异，其在世界建模中的应用尚缺乏系统性比较。本研究旨在填补该空白，探究RAG与微调在基于LM的世界建模中的表现差异，并设计更优的混合方案。

Method: （1）在5类文本环境（ALFWorld、TextWorld、WebShop、Sotopia、Chameleon）中构建微调与RAG两类世界模型；（2）使用4种策略LM（Llama-3.1-8B、Mistral-7B、Gemma-4-26B-A4B、Gemma-4-31B）作为冻结代理，通过候选动作预测-选择-执行框架进行规划；（3）通过反事实干预估计检索器错误率；（4）提出分层检索（先按观测后按动作相似度级联）与线性组合两种查询重构策略；（5）设计混合方法（HWM），结合微调与episode级掩码检索训练模型。

Result: （1）微调在15/20的模型-环境设置中效用最优，RAG在Chameleon环境中占优；（2）RAG数据效率更高（约40个样本即可接近峰值），微调则随数据规模持续提升（拐点约n=80）；（3）检索阶段Recall@5上限低于70%，分层检索在3/4环境中提升显著（TextWorld奖励近乎翻倍：12.62 vs 6.50）；（4）混合世界模型在17/20设置中取得最佳表现，达到Oracle上限77%的效用，45%组合超过90%。

Conclusion: 研究证实微调在基于LM的世界建模中普遍优于RAG，但二者结合的混合范式能进一步突破各自瓶颈。检索质量的提升（如分层检索）以及参数化与非参数化方法的协同，是构建鲁棒LM世界模型的关键。该研究为基于LM的智能体规划系统提供了实践指导。

Abstract: World models (WMs) simulate the transition dynamics of environments, enabling agents to plan over the consequences of their actions. In text-based environments, fine-tuning a Language Model (LM) to serve as a WM has emerged as a dominant paradigm. However, despite the widespread success of non-parametric approaches such as Retrieval Augmented Generation (RAG), retrieval for LM-based world modelling remains underexplored. We conduct a systematic evaluation across five diverse environments spanning embodied, web navigation and social settings, comparing fine-tuning and RAG-based approaches for LM-based world modelling. Our study reveals that fine-tuning often outperforms RAG, with fine-tuned WMs enabling agents to obtain higher rewards on 15/20 settings. While both construction paradigms benefit from additional and more diverse exploration, RAG-based approaches prove more data-efficient, and fine-tuning approaches disproportionately benefit from scaling the amount of experience collected. With a focus on RAG-based WMs, we devise a procedure that uses counterfactual intervention to estimate the error rate of the retrieval stage, and show that retrievers consistently surface suboptimal transitions from the experience buffer. Hoping to address this failing, we study a variety of query reformulation strategies, demonstrating that a hierarchical approach outperforms the traditional retrieval pipeline. Finally, we compose our findings into a hybrid world modelling system that parametrically captures core environment dynamics, while learning to rely on retrieval from an actively maintained memory store. Our hybrid system consistently outperforms other methods across multiple environments and models, showcasing the robustness of the approach and the applicability of our findings.

</details>


### [344] [How to Have a Sensitive Debate: An Instance-Optimal Protocol for AI Debate](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.02557)
*Jiawei Li,Zhiyang Xun,Lijie Chen,Jonah Brown-Cohen*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出了基于分数块灵敏度（Fractional Block Sensitivity, FBS）的AI辩论协议，用于解决可监督性问题。该协议在具有"稳定分解"的问题类上实现了实例最优性，提供了最坏情况下的正确性保证，并将诚实性提升至占优策略均衡。通过建立稳定分解与查询复杂度中FBS概念之间的等价性，作者证明了任何仅使用黑盒查询的协议都无法在渐近意义上优于该协议。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 随着AI系统在复杂认知任务上接近或超越人类专家，对这些系统进行准确监督的问题变得日益紧迫。AI辩论作为一种有前景的方法，理论上可在计算复杂性框架下形式化。但现有最佳协议（prover-estimator）仅提供平均情况保证和Stackelberg均衡保证，限制了其实用性。本文旨在设计一个更优的协议，提供最坏情况保证和占优策略均衡。

Method: 1. 设计了一个简洁的FBS辩论协议：Alice将声明分解为子声明，Bob有两个选择：(1) 证明分解对子声明中的小错误过于敏感，或(2) 选择一个子声明递归辩论。2. 利用分数块灵敏度（来自查询复杂度理论）的对偶线性规划为Bob提供采样概率，保证Bob以至少1/ρ的概率捕捉到Alice的错误。3. 证明了局部FBS条件意味着全局分解树函数的FBS至少为ρ^d。4. 通过构造替代oracle和使用概率耦合证明，任何m查询的自适应验证器的区分优势至多为m·ρ^(-d)。

Result: 1. 完整性（Completeness）：诚实的Alice总能获胜，时间复杂度为O(d·(T_D + q·T))，查询复杂度为O(d·q·Q)。2. 健全性（Soundness）：若Alice回答错误，Bob以至少ρ^(-d)的概率获胜；运行O(ρ^d log n)次协议后，捕获概率达到1-1/poly(n)。3. 最优性：任何m查询自适应协议在区分root值的差异时优势至多为min{1, m·ρ^(-d)}，意味着需要至少Ω(ρ^d)查询才能以常数概率找到有缺陷的子声明。4. 与先前prover-estimator协议相比，本协议提供：(a) 最坏情况而非平均情况保证，(b) 占优策略均衡而非Stackelberg均衡。

Conclusion: 分数块灵敏度精确刻画了在递归分解框架内可通过辩论有效解决的问题集。FBS辩论协议是实例最优的，这意味着要进一步扩展辩论可处理的问题类，必须放宽对人类判断的黑盒oracle假设。未来的研究方向包括：利用Bob与Alice同等的计算能力，或探索其他放松黑盒假设的方法以设计更好的辩论协议。

Abstract: As powerful AI systems reach and sometimes surpass the abilities of human experts across a range of cognitively demanding tasks, the problem of accurate oversight and supervision of these systems has become increasingly urgent. One promising approach is AI debate, which seeks to leverage a debate between two powerful AIs to break complex questions down into simpler claims that can be easily judged directly. Theoretical work on debate has formalized this intuition in the language of computational complexity theory, where the goal is to design protocols (i.e., rules of the debate game) that provide rigorous guarantees on correctness for judging solutions to complex problems with limited supervision. Specifically, the current best protocol has been shown to work for all problems that have sufficiently stable decompositions into subproblems. In this paper, we design a new protocol for this same class of problems that improves on the prior work in several ways. First, correctness holds in a worst-case rather than an average-case sense. Second, being honest and correct is a dominant-strategy equilibrium for both debaters, rather than a Stackelberg equilibrium. Finally, we prove black-box lower bounds, showing that our new protocol is instance-wise optimal. That is, no protocol for this class of problems can outperform ours while making only black-box queries to human judgments. We obtain these results by relating the notion of stable problem decompositions to the concept of fractional block sensitivity from query complexity.

</details>


### [345] [Mitigating Social Sycophancy via Pluralistic Preference Optimization](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.02568)
*Stephane Hatgis-Kessell,Myra Cheng,Xiaoxuan Hou,Qian Hu,Rahul Gupta,Natasha Jaques,Emma Brunskill*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出Pluralistic Preference Optimization (PlurPO)，一种无需人工标注或更强教师模型即可缓解大语言模型社会谄媚行为的后训练方法。核心思想是让模型自动识别并模拟人际关系冲突中除用户外的相关利益相关者，然后训练模型生成能被所有利益相关者接受的回复。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 大语言模型在个人建议（如情感关系咨询）中表现出明显的社会谄媚倾向，过度迎合用户而非平衡各方视角。先前缓解谄媚的工作主要针对有标准答案的事实性场景，而对缺乏真实标签的社会谄媚（如个人建议）缺乏有效方法。简单提示工程效果有限，且基于偏好的训练反而可能放大谄媚行为以提升用户满意度。

Method: PlurPO采用两步流程：(1) 自动构建偏好数据集——利用待训练模型自身（作为冻结的监督模型π_supervisor）识别输入中描述的人际冲突所涉及的利益相关者，从原始模型π采样k2=10个候选回复，并由监督模型模拟每个利益相关者对每个回复是否接受/否决，构造"所有利益相关者接受"优于"至少一个否决"的偏好对；(2) 使用Iterative RPO (Iterative Reasoning Preference Optimization, 基于DPO的变体) 进行训练。额外增加一轮训练以缓解角色混淆问题。训练仅依赖模型自身产生的信号，不需要真实标签或更强教师模型。

Result: 在四个社会谄媚基准数据集（OEQ, PAS, AITA, AITA-Flipped）和四个模型家族（Qwen3-8B, Phi-4, Llama 3.1 8B, Granite-4.1-8B）上的实验显示：PlurPO在所有数据集上均显著优于六种基线方法；在PAS数据集上将有害意图的认可率平均降低89%（从34.4%降至3.4%）；在OEQ上将模型与人类的认可率差距从17.8%缩小至8.0%；在AITA上将用户错误时被模型认同的比率从75.0%降至34.1%。用8B模型构造的偏好数据集可有效迁移到32B模型训练。同时模型在IFEval上的指令遵循能力未显著退化。

Conclusion: PlurPO证明多元对齐（pluralistic alignment）是缓解社会谄媚的有效策略，且现有谄媚模型本身已具备纠正自身行为的足够能力，无需更强的模型或人工真实标签。该方法具有可扩展性、跨模型家族的通用性，并能跨模型规模迁移数据。局限在于：(1) 仍存在过度批评用户的风险；(2) 依赖模型自身模拟利益相关者可能反映其固有偏见；(3) 训练效果对提示词设计较为敏感，需要针对不同模型进行调整。

Abstract: Personal advice, including relationship advice, now ranks among the most common uses of generative AI. But language models (LMs) exhibit sycophancy: they affirm users much more often than humans do, which can make people overconfident and less willing to repair their relationships after a conflict. Prior work on mitigating sycophancy has focused on factual settings where a response can be checked against a ground truth answer, while mitigations for social sycophancy (e.g., personal advice, where there is no ground truth) have relied on simple prompting and post-training methods with limited effectiveness. Our insight is that social sycophancy occurs in part because LMs overly center on the user and fail to consider the perspectives of other stakeholders impacted by the user's behavior. To address this problem we propose Pluralistic Preference Optimization (PlurPO): given inputs describing interpersonal conflicts, the LM identifies and simulates the relevant stakeholders, and is then trained to prefer and generate responses acceptable to all stakeholders. PlurPO uses only signals the model produces about its own outputs, without ground-truth labels. PlurPO substantially reduces social sycophancy across four datasets and four model families compared to prior methods. For example, on statements of intent to cause harm, where the users' actions should not be endorsed, PlurPO reduces the endorsement rate by 89% on average across four models. On general advice questions, where the target is to match the endorsement rate of human responses, it closes the gap by more than half, from 17.8% to 8.0% on average. The preference dataset constructed by PlurPO for an 8B model also effectively transfers to mitigating sycophancy in a larger (32B) model. Our results indicate that social sycophancy can be reduced by leveraging a model's own capabilities to simulate a plurality of relevant perspectives.

</details>


### [346] [Answering clinicians' questions over trial evidence tables with verifiable, feedback-driven language models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.02576)
*Manan Roy Choudhury,Suparno Roy Chowdhury,Swastik Sahoo,Muhammad Ali Khan,Kaneez Zahra Rubab Khakwani,Mohamad Bassam Sonbol,Irbaz Bin Riaz,Vivek Gupta*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: FD-SCoPE是一个基于语言模型的框架，让临床医生能够以自然语言查询癌症试验证据表，既能检索已记录字段，也能推导未存储属性（如药物靶点类别），并通过查询、程序与专家反馈提供可审计的答案。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 系统综述生成的证据表是临床决策的关键依据，但当前查询需要通过分析员手动操作，且许多问题涉及表中未直接记录的派生属性（如药物靶点类别、标准化终点）。现有LLM系统在处理这类表时存在三个缺口：流畅的查询未必返回正确的试验集；模型可推理但选择行可能遗漏相关试验；专家修正难以被后续问题复用。需要一个可审计、支持反馈累积的系统。

Method: FD-SCoPE整合了FD-NL2SQL和SCoPE系统，通过安全检查后将问题路由至两类路径：(1)对已记录字段问题，将问题分解为最多6个原子约束，与表值目录进行精确/近似匹配（字段阈值0.72，值阈值0.86），检索最相似的专家示例（基于all-MiniLM-L6-v2嵌入），生成只读SQLite查询并执行；(2)对未记录属性问题，先用SQL选择试验队列，再由规划器生成推导规则（Python表达式），程序在沙盒中执行并需在≥85%的样本行上与模型输出一致才能被接受，否则逐行推导。系统从批准的SQL示例库和推导程序库中复用规则，每次回答记录完整步骤供审查。主要模型为Qwen3.8-27B（thinking mode关闭，bfloat16，温度0），辅助模型Gemma-3-27B-it，vLLM 0.27.1部署于H200 GPU。

Result: 在包含159条免疫检查点抑制剂试验记录的IOTOX证据表上：FD-SCoPE完成全部140项临床风格任务（替代方法90.7–97.9%）；在1,500项已记录字段基准问题上精确匹配率58.9%（最佳替代DAIL-SQL风格55.2%，配对差3.7点）；在1,500项派生属性问题上，派生值F1为77.7%（替代方法64.8–73.4%），试验检索灵敏度99.3%，阳性预测值89.8%；基于299题参考答案的模拟反馈使1,201题保留问题的派生值F1从77.9%升至84.9%，未见试验的准确率从84.1%升至91.9%。组件分析显示查询式选行贡献最大（移除后F1下降10.4点）。系统在46项安全提示测试中正确拒绝所有越权请求，数据库文件执行前后哈希一致。局限性：单一肿瘤表、反馈由参考答案模拟而非真实临床医生使用、基准问题由模板程序化扩展、所有系统仅单次运行。

Conclusion: 将语言模型与可执行查询、验证程序和专家反馈相结合，可为临床医生提供可审计的试验证据访问途径。查询驱动的试验选择是减少遗漏相关试验的关键设计选择；通过反馈将修正转化为可复用的推导规则和批准SQL，可在未见试验上实现能力迁移；但需要专家审批学习到的规则以防止跨族误用。该框架是证据合成的接口而非决策系统，需在多表注册库和真实临床使用场景中进一步验证。

Abstract: Systematic reviews condense clinical trials into evidence tables, yet clinicians can interrogate these tables only through database queries, and many questions concern attributes that the table does not record, such as a drug's target class or a harmonised endpoint. Here we introduce FD-SCoPE, a language-model framework that answers both kinds of question, exposes the query, the selected trials and the derivation rule behind every answer, and learns from expert corrections. On an oncology evidence table of 159 immune checkpoint inhibitor trial records, FD-SCoPE completed all 140 clinician-style tasks (alternatives, 90.7-97.9%). For questions needing derived attributes it retrieved 99.3% of relevant trial records at a positive predictive value of 89.8% and outperformed four alternative approaches (derived-value F1 77.7% versus 64.8-73.4%). Corrections on 299 questions, simulated from reference answers, raised F1 on 1,201 unseen questions from 77.9% to 84.9%. Language models coupled with executable queries, verified programs and expert feedback can give clinicians auditable access to trial evidence.

</details>


### [347] [Labels Override Definitions in Jev-Style Typed Decision Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.02586)
*Seyedarmin Azizi,Erfan Baghaei Potraghloo,Massoud Pedram*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 该研究针对Jev式类型化决策模型（typed decision models），通过四项开放权重模型与PolicyBench合成测试集，发现模型返回值更多由选项标签（label）决定，而非开发者书写的选项定义（definition）。研究通过双向干预（修改提示渲染代码而非权重）证实标签偏差源于提示渲染阶段，而非先前归因的受限决策头（constrained decision head）。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: Jev式类型化决策模型被设计为：调用者在每个选项的definition中陈述规则，模型返回该规则的概率。但本论文测试发现模型更倾向读标签（derivation存在却无意义），挑战了接口的隐含契约。先前工作（Sun et al., 2026）将此偏差归因于受限决策头架构，但作者怀疑归因错误，需要通过机制研究确定偏差根源。

Method: 采用跨模型、跨任务、跨读取方式（scoring vs generative）对比实验：(1) PolicyBench合成测试套件——六个受控属性+七个策略，规则仅出现在definition中；(2) 11个公开分类任务；(3) 双向干预实验——对laya三个checkpoint删除标签，对von添加标签，权重和决策头均不变；(4) 控制变量设计PolicyBench-XF（两个分支的definition具有可比具体性）；(5) flip rate、state-blindness等新指标；(6) 95% bootstrap置信区间。

Result: 主要结果：(1) laya-td删除定义后准确率不变(0.8559 vs 0.8487)，但用A/B重命名选项可获得+0.1511准确率提升；(2) von完全不受标签影响(差异为0)；(3) 关键代码差异：laya写入"{label}: {definition}"，von仅写definition；(4) 双向干预使laya三个checkpoint完全不变(+0.0000)，von添加标签后从0.8511降至0.2281；(5) 否定问题处理失败：98%决策在极性取反时翻转，置信分数不可靠；(6) Qwen2.5-7B语言模型读取也呈现类似偏差，证伪决策头归因。
